job.title: Product Manager
job.html_description:
Based at Manchester City's HQ, this full-time permanent role will shape and grow the products that bring fans and visitors closer to the Club beyond match day. Working 37.5 hours per week in a hybrid model, you will guide products from discovery through launch, optimisation and ongoing evolution across attractions, conferencing and events, including opportunities connected with the new Medlock development.

 

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Operations, our Product team helps create meaningful experiences for supporters, visitors, partners and customers. The non-match day product pillar spans the Stadium Tours, Museum, Roofwalk, conferencing and events, as well as new experiences linked to the developing Medlock site. This is an opportunity to own a broad portfolio across both digital and physical customer journeys.

 

 

The Role

 

This Product Manager role focuses on non-match day experiences. You’ll manage products through their full lifecycle, from early discovery and concept development to delivery, launch and ongoing improvement. Using customer insight, analytics and commercial context, you’ll identify opportunities, shape viable solutions and improve how people experience the Club beyond match day. You will use customer insight, analytics and commercial context to help identify opportunities, shape viable solutions and improve how people experience the Club beyond match day.

 

You will own and prioritise the product backlog, translating strategic objectives and customer needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery plans. Working closely with Product Design and Technology, you will support feasibility assessment, coordinate testing and user acceptance, and help ensure products are operationally ready and prepared for launch.

 

The role brings together colleagues across Product, Design, Technology, Commercial, Fan Experience, Operations and Data. You will create alignment across different perspectives, monitor product performance and customer behaviour, and use evidence and feedback to guide roadmap priorities, product evolution and improvements to customer experience and commercial performance.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience managing products across the full lifecycle, from discovery through launch and optimisation.

⚽ Experience working closely with Product Design and Engineering or Technology teams to shape feasible, scalable solutions.

⚽ Ability to translate strategic objectives and customer needs into clear product requirements and delivery plans.

⚽ Practical understanding of agile product delivery and backlog prioritisation.

⚽ Experience coordinating stakeholders across multiple business functions to support aligned delivery.

⚽ Ability to use data, customer insight and structured problem-solving to evaluate performance and inform product improvements.

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 October 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

The recruitment process is expected to include an initial screening interview of approximately 30 minutes on Teams, followed by a final-stage interview on site that includes a practical task or presentation. Exact interview dates and final-stage details will be confirmed during the process.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: UAE Football Coach - Manchester City Football Education UAE
job.html_description:
Closing Date: 8 November 2026 
Assessment Date: 14 November 2026, 8am-12pm at City Football Academy, Manchester

 

Based in the United Arab Emirates, this full-time opportunity offers coaches the chance to take their career onto a global stage with Manchester City. You will help deliver high-quality coaching programmes while developing your own coaching identity within a diverse and fast-growing football environment. It is an opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to a world-class football organisation, gaining international experience while making a meaningful impact on player development.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Our Football Education team delivers programmes around the world, bringing Manchester City’s coaching philosophy to life across a range of environments. In the UAE, our programmes continue to grow, offering coaches the chance to work in a dynamic, multicultural setting while supporting the development of players of all abilities.

 

The Role

 

You will join a collaborative coaching team delivering programmes that reflect Manchester City’s coaching philosophy, standards and approach. Working across a range of age groups and abilities, you will help create engaging, high-quality sessions that support both player development and enjoyment of the game.

 

Alongside delivery, you will contribute to the ongoing development of programmes by supporting session planning, reviews and continuous improvement. You will work closely with colleagues to ensure consistency in delivery, while also adapting your approach to meet the needs of different players and environments.

 

You will also play an important role in representing Manchester City both on and off the pitch, building positive relationships with players, families and local stakeholders, and contributing to wider programme activations across the region.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ FA Level 2 or UEFA C coaching qualification (minimum)
⚽ Membership of a recognised FA or international equivalent
⚽ Experience delivering coaching sessions within a football environment
⚽ Ability to communicate clearly and build positive relationships with players and colleagues
⚽ Experience working with players from a range of backgrounds and abilities
⚽ Commitment to learning, development and continuous improvement

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at City Football Group means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

This role offers a comprehensive international relocation package, including housing, medical cover, transport allowance, flights and visa sponsorship, alongside the opportunity to gain valuable global coaching experience.

 

Find out more about our UAE programs

Follow us

 

  • Man City Abu Dhabi League

  • City Football Schools – UAE
    https://www.instagram.com/cityfootballschools/profilecard/?igsh=MTZ2bDlwZHplM3Y2
  • Man City Abu Dhabi Cup
    https://www.instagram.com/abudhabicup

 

How to Apply

 

If you’re ready to take the next step in your coaching career and explore an international opportunity with Manchester City, we’d love to hear from you. Please click apply and submit your application via our careers site by 8 November 2026.

 

The assessment day will take place on Saturday 14 November at City Football Academy, Manchester.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

The Role
You will join a collaborative coaching team delivering programmes that reflect Manchester City’s coaching philosophy, standards and approach. job.title: Casual Academy Physiotherapist
job.html_description:
Based at the City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual opportunity supports the health, wellbeing and on-pitch development of high-potential Academy players. You will provide responsive physiotherapy support across training and matchday activity, helping players recover well, reduce injury risk and return safely to full function within an elite development environment.

 

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within the Manchester City Academy, our multidisciplinary team supports young players throughout their development pathway. Medical, performance and coaching colleagues work together to provide thoughtful, evidence-based care that promotes player wellbeing, availability and long-term development on and off the pitch.

 

 

The Role

 

As a Casual Academy Physiotherapist, you will contribute to the assessment and management of injuries, helping to optimise recovery and minimise time away from football. You will also support screening and injury-prevention activity, applying current clinical practice to meet the individual needs of Academy players.

 

Working alongside the wider medical and performance team, you will help deliver rehabilitation plans that support a safe return to full function. You will provide emergency aid cover at training sessions and matches and maintain the professional registration, pitch-side trauma accreditation and clinical standards required for the role.

 

Clear communication will be central to your impact. You will work effectively with full-time colleagues, players, parents and coaches, while contributing to continuous professional development across the Academy therapy team. Casual assignments may be offered at short notice and can include evenings, weekends and other irregular hours.

 

 

What You’ll Bring

 

 

  • A degree in Physiotherapy, Sport Rehabilitation or Sports Therapy
  • Current HCPC or BASRaT registration appropriate to your professional discipline
  • Current ITMMiF Level 4 pitch-side trauma qualification, or a higher equivalent qualification
  • Ability to support injury assessment, rehabilitation and injury-prevention activity in a player-centred way
  • Clear and effective communication skills when working with players, parents, coaches and multidisciplinary colleagues
  • Flexibility to accept casual assignments at short notice, including evenings, weekends and other irregular hours

 

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working with Manchester City means being supported to contribute your expertise in an environment built on collaboration, openness and high standards of care. You will have the opportunity to support talented young players at important stages of their development and see the direct impact of thoughtful, evidence-based practice.

 

This casual position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced medical, performance and coaching colleagues within an elite Academy setting. Each assignment is a chance to broaden your experience, share knowledge and contribute to a multidisciplinary approach that places player wellbeing and long-term development at its centre.

 

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 6 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Visitor Attractions Front of House Assistants
job.html_description:
Based at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, this role helps bring the Manchester City visitor experience to life. You will welcome stadium tour and Altitude guests, capture and sell souvenir photography and merchandise, and support interactive experiences, making each visit feel organised, engaging and memorable.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

Within Medlock Attractions, we welcome visitors to experiences including the Manchester City Stadium Tour and Altitude. Our front of house team supports guests from arrival through to their souvenir experience, combining friendly service, accurate sales activity and close attention to detail.

 

The Role

 

You will be one of the first people our guests meet, providing a warm welcome and checking visitors in for the Manchester City Stadium Tour. You will help each arrival run smoothly by sharing clear information, using booking systems accurately and responding helpfully to guest needs.

 

Across the Stadium Tour and Altitude experiences, you will take souvenir photographs and sell photos, videos and relevant merchandise face to face through the VEGA sales system. You will listen to what guests are looking for, introduce additional products where appropriate and contribute to daily sales targets without losing sight of a positive visitor experience.

 

You will also support the Tours virtual reality experience and complete day-to-day administrative tasks using Microsoft Excel and Word. Working collaboratively with colleagues, you will bring care, organisation and attention to detail to every part of the operation.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Experience providing excellent face-to-face customer service in a customer-focused environment.

⚽ Experience using till and booking systems accurately.

⚽ Comfortable using Microsoft Excel and Word for day-to-day tasks.

⚽ Ability to stay organised and pay close attention to detail across guest and sales activity.

⚽ GCSE Maths and English at Grade C or above, or an equivalent qualification.

⚽ Good knowledge of the Premier League and Manchester City.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 30 October 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

 

Equal Opportunities

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Casual Football Coach - UK Football Education
job.html_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual role offers the chance to support Manchester City Football Education by delivering high-quality coaching sessions for players of diverse ages and abilities. You will help create a positive, organised and development-focused environment while building your experience with support from senior coaches.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.

 

Within Manchester City Football Education, we create engaging coaching experiences that support player development and inspire a lifelong love of the game. Our coaching environment is built on high standards, positive relationships and continuous learning, with a shared focus on helping players enjoy quality sessions and progress with confidence.

 

The Role

 

In this casual coaching role, you will support the preparation, delivery and review of sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching curriculum and methodology. You will work with players of different ages and abilities, helping to create an environment that is welcoming, professional and focused on development.

 

You will deliver sessions across weekends, evenings and school holidays, while receiving mentoring and training that supports your own growth as a coach. You will also contribute to quality assurance by maintaining high standards of delivery, communication and session preparation.

 

This is a role for those who enjoy working independently and as part of a wider coaching team, with a clear focus on positive player experiences, consistency and professional conduct. You will act as a positive role model and ambassador for Manchester City, helping to ensure players, parents and colleagues receive a high-quality experience at every session.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

⚽ Minimum UEFA C or equivalent coaching qualification
⚽ Experience coaching in education, community or club settings
⚽ A relevant higher education qualification, or equivalent professional experience
⚽ Commitment to ongoing CPD, including safeguarding awareness and DBS compliance
⚽ Clear and effective communication skills with players, parents, coaches and stakeholders
⚽ Proven ability to plan, deliver and review coaching sessions that support player development across age groups

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As a casual coach, you will also benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing mentoring and training, and the chance to build on your experience in a supportive coaching environment.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 8 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an assessment on Saturday 14 November 2026, at City Football Academy, Manchester. Attendance at the assessment day is compulsory to be considered for the role.

 

We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.

job.plain_text_description:
Based at City Football Academy in Manchester, this casual role gives you the opportunity to support Manchester City Football Education through goalkeeper coaching that is engaging, well-structured and focused on player development. You will help create a positive learning environment while building your experience with support from senior coaches.
Who We Are
Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way.
Within Manchester City Football Education, our goalkeeper coaching environment combines technical development, positive relationships and continuous learning. We work with players of different ages and abilities to deliver high-quality experiences that support confidence, decision-making and long-term growth in and out of possession.
The Role
In this casual goalkeeper coaching role, you will support the preparation, delivery and review of sessions aligned to the Manchester City coaching curriculum and methodology. You will work with goalkeepers of different ages and abilities, creating an environment that is positive, professional and focused on development.
You will deliver goalkeeper-specific sessions at City Football Academy in Manchester, and contribute to player, team and coach development programmes. You will also support some classroom delivery for UK and international participants, bringing a clear and engaging approach to every session.
Goalkeeper coaches who are confident leading sessions for outfield players are also encouraged to apply. You will benefit from full training in the Manchester City coaching methodology and development pathways, while contributing to a team environment that values high standards, collaboration and positive participant experiences.
What You’ll Bring
⚽ Minimum UEFA C or equivalent coaching qualification ⚽ Recognised goalkeeping qualification ⚽ Experience coaching in education, community or club settings ⚽ A relevant higher education qualification, or equivalent professional experience ⚽ Commitment to ongoing CPD, including safeguarding awareness and DBS compliance ⚽ Clear and effective communication skills with coaches, players, parents and stakeholders
Why Choose Us
Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.
As a casual coach, you will also benefit from flexible working arrangements, ongoing mentoring and training, and the chance to learn from some of the best goalkeeper coaches in the industry.
How to Apply
If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 8 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an assessment on Saturday 14 November 2026, at City Football Academy, Manchester. Attendance at the assessment day is compulsory in order to be considered for the role.
We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application.
Equal Opportunities
City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.
We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. job.title: Sports Medicine Lead - Manchester City Women
job.html_description:
Based in Manchester, this permanent role is available full-time or on a reduced-hours basis, with a minimum commitment of 0.6 FTE. You will provide comprehensive medical care across Manchester City Women’s First Team and Girls’ Academy, with a particular focus on supporting the First Team. You will help players access high-quality assessment, treatment and recovery pathways, while contributing to the medical standards, wellbeing and performance of the wider football programme.

 

Who We Are

 

Manchester City Women is a team driven by ambition, belief and a desire to keep pushing the game forward. Founded in 1988 and relaunched in 2014, we have grown into a consistent force in the women’s game, competing at the highest level in the UK and Europe. Progress, performance and pride sit at the heart of everything we do. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are building what comes next, the City way.

 

Within our Performance Services department, we support the health, wellbeing and performance of Manchester City Women players across the first team and Girls Academy. Working as part of a collaborative medical and sports science environment, we help create the conditions for players to develop, perform and sustain their careers.

 

The Role

 

You will provide medical care for first-team players and Girls Academy players aged 8 to 19, leading on the assessment, investigation, treatment and management of injury and illness. You will also support required medical assessments, screening and profiling, contribute to pre-signing medicals, and provide pitch-side cover at home and away fixtures, including international competitions where required.

 

You will be a proactive member of the multidisciplinary team, contributing to diagnosis, treatment planning and return-to-play decisions. The role will lead the illness audit and help develop prevention strategies, education resources and timely communication plans, while also supporting player wellness and appropriate referral for mental health concerns.

 

You will establish and lead Emergency Medical Action Plans across training, match and travel environments, including for the Academy, and help maintain high standards of clinical governance. By working closely with performance staff, coaches, players, external consultants and football leadership, you will support regulatory compliance, clear communication and an effective medical service across the programme.

 

What You’ll Bring

 

  • Full registration with the General Medical Council.
  • Currently on the GMC specialist register for Sport and Exercise Medicine, General Practice or any other relevant medical speciality.
  • Membership (MFSEM) or Fellowship (FFSEM) of Faculty of Sport and Exercise Medicine.
  • Advanced capability in clinical examination, functional assessment, musculoskeletal imaging and the medical management of injury and illness in high-performance sport.
  • Experience delivering medical services to high-performance athletes.
  • Experience working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team in high-performance sport.
  • Experience supporting young adults in an elite sporting environment.
  • Ability to reflect on clinical practice, adapt when needed and communicate with care. Strong integrity, humility and professionalism. Contribute effectively to clinical governance and compliance with relevant regulations.

 

Why Choose Us

 

Working at Manchester City Women means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work.

 

As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance.

 

Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs.

 

You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers.

 

How to Apply

 

If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 8 November. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can.

 

Equal Opportunities

 

City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation.

 

We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs. We will carefully consider your application during the initial screening and will contact you only if you are selected for an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments or any support throughout the process, please contact hiring@cityfootball.com and we will be happy to help.

 

All CFG recruitment communications originate from @cityfootball.com email addresses. If you receive communications from Gmail, Outlook.com or other personal email services claiming to represent CFG, please verify with the hiring team. Employment is subject to the provision of proof of eligibility to work in the UK.

 

Due to our safeguarding promise, all UK-based CFG roles will be subject to a DBS check upon commencing employment with us. This will be either a basic, standard or enhanced check depending on the job role and responsibilities.

job.title: Matchday Steward (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour


Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)


Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and providing excellent service to the customers of our many bars and kiosks.

 

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 6-8 hours depending on the game.


Responsibilities:

  • Take initiative and participate in the set-up of kiosks and bars, stock and supplies

  • Welcome guests and taking orders

  • Process payments on POS devices in an efficient manner

  • Maintain counters and fridges with sufficient supplies of stock throughout the service period, as guided by your manager.

  • Ensure stock rooms and areas are organised and clean, to ensure easy stock rotation and reconciliation.

  • Where necessary, assist in the back of house areas: kitchen and food preparation, pot wash and stock deliveries

  • Perform clean-up duties after each shift and ensure that concession stand is sanitized and tidied to a high standard

  • Serving alcohol responsibly and following the club’s Challenge 25 Policy

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies including the club’s Food Safety Management Systems

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

  • A positive attitude and be prepared to help the team

  • Experience in catering, hospitality or food service

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Engaging and easy to talk to

job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for a self-motivated, detail orientated and hardworking cleaner to join our team. You will be responsible for making sure that the site is clean, presentable. This can entail dusting, polishing, mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, and cleaning smudges off windows and doors.


Responsibilities:

  • Being responsible for all basic cleaning in and around the building.

  • Cleaning floors and rooms - including dust mopping, damp mopping, sweeping, vacuuming, dusting, picking up objects off the floor, and spot cleaning glass and windows.

  • Cleaning restrooms, including restocking dispensers, emptying trash, cleaning and sanitizing fixtures, cleaning mirrors, spot cleaning partition doors and walls, sweeping and mopping tile floors, and cleaning toilets and urinals.

  • Emptying trash, cleaning vacuums and replacing liners

job.title: Matchday Public Catering Chef (casual contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Fixed-Term Contract

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

If you have experience in preparing and cooking hot food or as a grill chef with a passion for customer service – we want to hear from you! You will be engaging, enthusiastic and have a thirst to learn and grow. You want to be a part of the buzz and excitement of a match day by being the face of Crystal Palace Football Club and serving high quality products throughout the match.

Our match days are typically on Saturdays with some weekday evening and Sunday matches and the typical shift day is 8 hours depending on the game.

Responsibilities:

  • Understanding all menus, product offerings, packaging and pricing

  • Responsible for preparing and cooking all the hot food such as burgers, pies, hot dogs nachos and specialty items for a unit on match day and meeting peak periods with appropriate food levels

  • Maintain high standards of food presentation and quality with regular controls

  • Ensure all products are accounted for, prepared and distributed according to cook-off numbers and instructions from your manager

  • Restock and ensure the food prep area is clean at the end of your shift

  • Ensure all kitchen unit equipment (electrical or otherwise) is cleaned down and properly maintained at the end of every shift

  • Adhere and keep up to date records for food and health and safety standards such as food temperature control levels and following the club’s Food Safety Management System

  • Adhering to all Health & Safety policies and Security policies

  • Carrying out any other reasonable duties asked of you from within your team and management including being flexible in covering tasks outside of your role-specific duties.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Food Safety Level 2 certificate and strong knowledge of proper food handling procedures

  • Experience grilling or cooking food in mass quantities, particularly in a busy or similar environment

  • A can-do attitude and be prepared to help the rest of the team out with a positive attitude

  • Immaculate grooming standards and overall appearance

  • Always look for ways to improve

  • Can work in high pressure situations

job.html_description:

Who we are:

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club are looking for an experienced and skilled Maintenance operative to perform and upkeep tasks such as repairs, inspections, plumbing, carpentry, painting, decorating, general maintenance and planned improvement services to our facilitates. The individual will be responsible for assisting other trades when required to ensure the highest level of service across our sites.


Responsibilities:

  • Undertake the day-to-day general maintenance repairs in-house for all our facilities but mainly at our Academy Training Ground.

  • Undertake painting work, such as preparing painting surfaces, removing old paint, mixing and matching paints, and to use correct utilities to prepare the surrounding areas in order to prevent messes.

  • Undertake plumbing work, such as fixing leaks, unblocking drains and gutters, shower fitting, and more.

  • Undertake tiling and decorating work, such as, preparing surfaces by levelling off with the correct material, measuring and applying tiles, repairing/removing old surfaces, add more.

  • Undertake carpentry work, such as taking measurements and installing shelves, cabinets, handles, locks and more.

  • Preparation of the facilities for home matches

  • Regular checks and repairs on lights, toilets, and seats.

  • Completing work in accordance with the Crystal Palace specifications and in compliance with the relevant Legislation and industry best practices

  • Working to operational procedures, safe working practices and Health and Safety procedures as required.

  • Providing general support and assistance to the Maintenance Manager

  • Inspecting the Training ground and Academy and it’s adjoining structures on a daily and weekly basis to ensure they are all well-kept and in order.

  • Completing works at other Crystal Palace Football Club grounds and facilities including the Academy Training Ground.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience in a maintenance environment.

  • Experience in plumbing, painting, decorating, carpentry, and general maintenance.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance systems such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical etc.

  • Ability to read manuals and drawings.

  • Experience using hand and electrical tools.

  • Experience working in large scale stadiums/ buildings.


Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days

Who we are:

Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees.

About this role:

Crystal Palace FC is looking for passionate, well-presented, and engaging individuals to join our Security matchday team. You’ll play a key role in ensuring the safety, safeguarding, and enjoyment of all our guests at Selhurst Park. Representing Crystal Palace FC on the front line, you’ll deliver outstanding service with a smile, support fans, and help create an unforgettable matchday experience. Be part of the energy, excitement, and pride of Selhurst Park as you play a key role in bringing our club to life on matchdays.


Responsibilities:

  • Commit to and attend all Premier League fixtures (schedule to be announced in June) as well as FA Cup games as required

  • Be responsible for the safe access and comfort of spectators visiting the stadium

  • Identify and report any incident, occurrence or hazard among spectators and report to a supervisor

  • Ensure that CPFC standards are upheld by being the first line of contact with guests and provide a welcoming environment to provide the best experience and visit at Selhurst Park Stadium.

  • Maintain an immaculate personal presentation with a polished professional appearance.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

• You must be over 18 (Essential)

• SIA Door Supervisor Badge (Essential)

• NVQ Level 2 in Spectator Safety (desirable)

• Friendly and happy to help all clients with patience and good manners

• Be mature and be able to handle situations calmly

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills and be polite and courteous

• A strong focus on accuracy and diligence in every aspect

• Good communication skills

• An understanding of body search regulations and processes

• Experience working at a football stadium and/or similar spectator events (Desirable)

job.title: Logistics & Fulfilment Operative (Casual Contract)
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   0-hour, Casual Contract

Salary/ ROP:       £13.15 per hour

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

The Logistics Operative plays a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of matchdays and events across Selhurst Park. Responsible for the movement, storage and organisation of food, beverages, equipment and disposables, the role ensures kiosks, bars and hospitality areas are fully stocked, organised and operational.

Working as part of the Public Catering team, the Logistics Operative helps maintain high standards of cleanliness, food safety and operational efficiency, ensuring an exceptional experience for supporters, guests and clients.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive, check and store food, beverage and equipment deliveries.

  • Ensure stock is rotated and stored in accordance with company procedures.

  • Support stock counts and stock reconciliation activities.

  • Report shortages, damages and discrepancies to management.

  • Maintain accurate stock records where required.

  • Prepare kiosks, bars and catering areas for operation.

  • Distribute food, beverage, equipment and disposable stock throughout the stadium.

  • Support premium areas and event spaces with operational requirements.

  • Ensure units are replenished efficiently throughout service.

  • Respond quickly and effectively to operational requests during matchdays and events.

  • Maintain cellar areas to a high operational standard.

  • Support beer line cleaning procedures where required.

  • Ensure food stores, disposable stock rooms and chemical storage areas are clean, organised and compliant.

  • Assist with the movement and handling of kegs and heavy stock items using safe working practices.

  • Complete HACCP, delivery, temperature and cleaning records accurately.

  • Follow all Health & Safety, Food Safety, COSHH and manual handling procedures.

  • Maintain high standards of cleanliness throughout operational areas.

  • Report maintenance issues, hazards and incidents promptly.

  • Work closely with the Stock Controller, Hub Leaders and management team to ensure operational requirements are met.

  • Support colleagues across the department where required.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and operational issues promptly.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience working within hospitality, catering, logistics, warehouse or customer-facing environments.

  • Flexible approach to working hours, including evenings, weekends and matchdays.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently and use initiative.

  • Previous experience within logistics, cellar operations or stock control. (Desirable)

  • Experience working in a stadium, arena or large-scale event environment. (Desirable)

  • Experience handling food and beverage stock. (Desirable)

  • Level 2 Food Safety Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Manual Handling Certificate. (Desirable)

  • Counterbalance Forklift Licence. (Desirable)

  • Personal Licence Holder. (Desirable)

  • First Aid qualification. (Desirable)

Acting as the main point of contact within their area, the Hub Leader is responsible for ensuring excellent guest service, accurate stock control and that all team members operate in accordance with Club standards and legal requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the full operation of a designated concession or bar unit from set-up to close-down.

  • Attend pre-match/pre-event briefings and prepare the unit for service.

  • Complete close-down duties and support final counts and cleaning.

  • Liaise with the Concessions Supervisor and management team to ensure the smooth operation of the area.

  • Deliver exceptional service to supporters and guests, including dealing with customer complaints and resolving issues in a professional manner.

  • Promote product knowledge and upselling opportunities.

  • Ensure accurate counting and control of food, beverages and disposables.

  • Ensure stock is handled securely and replenished accurately throughout service.

  • Monitor stock usage during the event and communicate shortages proactively.

  • Record wastage, transfers and returns in accordance with training.

  • Maintain regular communication with the Concessions Supervisor and management team.

  • Communicate shortages, equipment failures and maintenance issues promptly.

  • Escalate concerns proactively to minimise disruption to service.

  • Lead by example while supporting, motivating, and developing team members.

  • Ensure key information is effectively communicated to team members.

  • Ensure food safety, hygiene and operational standards are maintained at all times.

  • Ensure all required documentation is completed accurately and on time.

  • Ensure licensing regulations are followed, with particular attention to Challenge 25 and protecting children from harm.

  • Monitor the correct use of PPE, handwashing and food handling procedures.

  • Ensure products are served to agreed specifications and brand standards.

  • Support stock accuracy and waste reduction initiatives.

  • Complete all paperwork accurately and within required timescales.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in hospitality, retail, catering, or other fast-paced customer-facing environments.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to work independently, use initiative, and remain calm under pressure.

  • Previous team leader or supervisory experience.

  • Experience with EPOS systems, cash handling, and stock control.

  • Availability to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Personal Licence Holder (desirable)

  • Reliable, responsible, and professional, consistently leading by example.

  • Positive and supportive, with the ability to motivate others and remain calm under pressure.

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Lead Academy Performance Nutritionist
job.location: Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Academy Training Ground, BR3 1NZ

Contract type: Full-time

Deadline:            13th October 2026

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Working at our Copers Cope Academy training ground, you will be a collaborative and pragmatic practitioner looking to deliver a periodised, performance-focused, evidence-based and data-driven nutrition programme. You will design and deliver engaging, age-appropriate education strategies for players, staff, parents and host families that translate nutrition knowledge into sustainable behaviours. You will create systems to measure, monitor, interpret and share body composition data, while maintaining accurate records of consultations, interventions and outcomes. You will build strong interdepartmental relationships with the culinary team to create inventive, nutritionally rich and varied menus, and with the wider MDT to align messaging, educate coaching staff and integrate nutrition into rehabilitation, to support player development. You will lead the nutrition function, managing the working budget and providing oversight and development to our studentship programme, delivering nutritional support across our long-term player development pathway from U9–U21.

Responsibilities:

  • To lead the Academy nutrition function, working collaboratively with the Head of Sports Science and Medicine and wider Multi-Disciplinary Team (MDT) to deliver a high-quality, evidence-based nutrition service across the Academy pathway (U9–U21).

  • To develop, implement and continuously evaluate a periodised nutrition programme that supports player development, health and performance across training, matchday, travel and rehabilitation environments, including fuelling, hydration, recovery and supplementation.

  • To provide individualised, age-appropriate and athlete-centred nutritional support to Academy players, with particular consideration to growth and maturation, energy availability, bone health, recovery and the nutritional demands of developing athletes.

  • To design and deliver engaging nutrition education for players, coaches, staff, parents and host families, translating nutrition knowledge into practical and sustainable behaviours and building strong, trusting relationships with players and their support networks.

  • To work collaboratively with Performance, Medical, Strength and Conditioning and Coaching staff to integrate nutrition into wider MDT performance systems, including player development, injury rehabilitation and return to performance.

  • To lead the development and implementation of systems to measure, monitor and interpret body composition and other relevant athlete data, using appropriate data visualisation and reporting to inform interventions and objectively evaluate their impact on player development, health and performance.

  • To maintain accurate and comprehensive records of consultations, interventions, body composition assessments, outcomes and relevant athlete data, ensuring appropriate confidentiality, governance and professional standards are maintained.

  • To work closely with the Academy culinary and catering teams to develop inventive, nutritionally rich and varied menus, translating nutritional requirements into practical food provision and daily player behaviours.

  • To lead and manage the Academy nutrition working budget and provide oversight, support and development to the Academy studentship programme.

  • To contribute to player, parent, host family and coach education, as well as the continuing professional development of Sports Science and Medicine staff, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the current evidence base and best practice in sports nutrition.

  • To support and contribute to relevant research, audit and quality improvement projects across the Academy, ensuring practice continues to develop in line with current evidence and relevant Premier League / EPPP requirements.

  • All employees may be required to undertake any other duties as may be reasonably requested, together with other duties and responsibilities as required by the line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager.

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.


Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

  • MSc or equivalent qualification in Sports Nutrition or a related discipline.

  • SENR accredited.

  • Minimum ISAK Level 1 qualification.

  • Demonstrable experience working within an elite sporting environment, ideally within professional football, with experience supporting the long-term development, health and performance of young athletes.

  • Demonstrable experience supporting young athletes through growth and maturation, with a strong understanding of energy availability, bone health, recovery and the nutritional demands of developing athletes.

  • Experience using body composition and athlete data to inform individualised interventions and evaluate outcomes.

  • Experience applying performance nutrition strategies across training, matchday, travel and rehabilitation environments, including fuelling, hydration, recovery and supplementation.

  • Experience working collaboratively with catering teams to translate nutritional requirements into practical food provision would be advantageous.

  • Demonstrable up-to-date knowledge of the current evidence base and the ability to translate this into practical, athlete-centred practice.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to educate, advise and motivate young athletes, parents, coaches and staff.

  • Strong interpersonal, organisational and leadership skills, with the ability to build effective relationships, manage competing priorities, take ownership of interventions and work collaboratively within a high-performance MDT.

  • Confident, self-motivated and able to work effectively under pressure, with a commitment to continuous professional development and high standards of professional practice.

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.

job.title: Social Media Manager
job.location: Selhurst Park Stadium, London, London, SE25 6PU, GB | Copers Cope Road, Beckenham, London, BR3 1NZ, GB | London, London, W1F 9SJ, GB
job.html_description:
Job Location:      Selhurst Park Stadium, SE25 6PU

Contract Type:   Full-time

Who we are:

We are Crystal Palace Football Club, a Premier League Football Club with more than 160 years of proud history. Spread across three different sites - brand new main offices at Selhurst Park Stadium, our London office, and our Training Ground/Academy, we offer the best atmosphere and culture for our fans and our employees. 


We strive for excellence in the workplace with a philosophy of high standards, professionalism, and a strong work ethic from our employees. We are constantly trying to grow, diversify and build with not only our team on the pitch, but also our team in the offices and on the ground.

About this role:

Crystal Palace Football Club is seeking a creative, multi-skilled and well organised Social Media Manager to undertake a key role in the club’s marketing team. The successful candidate will be charged with leading the club’s social media to engage the club’s existing and growing global fan base, whilst managing a team across @cpfc, @cpfc_w, and @CPFCAcademy channels. The role will also be expected to travel to Premier League, Cup, and European matches home and away in line with a staffing rota that they will manage.

On top of leading the club’s Social Media strategy, the Social Media Manager will be responsible for overseeing and delivering day-to-day publishing across all core channels (X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Whatsapp) for Men’s, Women’s and Academy teams, as well as maintaining an annual social calendar of key dates / events. Every day, they will conceive, pitch and create innovative content ideas in conjunction with the club’s editorial, video production and graphics team to deliver interesting, accurate, shareable and high-quality club output, with a strong focus on vertical content. The role will be at the heart of creative content but is also responsible for planning and scheduling posts on a day-to-day basis.

As a member of the marketing department, they will also be charged with inputting into and delivering effective revenue generating campaigns for club departments (Retail, Ticketing, Commercial Partnerships, Premium Hospitality etc).

As well as directly managing two executives, the role will also include the management of a pool of freelancer creators and be a key point of liaison for external creators and distributors both in football and the wider cultural social media space.

We operate as a small team – and the successful candidate will be expected to maintain a ‘can-do’ positive attitude, be flexible to changing demands in a fast-paced environment and have outstanding people skills. They will be proactive, inquisitive, organised and obsessed with all things digital - and of course, Premier League football.

Responsibilities:

  • Managing and developing the club’s social media strategy.

  • Day-to-day management of all CPFC social media platforms, delivering daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal posts and campaigns.

  • Travel to Premier League, Cup, and European matches home and away in rotation with the wider social media team

  • Devising and delivering content ideas & campaigns from ideation.

  • Build and maintain positive working relationships with key stakeholders across the club and externally.

  • Being the guardian of the club’s tone of voice on social media platforms.

  • Supporting commercial partners and club departments in creating / optimising campaigns through social media.

  • Demonstrating excellent, true ‘fan engagement’ and two-way communication with supporters.

  • Ownership of platform & content analytics to optimise output; reporting on reach, engagement, referral and growth metrics.

  • Play leading role in video shoots for key launches, for example kit launches, and player transfers.

  • Other duties and responsibilities as required by line manager

  • Upholding and promoting the Club’s policies and procedures, including Health and Safety, Safeguarding and Equal Opportunities policies and procedures.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications:

You will have…

Essential

  • Minimum four years’ experience in a professional sports environment

  • Experience running similar sized social media accounts and be able to share demonstrable results in audience growth, content innovation, driving referral traffic, and shaping and delivering a social media strategy.

  • Attention to detail, with outstanding written communication skills

  • Proficient in video / image production and use of Premiere Pro, as well as photoshop

  • A strong understanding - and passion for – Premier League and European football

Highly Desirable

  • Experience working with talent

  • Experience working with commercial partners on activating branded campaigns

  • In-depth knowledge of Crystal Palace Football Club

You are…

  • Someone who lives and breathes social media, with strong views as to what represents content and community management.

  • Someone who doesn’t simply post and move onto the next thing - we're looking for someone who wants to engage with the fan base, adding layers and depth to each post – to further enrich the fans consumption of our content.

  • Someone who understands the importance of tone of voice and organisational values – but also someone who isn’t afraid to test and learn.

  • A creative, confident, passionate individual – a storyteller, with an eye for detail.

  • Someone who understands the demands of working for a football club and is willing to work out-of-hours and weekends

  • Someone who is willing to be flexible and work to tight deadlines

Benefits:

  • Complimentary match day ticket

  • Reward and Discount Scheme through our Tech Scheme and Simple Health app

  • Health and Wellbeing benefit scheme

  • 20% Discount in our Retail Stores

  • Discounts in various gyms through GymFlex

  • Volunteering Day - 1 Workday off to support a charity of your choice.

  • Travel Season Ticket loan

  • Holiday allowance: 25 Days 

Our commitment to Equality

At Crystal Palace Football Club, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion is spirited and continues to grow due to the working environment, which makes all staff feel appreciated and welcomed. Crystal Palace Football Club do this by encouraging good relations and practices towards different groups and are committed to promoting employment opportunities that celebrate diversity.

We are committed to attracting, recruiting, and retaining the most talented candidates and the club intends to ensure that everyone who wishes to engage with the club, whether as matchday fans, staff, players, board members, participants in Foundation programmes and any other person engaged with the club's activities, has a real and equal opportunity to do so.


Reasonable Adjustment

We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. We guarantee an interview to all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role, ensuring equitable opportunities for everyone.

If you require disability-related adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact DLO@cpfc.co.uk (DLO inbox is for disability-related queries only, if you wish to gain further information regarding this vacancy, please contact cpfc.recruitment@cpfc.co.uk). We are here to help you through the whole recruitment process including trying to apply for a vacancy, getting in touch with us through the process, and/or helping with access in case you are required to come in for an interview.


Safeguarding

Crystal Palace Football Club is committed to safeguarding and ensuring the welfare and protection of children and vulnerable people and expects all staff to share this commitment. As such, the post holder will be required to undergo any relevant security checks, including a comprehensive background check, Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) to ensure the safety and protection of children and vulnerable individuals.
