job.title: Functional Signage & Commodities Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Functional Signage & Commodities Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. 
The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Functional Signage & Commodities Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. 
This position is responsible for overseeing the collation and delivery of all functional signage and standard dressing commodity requirements across all official sites at the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.  

Functional Signage (alternatively known as functional area signage or FA Signage) refers to the signage that individual departments within FIFA27 require to ensure their spaces and facilities can function as required for the event.  The signage can be used to designate rooms and spaces, as well as display operational necessary information and will be utilized at all official sites at FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™. These signs can come in a variety of sizes and can be wall mounted or freestanding.  These signs are fundamental to the smooth operation of the events and the requirements are collated in collaboration with the functional areas that are responsible for the room, area or space. Functional signage may also include some handheld ‘lollipop’ signage, venue maps, seat designation and functional area specific information such as QR codes. 
 
Dressing Commodities (sometimes referred to as ‘Kit of Parts’ or ‘KOP” items) are standard dressing items that can be ordered by functional areas in order to support the delivery of their function or to enhance the look of a space they are responsible for. Dressing examples include, but are not exclusive to: freestanding backdrops, event branded table skirts and cloths, flags and banners which may also contain functional information.  In addition, custom, non-KOP treatments may also be ordered if deemed necessary and within agreed service level limits. 

They will work with multiple functional areas across the FIFA27 and associated teams to successfully record all of their functional signage requirements; work with the language services team to ensure that all Functional Signage is translated to the necessary languages; work with the design team to ensure all functional signage and dressing commodities  are designed and artworked to be consistent with the Signage Kit of Parts; and work with the appointed signage suppliers to ensure that all requirements are produced and delivered to all FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ official sites in a timely manner and to agreed deadlines. 
The role requires a high attention to detail and would suit a tenacious individual who enjoys working in close collaboration with people from across the organization. The role is heavily weighed towards data collation and would suit a candidate from a project-based background, with no specific requirement for this to be within events or signage - although such experience or skills would be advantageous.

Key Responsibilities 
  • Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. 
  • Collating all FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional signage and dressing commodity requirements in collaboration with the functional areas from across the organization. Acting as the focal point for the functional areas on all requests. 
  • Managing the functional signage and dressing commodity requirements content management system and ensuring all information provided is consistent and correct. 
  • Liaison with appointed suppliers to ensure FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ meet all production deadlines for functional signage and dressing commodities. 
  • Ensuring the appointed suppliers deliver, and where necessary install all functional signage and dressing commodities as per the requested timelines. 
  • Quality control of printed products to ensure they are meeting the agreed standards. 
  • Acting as the point of contact for all Dressing and Signage team members with regards to their functional area commodity and signage questions. 
  • Liaison with Language Services Department to add items to the glossary as per the requests from the functional areas. Terms will be received in English and translated to Portuguese (Brazilian). 
  • Proofing of functional signage artwork including checking wording matches that in the glossary in the required languages. 
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of functional signage and dressing commodities operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.  
  • Contributing to Dressing and Signage team meetings as and when required. 
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.  
  • Strong experience in a project or data management role, ideally with tangible experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. 
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations. 
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.  
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. 
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. 
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. 
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. 
  •  The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. 
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Talent Pool – People with Disabilities | 8 Host Cities
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) which will be hosted for the first time ever in South America, Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

This is an exclusive talent pool initiative for people with disabilities, as part of our commitment to inclusive hiring.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible working environment. As part of this commitment, we are launching an affirmative hiring initiative exclusively for people with disabilities to build a talent pool of professionals interested in contributing to the delivery of one of the world’s largest sporting events.

This initiative aims to connect talented individuals with potential opportunities across different divisions and functional areas of the tournament. We welcome candidates with a range of professional backgrounds, skills, and experiences, including those looking to apply their transferable skills in a new environment.

Candidates may be considered for future opportunities based on their qualifications, experience, skills, interests, preferred location, and the specific requirements of each position.

We are committed to an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Reasonable accommodations can be requested at any stage of the process.

Administration 
  • Anti Doping
  • Event Controlling
  • Sustainability & Human Rights
  • Volunteer Management
  • Workforce Management
Operations
  • Access Management
  • Accreditation
  • Catering
  • Cleaning & Waste Management
  • Competition Management
  • Dressing & Signage
  • Engineering
  • Event Logistics
  • Event Transport
  • Fan Services
  • Guest Operations
  • Host Broadcast Production
  • Media Operations & Services
  • Medical
  • Overlay
  • Referee Services
  • Safety & Security
  • Stadium Entertainment
  • Team Services
  • Technology
Revenues & Marketing 
  • Event Marketing
  • Hospitality
  • Partner Rights Delivery
  • Partnership Management
Experience & Skills
  • Education and/or professional experience relevant to the area of interest. Previous experience in events, sports, hospitality, logistics, customer service, administration, or related fields may be an advantage, depending on the position.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders from diverse backgrounds.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving, adaptability, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and multicultural environment.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion, where relevant to the position.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese.
  • English proficiency may be required for some opportunities. 
  • Familiarity with MS Office tools, such as Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, may be desirable for certain positions.
Location & Availability
  • Potential opportunities may be available across the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 host cities, including Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Belo Horizonte, Salvador, Recife, Fortaleza, Brasília, and Porto Alegre. 
  • Work arrangements, contract duration, start dates, and availability requirements will depend on the specific position and operational needs of the tournament and venues.

FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is a proud equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and prohibits discrimination of any kind on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We encourage candidates to share any accessibility requirements they would like us to consider during the process. Requests will be handled with care and discretion.

job.title: Venue Telecom Manager – 8 Host Cities
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. 

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Venue Telecom Manager (VTCM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The VTCM will work closely with the Technology teams in all the stadiums and IBCC and Zurich, as well as other stakeholders, to deliver critical Network and telecommunications solutions for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non-competition venues, including:
    o   Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN)
    o   Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment)
    o   Internet, VLAN, VPN services
    o   Mobile Network and Private 5G
    o   Push-to-Talk/Private Mobile Radios
    o   Spectrum Management
    o   CATV/IPTV
    o   Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs)
  • Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues.
  • Stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment.
  • Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Coordinate on-site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations.
  • Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC).
  • Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post-event analysis.
  • Participate in pre-tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.
Education
  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field.
Experience
  • Relevant IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events.
  • Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including IPTV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas.
  • Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred

Ideal skills 
  • Manager with experience in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events 
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, IPTV, radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. 
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. 
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones  
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members 
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance  
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or willing to relocate.

- Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of telecommunications infrastructure and services across competition and non-competition venues, including: o Broadcast Contribution Network (BCN) o Event Network (WAN, MAN, LAN, WLAN, cabling, containment) o Internet, VLAN, VPN services o Mobile Network and Private 5G o Push-to-Talk/Private Mobile Radios o Spectrum Management o CATV/IPTV o Rate Card services (Internet/IP Codecs) - Deploy and oversee technology services across various venues. - Stadia, training sites, operation centers, accreditation centers, ticketing centers, hotels, airports, and transport hubs. - Ensure compliance with FIFA standards in the integration of tournament technology services, such as Accreditation and Ticketing, with the FIFA Event Network environment. - Collaborate with Football Technology Innovation suppliers, media, broadcasters, and other functional stakeholders to define and fulfill network and cybersecurity requirements. - Coordinate on-site IT and telecom technical teams for infrastructure testing, acceptance, and operations. - Manage incident resolution and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs), escalating risks and issues to the Technology Command Center (TCC). - Support spectrum management efforts, including interference resolution in collaboration with regulatory authorities and venue teams. - Ensure timely and accurate reporting, including daily updates to the TCC and post-event analysis. - Participate in pre-tournament training, readiness exercises, and rehearsals.
Education
- University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field.
Experience
- Relevant IT/Technology experience, preferably in major events. - Strong knowledge of IT and telecommunications technologies, including IPTV, AV systems, radio communications, VLANs and related areas. - Experience coordinating with diverse teams and managing vendor relationships. - Strong project management and organizational skills. - Detail-oriented and process-driven with the ability to manage competing priorities. - Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills. - Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
Ideal skills
- Manager with experience in similar projects - Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events - Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, IPTV, radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. - Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. - Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones - Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members - Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation - Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills - Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge - Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance - Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments
Requirements
- Right to work in Brazil - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or willing to relocate.

job.title: Law Clerk Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:

  • A role within the commercial legal team, which supports the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global commercial operations.
  • Assist the commercial legal team in advising the various FIFA business functions in their everyday operations.
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities, including FIFA’s sports marketing, licensing, agency appointments and media promotions.
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP and technology agreements.
  • Assist in providing legal support related to social media and digital content related matters.
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities.
  • Supporting the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA+ and FIFA’s other digital channels.
  • Assist in providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities.
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements.
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice.
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes.
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Structured, reliable, well-organized with a strong eye for detail.
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions.
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility with an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects.
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities.
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills.
  • High degree of professionalism and confident demeanor.
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior legal counsels as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone.
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist the organization and internal clients.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from a top tier accredited US law school.
  • Active US bar membership is required.
  • 2-3 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on media, rights, sports or IP matters.
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice.
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish) is an asset but not required.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Excel.
  • Comfortable with international travel.
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Logistics Coordinator
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  •  Performing hands-on day-to-day warehouse operations, including receiving and unloading deliveries, checking materials, put-away, storage, picking, packing, labelling, kitting, dispatch and processing returns. 
  • Physically preparing, packing and moving materials for internal customers, FIFA events and shipments, including assembling orders and ensuring goods are ready on time and in the required condition.
  • Coordinating and processing warehouse orders and distribution activities, while acting as back-up for internal mail distribution. 
  • Conducting regular stock checks and supporting inventory counts, discrepancy resolution and the accurate recording of goods movements. 
  • Maintaining and further developing the internal warehouse system to ensure accurate inventory records and efficient stock management.
  • Supporting demand planning and stock flow in collaboration with internal stakeholders to ensure the timely availability and efficient management of inventory and materials.
  • Organizing and coordinating domestic and international shipments, including air freight, courier services, customs clearance and the preparation of relevant shipping documentation, in collaboration with logistics service providers. 
  • Supporting logistics operations on-site at FIFA events worldwide, including the preparation, delivery, set-up, replenishment and return of event materials.
  • Ensuring that warehouse activities are carried out safely, securely and in accordance with applicable procedures, service standards and handling requirements.
  • Advising and supporting internal stakeholders on international logistics, warehouse, distribution and shipping-related projects.
  • Developing and maintaining relationships with suppliers, service providers and internal customers, including supporting commercial negotiations. 
  • Managing logistics-related supplier invoices, including verifying charges against orders and services, ensuring correct cost allocation and approvals, tracking payment status and resolving discrepancies with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Supporting the preparation of tender documents, evaluation of offers and management of contracts with logistics service providers.
  • Developing and continuously improving logistics concepts, procedures, processes and service levels, while identifying and implementing opportunities to optimize costs and distribution services.
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in logistics, preferably combined with a strong administrative background.
  • Experience in warehouse operations, distribution, international shipping or related logistics activities is an advantage.
  • Experience in the sports or events industry is an advantage.
  •  Completed commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification, preferably in the field of logistics.
  • Further education or professional qualification in logistics, supply chain management or a related field is an advantage.
  •  Broad knowledge of logistics, with a strong understanding of warehouse and distribution operations. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage and coordinate multiple tasks and priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly identify issues and implement practical solutions.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Ability to work under pressure while maintaining accuracy and efficiency. 
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills with a customer and service-oriented mindset.
  • Fluent in English and good command of German, both written and spoken.
    Additional languages, particularly French or Spanish, are an asset.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
  • Good knowledge of warehouse and logistics systems.
  • Driving license required.
  • Readiness for stand-by duties
  •  This role requires regular on-site presence at our office. 
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.
#Jointheteam

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Senior Manager and the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Manager, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.  

This role will be responsible for the implementation and management of the customer care strategies and processes for General Public Customers, ensuring compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. The Customer Care Coordinator focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 with a special focus on international clients. FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.   

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  •  Implement and effectively coordinate the customer care strategies and processes across all the communications channels established, including but not limited to the contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.      
  •  Support the Customer Care Manager in managing the customer care team and the potential outsourced customer care and call center service providers for the implementation and effective delivery of the services, ensuring a proper setup of all the services required.      
  •  Support the Customer Care Manager in ensuring proper training of all the customer care staff members and the call center teams, according to the sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations;   
  •  Perform customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) whenever required;   
  •   Apply the escalation processes and ensure his proper implementation by the different teams;       
  •  Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible;       
  •  Support the proper implementation of effective processes and strategies for automated and manual case management using the respective CRM systems;    
  •  Actively search and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of customer care and call center agents, and maximize customer information and satisfaction;   
  •  Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks, and implement processes to mitigate them;      
  • Ensure that all the Customer Care processes are in compliance with the different FIFA functional areas requirements, including but not limited to Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.  
  •  Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems;    
  •  Manage and train a small team in charge of performing quality assurance checks. 
  •  Ensure an efficient administration and archive of all versions of customer care and call center knowledge base, in all languages.   
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Minimum three years experience in leading large teams, including in-house staff and external service providers, with international and different cultural backgrounds under the same goal. 
 
  • Minimum two years experience in leading Ticketing Customer Care teams on major international sports events, including recruitment, training, and the delivery of the project. 
 
  • Planning, managing, and conducting ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects, experience in International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups.    
 
  • Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or Sport Events. 
 
  • Experience in similar role during previous FIFA World Cups. 
 
  • Team-leading skills, able to lead multicultural teams.   
 
  • Communication and problem-solving skills.   
 
 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
 
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.    
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Travel Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Travel Manager leads end-to-end travel operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including flights, accommodation and ground transportation.

The role requires hands-on experience with bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, availability checks and fare rules, as well as coordinating complex group travel for major events.

Working closely with FIFA teams, airlines, suppliers and other stakeholders, the Travel Manager must combine strong operational knowledge with flexibility, empathy and a genuine service mindset.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage flight and hotel bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, cancellations and refunds using Amadeus.
  • Apply airline fare rules, ticketing conditions, deadlines, penalties and baggage policies.
  • Coordinate travel for groups of over 100 people, including flights, accommodation, visas, ground transportation and itineraries.
  • Build strong relationships with airlines, hotels, travel agencies and transportation providers.
  • Negotiate rates, booking conditions and operational solutions while monitoring budgets and costs.
  • Support travellers during schedule changes, disruptions, emergencies and other unexpected situations.
  • Develop contingency plans and make quick, practical decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Maintain accurate travel data, reports, passenger lists and operational documentation.
  • Coordinate travel requirements across multiple cities and client groups, including teams, delegations, guests, VIPs and workforce.
  • Provide responsive, patient and solution-oriented service throughout the travel journey.
  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risks
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control
  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management
  • Strong experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation) 
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules 
  •  Relevant experience in project and event management

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Travel Manager leads end-to-end travel operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including flights, accommodation and ground transportation.
The role requires hands-on experience with bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, availability checks and fare rules, as well as coordinating complex group travel for major events.
Working closely with FIFA teams, airlines, suppliers and other stakeholders, the Travel Manager must combine strong operational knowledge with flexibility, empathy and a genuine service mindset.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Manage flight and hotel bookings, quotations, ticket issuance, reissuance, cancellations and refunds using Amadeus. - Apply airline fare rules, ticketing conditions, deadlines, penalties and baggage policies. - Coordinate travel for groups of over 100 people, including flights, accommodation, visas, ground transportation and itineraries. - Build strong relationships with airlines, hotels, travel agencies and transportation providers. - Negotiate rates, booking conditions and operational solutions while monitoring budgets and costs. - Support travellers during schedule changes, disruptions, emergencies and other unexpected situations. - Develop contingency plans and make quick, practical decisions in high-pressure situations. - Maintain accurate travel data, reports, passenger lists and operational documentation. - Coordinate travel requirements across multiple cities and client groups, including teams, delegations, guests, VIPs and workforce. - Provide responsive, patient and solution-oriented service throughout the travel journey. - Development of contingency plans for high level client groups - Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risks - Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control - Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership - Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness - Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments
YOUR PROFILE
- Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. - Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) - Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry - Further education in tourism, event or general management - Strong experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation) - Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules - Relevant experience in project and event management

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Support the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Coordinate and execute workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to support an integrated planning process, ensuring resources align with operational needs and service levels
• Assist in defining workforce categories and supporting the development of entitlements for each group
• Maintain and update the centralised headcount plan, ensuring data accuracy and accessibility
• Support change management activities to enable continuity in workforce planning and execution
• Contribute inputs to workforce budgets, timelines, and planning cycles

Workforce Operations & Management
• Help develop and execute operational plans for workforce delivery during tournament time, including supporting site operations
• Assist in defining requirements for physical spaces, overlay, technology, and other workforce-related needs on site
• Develop workforce policies & procedures with key operational stakeholders (transport, accommodation, catering etc.) and core central business areas such as HR, technology, finance. 
• Define and map out key workforce planning & operational processes, understanding the cross-functional collaboration required.
• Support the coordination of business processes and system requirements for workforce operations tools
• Deliver role-specific and venue-specific training for workforce operations teams
• Support the day-to-day supervision, scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including workforce and volunteers
• Provide operational support to venue managers during event delivery

  • Work Experience
    • Experience in workforce planning or operations, ideally within international events and/or the sports industry
    • Good working knowledge of workforce planning systems, tools, and practices
    • Experience supporting or coordinating operational venue teams at large-scale events
    • Understanding of data-driven decision-making and workforce planning processes in complex environments
    • Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritise tasks effectively, and work with a level of independence
    • Experience supervising team members and contributing to team performance through positive leadership and collaboration
    • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability, with experience supporting discussions, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination
    • Experience working in a multicultural and/or multinational environment
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken  
    • Fluent/Advanced Portuguese

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Legal Counsel Commercial Legal
job.html_description:
We govern the beautiful game and ensure it's run with transparency and integrity.

Join our team in Miami and support us on our mission.
The Legal Counsel will be an active member of the Commercial Legal Team working with various Senior Legal Counsels, the Head of Content & Media and the Director of Commercial Legal to
support the delivery of legal services relating to FIFA’s global operations.

The role of Legal Counsel will support some, or all, of the business functions within FIFA’s global operations, such as the following:

  • Assisting the commercial teams by advising on their everyday operations
  • Assisting in drafting, negotiating and advising on a broad range of commercial and media partnerships matters connected with FIFA’s revenue generating activities
  • Providing support regarding the interpretation of a range of media, rights, marketing, IP, retail and licensing, agency appointments, consumer promotions and technology agreements
  • Assisting in providing legal support related to Web3 activities, social media, digital content, gaming and e-sports related matters
  • Providing legal and contractual support to FIFA’s strategic and corporate development activities
  • Providing legal and contractual support on the exploitation of commercial opportunities on FIFA’s digital platforms
  • Supporting FIFA’s subsidiaries, including the FIFA Museum and the FIFA Foundation regarding the exploitation of commercial opportunities within FIFA’s commercial framework
  • Providing advice, guidance and support for all legal, regulatory and governance matters relating to FIFA’s commercial media activities
  • Providing legal support and counsel on development and production deal structures and documentation for internal and third-party projects, including advising on pre-production and coproduction deals
  • Assisting in managing, developing and maintaining FIFA's portfolio of non-live content related templates
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Technology team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Assisting and providing support for the FIFA Innovation team in support of the upcoming major FIFA tournaments worldwide
  • Providing legal support for music related matters (both live and recorded music)
  • Instructing and liaising with external counsel in connection with local law matters in various jurisdictions
  • Developing and maintaining FIFA’s template agreements
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

This role would suit someone with great communication skills who is a dedicated team player and excels in being professional with excellent legal skills.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Ability to participate and be part of a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • First class written and spoken English language skills, consistent with drafting and negotiating complex, high value and nuanced English language agreements
  • Ability to provide and communicate effectively practical and solutions-based legal advice
  • Excellent understanding of the sports marketing, sports merchandising, licensing, retail, digital marketing, sponsorship, licensing, e-commerce and business intelligence industry landscapes
  • Excellent negotiation, drafting, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Structured, reliable, with a strong eye for detail
  • Ability to perform consistently within a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, driving results, and ensuring the successful achievement of organizational goals
  • Strong commercial acumen with an ability to transfer legal knowledge into commercially and operationally oriented solutions
  • Proactive, with a strong sense of personal responsibility and an ability to work autonomously on a wide variety of projects
  • Resilient with an ability to competently handle a large workload amid rapidly shifting priorities
  • Open-minded team player with an affinity for working within a variety of cultures and excellent communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism and confidence
  • Ability to be a good ambassador for FIFA in all manner of external facing situations, including during contractual negotiations, external workshops and during FIFA competition-related assignments
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA senior management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts
  • Willingness to operate outside of comfort zone
  • Takes initiative to reflect on how to improve and develop working styles and methods to assist internal clients
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active bar membership is required
  • 4-6 years expertise in an in-house legal department or a top-tier law firm focusing on technology, media, sports or IP matters
  • Native level English (or equivalent), consistent with requirement to draft and negotiate complex and nuanced English language agreements and advice
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (French/Spanish/Portuguese) is an asset but not required
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook / Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Teams
  • Comfortable with international travel
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.
 
Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
 
Health insurance: We offer generous medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage.
Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
Retirement: We offer generous 401(k) employer contributions.
Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.

job.title: Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Senior Manager and the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Coordinator, the Ticketing General Public Customer Care Analyst will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will be responsible for the implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of the customer care strategies and processes for General Public Customers, ensuring compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. The Customer Care Analyst focuses particularly on the analysis and performance optimization of ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027, with a focus on both national and international clients. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the design and monitor the performance of customer care strategies and processes across all communication channels established (contact forms, call centers, chatbot, emails, etc.), flagging adjustments needed for consistency and effectiveness. 
  • Support the Customer Care Manager in overseeing outsourced customer care and call center service providers, monitoring service setups and delivery against agreed requirements and service levels. 
  • Support the design of training content and monitor training completion and effectiveness for customer care staff and call center teams, in line with the sales strategy and FIFA ticketing requirements and regulations. 
  • Review and validate customer care ticketing processes (back office and onsite) on a sample basis to ensure adherence to standards. 
  • Monitor adherence to escalation processes across teams and report on deviations for correction. 
  • Design and implement quality control procedures to detect deviations from requirements early and flag them for timely correction. 
  • Support the design, implementation and ongoing optimization of automated and manual case management processes within the CRM systems in use. 
  • Analyze customer care and call center performance data to identify opportunities to increase agent productivity and customer satisfaction, and support the implementation of resulting solutions. 
  • Proactively identify and report on patterns and risks, and support the design of processes to mitigate them. 
  • Monitor and report on Customer Care process compliance with FIFA functional area requirements (Legal, Sustainability, Data Protection, Finance, etc.), flagging gaps for resolution. 
  • Analyze and report regularly on KPIs and the effectiveness of customer care and call center services, using CRM and other systems. 
  • Coordinate the quality assurance checks performed across the customer care operation and consolidate findings into regular reporting. 
  • Maintain version control and archiving of the customer care and call center knowledge base, across all languages, ensuring accuracy and accessibility. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.   
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents. 
 
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.     

WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • Experience working within large, multicultural operational structures (in-house staff and external service providers), collaborating toward a shared operational goal. 
  •  Experience supporting Ticketing Customer Care operations on major international sports events, with exposure to recruitment, training and project delivery processes. 
  •  Experience planning, monitoring and analysing ticketing customer care strategies and processes for world-scale projects; prior exposure to International Sports Events, including previous FIFA World Cups, is an advantage. 
  •  Venue and onsite operations experience for ticketing and/or sport events. 
  •  Experience in an analytical or customer care operations role during previous FIFA World Cups or comparable major international sports events is advantageous. 
  •  Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively within multicultural teams. 
  •  Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
LANGUAGES

Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.

TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Monday) and planning software and online collaboration tools   
  •  CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases.

job.title: Project Manager for Medical Services
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Medical Services Manager is responsible for the administrative and project management backbone of the Medical Services area for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all medical workstreams progress on schedule, with documentation, processes, budget and procurement under control, allowing the medical leadership (Senior Medical Services Manager, General Medical Officer and Venue Medical Officers) to focus on clinical and operational delivery.

The position is the area’s integration point with FIFA27 corporate systems and processes (WeTrack, SharePoint, Monday.com, Workforce, Procurement, Finance) and the administrative point of contact for the Venue Medical Officers across the eight host cities: Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador and São Paulo.

The scope covers the full project cycle: planning and preparation, special events (Final Draw, Team Seminars, Play-off), site inspections, the tournament period and administrative close-out.

A healthcare background is not required. We are looking for a project management and administration profile from a major events environment, with strong command of processes, tools and organization.

Project Management & Area PMO

  •         Maintain the area master plan (Medical Operations Master Plan) up to date: schedule, milestones, dependencies and deliverables catalogue for all workstreams of the area
  •         Track the progress of each deliverable against FIFA milestones, flag deviations early and propose recovery plans
  •         Manage the area’s issues log, risk register and decision log, and drive the follow-up of actions through to closure
  •         Prepare the area’s periodic meetings (FIFA Medical, GMO, VMOs and functional areas): agenda, materials, minutes and action tracking
  •         Consolidate status reporting for the Senior Medical Services Manager, the GMO and FIFA governance structures


Processes, Systems & Document Governance

  •         Act as the area’s operational owner in WeTrack: plans, tasks, risks and milestones, ensuring the system reflects the actual project status
  •         Manage the area’s document library in SharePoint: folder structure, naming conventions, version control, approval workflow (Proposed, Consolidated, Endorsed) and confidentiality
  •         Ensure the official flow of deliverables: final version exported, published on SharePoint and reflected in WeTrack and Monday.com
  •         Complete and maintain FIFA corporate templates and forms (FAOP, VUM, Core Services, RFx, Workforce Plan) within cross-functional deadlines
  •         Standardise the area’s templates, checklists and operating procedures (inspections, activation flows, reports), aligned with the FIFA Medical Handbook
  •         Support the rollout and maintenance of the area’s digital tools (inspection app, control dashboards, daily reporting system)

Administration, Procurement & Budget

  •         Lead the administrative side of medical services procurement (RFI, RFP, quotations): timeline, supplier list, Q&A consolidation, comparison matrix and documentation for Procurement and Legal
  •         Monitor contracts with designated hospitals, ambulance providers, equipment and medical service suppliers: deadlines, deliverables, service measurement and invoicing
  •         Support the area’s budget control: quarterly forecast, actual versus plan, purchase requests and reconciliation with Finance
  •         Organize the administrative logistics of site inspections and travel (schedule, flights, accommodation, accreditation, reports)
  •         Support Workforce on the area’s processes: workforce plan, onboarding, accreditation, uniforms and mandatory training

Host City & VMO Support

  •         Act as the administrative point of contact for VMOs across the eight host cities and Team Base Camp cities: requests, deadlines, templates, system access and information
  •         Keep the Master Hospital Panel and the VMO matrix up to date (inventory, contacts, approval status, priority access pathways) with information provided by the host cities
  •         Coordinate the collection and consolidation of host city data (medical posts, opening hours, hotel and TBC addresses, emergency contacts)
  •         Organize the schedule and documentation of medical inspections at stadiums, TBCs, hotels and special event sites

Tournament Operations & Special Events

  •         Support the administrative preparation of special events (Final Draw, Team Seminars, Play-off) and of the tournament period: plans, rosters, materials, accreditation and communication
  •         During the tournament, run the area’s administrative cell at HQ: consolidation of daily venue reporting, roster and attendance control, incident logging and support to venue Medical Coordinators
  •         Coordinate the area’s administrative communication with functional areas (Safety & Security, Competition, Guest Operations, Technology, Workforce, Team Services)

Reporting, Close-out & Legacy

  •         Maintain the area’s dashboards and KPIs (status by workstream, inspections, open issues, procurement)
  •         Prepare reports, presentations and materials for meetings with FIFA Zurich and cross-functional areas, in the required template and language
  •         Lead the area’s administrative close-out: contract closure, document archiving, post-event report and lessons learned

Required

  •         Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Project Management, Economics or a related field
  •         Solid experience in project management, PMO or administrative coordination, ideally within major events, sport or multi-stakeholder projects
  •         Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and spoken); Spanish is an advantage
  •         Advanced Excel and MS Office skills (Word, PowerPoint, Project); experience with planning and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Monday.com, Teams, WeTrack or similar)
  •         Experience with procurement processes, budget control and contract management
  •         Experience with document governance: version control, approval workflows and executive reporting
  •         Availability for frequent domestic travel and flexible working hours during peak periods (special events and tournament)
Desirable

  •         Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 or equivalent)
  •         Previous experience in FIFA tournaments, Olympic events or other major international events
  •         Knowledge of the healthcare sector, medical services or hospital operations
  •         Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools
  •         Experience in multicultural environments and geographically distributed teams

Key Competencies

  •         Organization and method: structures processes, deadlines and documents so that anyone in the area can find what they need
  •         Autonomy and proactivity: anticipates open issues and risks, follows up with owners and proposes solutions without detailed instruction
  •         Executive communication: writes and presents clearly and concisely, in English and Portuguese, for technical and executive audiences
  •         Stakeholder management: builds relationships with VMOs, functional areas, suppliers and FIFA Zurich, aligning diverse interests
  •         Adaptability and resilience: responds well to shifting priorities, evolving plans and the pressure of event periods
  •         Attention to detail: ensures consistency of data, versions and deadlines across systems and documents
  •         Integrity and confidentiality: handles sensitive information and restricted-distribution documents with discretion

The Medical Services Manager is responsible for the administrative and project management backbone of the Medical Services area for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all medical workstreams progress on schedule, with documentation, processes, budget and procurement under control, allowing the medical leadership (Senior Medical Services Manager, General Medical Officer and Venue Medical Officers) to focus on clinical and operational delivery.
The position is the area’s integration point with FIFA27 corporate systems and processes (WeTrack, SharePoint, Monday.com, Workforce, Procurement, Finance) and the administrative point of contact for the Venue Medical Officers across the eight host cities: Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador and São Paulo.
The scope covers the full project cycle: planning and preparation, special events (Final Draw, Team Seminars, Play-off), site inspections, the tournament period and administrative close-out.

job.title: Volunteer System Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Volunteer Systems Manager, the Volunteer Systems Coordinator will actively participate in the design, development, and implementation of the Volunteer Management System for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The successful candidate must demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and a strong ability to solve complex problems, particularly in the context of volunteerism and database management systems. In addition to managing system integrations that are crucial for an efficient volunteer journey, the role requires collaboration across the Volunteer department to ensure that the technology platforms meet contractual requirements and support critical business processes effectively.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • Support the Volunteer Systems Manager in ensuring all technical requirements are captured, documented, and addressed within the Volunteer Management System.
  • Assist in defining and refining volunteer journey requirements across all modules of the volunteer management system, including Recruitment, Assignments, Scheduling, Rostering, Training, Accreditation and Uniform Distribution, and tournament Operations.
  • Support with the development and defining the integration matrix mapping necessary for all relevant systems, ensuring seamless connectivity and data flow across platforms.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of system training materials and assist with training sessions for system user.s. This involves prioritizing user requests, managing deadlines, and defining essential system reports to support operational needs.
  • Coordinate the development and delivery of the system to meet all required specifications. Provide ongoing problem resolution and support following the go-live date to ensure seamless system performance.
  • Contribute innovative ideas to improve and optimize system workflows.
  • Work in close collaboration with internal FIFA Functional Areas and Host Cities to help ensure the successful development, implementation and management of the Volunteer Management System.
  • Identify and report system-related issues and diligently follow up to ensure their resolution or escalate as necessary to mitigate potential impacts.
  • Support with planning and delivery for the Official Draw, Playoffs and other readiness workshops.
Responsibilities of the role will likely evolve during the lifespan of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, and the successful candidate should be supportive and flexible to additional requirements.
  • Strong experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Desired - Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field.
  • Efficient communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to follow governance processes, manage change requests, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Adaptable to work across multiple teams, locations, and time zones.
  • Ability to balance priorities whilst working in a fast-moving progressive environment.
  • Strong team player, adaptable to working under tight timelines, and ready to step in wherever needed to drive success, with a commitment to delivering results without compromising quality.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in using technology, including the Office 365 suite and industry-specific software.
  • Experienced in working with various Event Management Systems and/or Volunteer Management Systems.
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
