Maintain structured records of site authority responsibilities, agreed security measures, dependencies, outstanding actions and planning decisions. - Support coordination with relevant FIFA/FIFA27 functions and public security stakeholders on emergency arrangements, contingency requirements and other operational dependencies affecting NCS sites. - Support preparation of Safety & Security inputs into Site Operating Plans and other relevant site planning documents. - Support the NCS Manager in defining supplier requirements, staffing, operating hours, services and resources for contracted NCS security providers. - Maintain central supplier planning records, readiness trackers, resource information and supporting documentation, including mobilization status, outstanding actions and identified gaps. - Maintain and review supplier attendance, deployment and service-delivery evidence against approved staffing, operating hours, deployment plans and contractual requirements to support assurance and invoice verification. - Ensure that approved central requirements, plans, resource parameters and unresolved actions are accurately documented and transferred to VSSMs as planning transitions into decentralized delivery. - Support preparation of reports, presentations, briefings and management information for the Manager NCS and wider Safety & Security function. - Provide accurate resource, deployment and supplier delivery information to support NCS budget control, forecasting, invoice verification and contract administration by the Manager NCS.
Education
- Degree in security management, business administration, project management, event management or a related field desirable. - Relevant security, project coordination or administrative training is desirable.
Experience
- Strong experience in security planning, project coordination, operational administration or a comparable role. - Experience supporting multi-site operations or complex event planning desirable. - Experience preparing operational plans, deployment information or structured security documentation. - Experience working with private security suppliers or site operators desirable. - Experience maintaining resource, staffing or deployment records. - Major sporting event experience is desirable.
Skills & Competencies
- Strong planning and coordination skills. - Excellent attention to detail and document quality. - Strong organizational and administrative capability. - Ability to manage multiple site records and planning deadlines. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to identify planning gaps and escalate them appropriately. - Good analytical and numerical skills. - Advanced IT proficiency, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Certifications & Requirements
- Right to work in Brazil. - Fluent in English (spoken and written) - Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) - Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. - Willingness to travel nationally and work extended or irregular hours during tournament periods.

job.title: Training & Readiness Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Manager, Training & Readiness (Safety & Security) is responsible for designing, implementing and overseeing the tournament-wide capability-building, training and readiness programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role ensures that all safety and security personnel — including direct hires and supplier staff — meet defined competence, licensing and readiness standards prior to deployment.

The position establishes structured training frameworks, certification processes and exercise programmes to ensure operational preparedness across stadiums and non-competition sites. The role supports the creation of a sustainable safety and security legacy in Brazil through structured upskilling and professionalisation of the workforce.

• Conduct a comprehensive market capability and capacity analysis to identify gaps and risks related to the provision of staffed safety and security services
• Identify applicable qualification, certification and licensing criteria within Brazil and its federal states relevant to guarding, stewarding, close protection and related disciplines
• Design and implement a bespoke capability-building strategy for internal staff and external security suppliers
• Design and deliver security training programmes tailored to specific roles (e.g. security guards, stewards, supervisors, managers, TSLOs/RSLOs and direct hires)
• Develop and implement a structured training curriculum and training materials aligned with the Safety & Security Strategy and Operational Plan
• Design, develop and implement analogue and digital training solutions, including instructor-led programmes, workshops and e-learning packages, ensuring scalable, accessible and role-specific learning delivery across all safety and security personnel
• Define readiness criteria and certification processes for safety and security personnel prior to deployment
• Establish systems to track workforce competence, training completion and deployment readiness across all official tournament sites
• Coordinate and oversee joint exercises, table-top simulations, venue rehearsals and scenario-based drills to test operational response and inter-agency coordination
• Design and implement programmes to ensure compliance with statutory qualification and licensing standards on site, including the development of quality control audit processes
• Engage with safety and security suppliers to ensure that capability-building programmes are delivered effectively and that all personnel are trained before commencing work
• Coordinate with other FWWC2027 functional areas to ensure alignment on policies, procedures and response protocols
• Oversee the delivery and evaluation of drills, simulations and readiness exercises to ensure operational effectiveness
• Identify training gaps and implement corrective actions through continuous improvement processes
• Conduct on-site quality control audits to verify training completion, certification and operational competence
• Support senior management and site management in verifying training-related supplier invoices and compliance documentation

Education
• University degree in security management, education and training, public safety, risk management or a related field
• Professional training qualification or certification (e.g. instructional design, adult learning, security training accreditation) is desirable

Experience
• Experience in safety and security training, workforce readiness or operational preparedness roles
• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured training programmes in large-scale operational environments
• Experience coordinating exercises, simulations and multi-agency readiness activities
• Familiarity with Brazilian licensing and qualification requirements in the security sector
• Experience working with public security authorities and private security suppliers

Skills & Competencies
• Strong instructional design and training delivery capability
• Structured and analytical approach to readiness measurement and workforce tracking
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Ability to coordinate complex multi-stakeholder exercises and rehearsals
• Strong leadership and stakeholder engagement capability
• Clear written and verbal communication skills
• Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Certifications & Requirements:
• Right to work in Brazil. 
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)
• Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
• Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing CRM QA UAT Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager, the Ticketing CRM QA UAT Manager will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 

This role will be responsible for develop and implement QA/UAT strategies, user acceptance tests for all ticket sales, distribution and communication channels.  

Ticketing CRM QA UAT Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements. The role focuses particularly on the delivery of user acceptance tests to ensure an efficient ticketing operation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. 

Key Responsibilities 
   
  • Review and understand business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation related to the sales channels. 
 
  • Produce and implement test scripts, from a customer relationship perspective, to verify compliance of the systems with the ticket sales strategy and requirements. 

 

  • Develop and implement Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Test strategies, collaborate with stakeholders to define QA/UAT objectives, methodologies, and best practices; 

 

  • Plan and implement processes for the delivery of user acceptance tests for all ticket sales, distribution and communication channels, in pre-production and production environments, including but not limited to: online ticketing portals, mobile ticketing apps, back-office ticketing systems, bespoke CRM and Marketing Automation tools, general and single sign-on integration; 

 

  • Set the desired outcomes within test scripts, select and communicate with test participants and define testing and reporting timelines; 

 

  • Liaise with internal and external stakeholders for the communication of UAT results and management of fixes and change requests; 

 

  • Use issue tracking system to report on UAT results, support and change requests; 

 

  • Pro-actively identify and report on patterns and risks; 

 

  • Identify opportunities to improve development and testing processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and overall quality. 

 

  • Plan and implement quality control procedures to ensure that any deviation from the requirements is detected and corrected as soon as possible and that any system deviation from the requirements is detected as soon as possible, at all times during the ticketing process; 

 

  • Drive the implementation of test automation frameworks and tools to streamline testing processes and improve efficiency. Evaluate automation opportunities and prioritise test cases for automation to maximise productivity. 

 

  • Actively research and implement solutions to pro-actively increase the productivity of the sales channels team; 

SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • 3-5 years’ experience in: Quality Assurance and User Acceptance Test strategies 
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project 
  • Leading and managing small teams 
  • Delivery of user acceptance tests 
  • Experience in ticketing system 
  • Customer Service  
  • Excellent communication and relationship management 
  • Good numeracy 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation 
  • Accountability and Transparency 
  • Analysis and Innovation 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability 
  • Perseverance and Dedication 
  • Proactivity and Organisation 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools 
  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases 
  • JIRA 
  • Confluence 
 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Ticketing Training Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Ticketing Training Coordinator plays a key role in the preparation of all required training programmes for the Ticketing department prior to, and during, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. Reporting organizationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring tournament time Ticketing Workforce are effectively prepared to deliver in their role. 

The Ticketing Training Coordinator will be required to lead activities related to learning needs analysis, training design, training delivery, logistical planning and reporting.

Training is expected to be delivered across a variety of mediums including – e-learning, face to face, self study and additional knowledge base resources.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The key responsibilities and oversights of the Ticketing Training Coordinator include:   
  • Develop, design, and or adapt existing e-learning content using Rapid Authoring Tool(s) such as Adobe Captivate or similar. 
  • Collaborate with Ticketing Operations experts to gather information and ensure the accuracy of training modules. 
  • Support other Ticketing teams in their training planning in relation to the e-learning tool. 
  • Support Ticketing Operations teams in designing and delivering face to face training content and supporting resources. 
  • Integrate and manage e-learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS). 
  • Ensure all e-learning modules are accessible and user-friendly for a diverse audience. 
  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. 
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for e-learning modules and LMS issues.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of all training materials and development processes. 
  • Coordinate with the IT department to ensure seamless operation of e-learning platforms. 
  • Ensure compliance with organizational standards and industry regulations in all training content. 
  • Conduct regular reviews and updates of e-learning content to maintain relevance and effectiveness. 
  • Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in e-learning and instructional design. 
  • Support general ticketing operations for other FIFA events as required.
Education/ Experience 
  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education  
  • 1-3 years of professional experience 
  • Experience in training design and delivery
  • Experience in delivering e-learning as a training solution and managing LMS systems 
  • Highly accurate and detail-oriented working style, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player 
  • Native-level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued 
 Skills & Competencies 
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams) and online collaboration tools 
  • Proficient in e-learning Rapid Authoring Tools
  • Knowledge and understanding of Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Able to think creatively and ‘outside of the box’ to deliver solutions in a fast-faced- environment 
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities 
  • Skilled in facilitating collaboration between various business areas 
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones 
Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred

Ensures the integrity of accounting and prepares accurate and timely financial statements and documents, in line with local GAAP and IFRS. Responsible for month end close activities; responsible for performing balance sheet, revenue, expense, and payroll account reconciliations, as well as executing accounts payable and accounts receivable processes. Assists with external audit, budgets and special projects as needed. To manage, supervising and motivate a small team of Accountants and provide effective guidance and leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support function in Month End and Year End closing activities
  • Verifying and performing payments to suppliers & manage cashflow, and ensures all payments are properly approved prior payment.
  • To review transactions to assure accounting treatment is in accordance with IFRS and with internal accounting regulations
  • To review general ledger accounts and makes necessary journal entries including posting monthly, quarterly and yearly accruals.
  • To prepare and record Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Fixed Assets entries by compiling and analysing account information
  • To analyse and review company expenditures
  • Produce error-free accounting reports and present their results
  • Participate in financial standards setting and in forecast process
  • Assist with tax audits, and tax returns and consumption tax returns
  • Ensure compliance with IFRS and FIFA Accounting principles
  • To provide necessary support for internal customers and external auditors
  • To seek ways to improve upon accounting processes and procedures
  • To assist the Head of Finance and the management on special requests

  • Degree in Accounting or in Finance
  • Proven experience (4 years or more) as accounting supervisor and/or accountant 
  • Experience in an international environment 
  • Experience using/maintaining a financial ERP model (e.g. SAP)
  • Experience in Event Finance of advantage
  • Experience in procurement of advantage
  • Good communication skills
  • Very good sense for responsibility
  • Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast-paced and high-volume environment.
  • Focus on accuracy and timeliness, attention to detail
  • Confidentiality
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Customer Relationship Senior Manager the Ticketing Member Associations Customer Care Manager will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.  
This role will be responsible for planning and management of the customer care strategies and processes for Group Sales Customers to specifically fulfil all FIFA’s Member Associations ticketing requirements and ensure a smooth and successful ticketing operation for these key FIFA stakeholders. The Customer Care Manager must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements, policies and regulations whilst providing support to all Member Associations with ticketing issues and enquiries. The Customer Care Manager focuses particularly on the delivery of effective ticketing customer care for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing CRM Communication Channels Manager, the Ticketing CRM Communications Channels Coordinator will support Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. 


This role will be responsible for updating and managing text content, such as (but not limited to) FAQs, standard responses, and chatbot scripts, within our back-office tools.  Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist must ensure compliance with the applicable sales strategy and the FIFA ticketing requirements.  


The Ticketing Communication Channels Specialist focuses particularly on ensuring content accuracy, effectiveness, and alignment with sales communication strategies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.    


  • Maintain and update text-based content, including FAQs, chatbot scripts, and other sales communication materials, within back-office systems. 
 
  • Ensure all content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with company messaging and brand guidelines. 
 
  • Regularly review and update content based on CRM sub-teams feedback and business needs. 
 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales strategy and requirements, sales collaterals and communications, and customer care teams, to gather requirements concerning the content to be updated and respective timeline. 
 
  • Work closely with subject matter experts to ensure content accuracy and relevance. 
 
  • Coordinate content review and approval processes to ensure timely updates and deployments. 
 
  • Support the configuration and testing of FAQs, chatbot and other communication channels within back-office tools, flagging optimization opportunities to the relevant owners. 
 
  • Ensure that the communication channels accurately respond to user queries and provide relevant information or assistance. 
 
  • Monitor communication channel performance metrics and flag optimisation opportunities to improve user experience and engagement. 
 
  • Support training sessions for internal teams on using back-office tools and accessing sales communication content. 
 
  • Share observations and feedback on FAQs, chatbot and other communication channel performance to support best-practice recommendations for sales effectiveness. 
 
  • Conduct regular quality assurance checks on content and functionalities to identify and resolve content-level issues or errors. 
 
  • Identify and escalate technical issues related to the communication channels, collaborating with IT teams to support the implementation of solutions. 
 
  • Any other duties that may be assigned.

ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculate risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts.

INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent in relevant areas.      
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
  • 1-3 years’ experience in managing and updating content for various platforms 
  • Familiar with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms 
  • Familiar with HTML, CSS, and basic web development 
  • Experience in planning and delivery of a similar project 
  • Experience in Customer Service  
  • Excellent communication and relationship management 
  • Team player with excellent interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams 
  • Courtesy and Cooperation 
  • Accountability and Transparency 
  • Analysis and Innovation 
  • Flexibility and Adaptability 
  • Perseverance and Dedication 
  • Proactivity and Organisation 
  • Time Management and Prioritisation

Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written. 
Spanish and/or additional languages is highly advantageous.

  • CRM software for case management, including automatic and manual management of the cases

  • JIRA

job.title: LCC Planning Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
This role will be responsible for supporting the central logistical operations during the planning and delivery phases to provide a seamless logistics operation throughout the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Further, this role will support throughout the planning and delivery stages coordinating logistics activities across the end-to-end supply chain including customs, warehouse, distribution, materials and venue. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support Central Logistics operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including program management, development, implementation and support of Logistics Coordination Centre (LCC) 
  • Support with contract management of the Official Logistics Service Provider (LSP) and other Logistics equipment suppliers to ensure adherence to contractual KPIs and service levels 
  • Support on the overall planning, implementation, operational process across Central Logistics and LCC operations to achieve a seamless supply chain 
  • Coordinate with various stakeholders, including Host Cities, FIFA Client Groups, suppliers, and service providers, to capture requirements and align with logistics operations 
  • Assist with programme management of logistics teams (materials, venues, customs and freight forwarding, warehousing, PMA and distribution) to ensure alignment on logistics requirements, timelines, and expectations Assist with maintaining the Risks & Issues Register, aligning contingency plans to address unforeseen circumstances that may arise during the tournament 
  • Assist with drafting and tracking of policies and procedures 
  • Assist in analyzing supply chain data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for optimization, providing actionable insights to the Logistics team 
  • Generate regular and ad hoc reports on Logistics planning progress, budgets, and logistics to support management decisions, including daily/weekly logistics situational reporting 
  • Support with implementation of technological solutions and digital platforms to streamline logistical processes, enhance tracking, and improve real-time communication
  • Help create and maintain user guides, step-by-step instructions, and training materials for the Logistics team.
  • Contribute to the development of presentations and visual aids for stakeholder communication on Logistics planning processes and updates. 
  • Assist with monitoring and managing the Central Logistics budget  
  • Support in the organization of meetings with internal stakeholders to review logistics needs, address issues, and provide updates. 
  • Manage stakeholder logistics requests by facilitating logistics change requests communicating changes, and ensuring all updates are accurately tracked. 
  • Monitor logistics schedules, updating stakeholders on any reported delays or issues 
  • Be available to work shifts during tournament times, within the Logistics Coordination Centre as required. 
  • Document best practices and procedures to ensure clear tracking and transfer of knowledge.
  • Participate in outreach programs, as required, intended to educate stakeholders on tournament time operations.
  • Support on-ground logistics operations if required, possibly travelling to other locations.
  • Relevant experience of overall work. 
  • Experience in Events or Supply Chain is a plus. 
  • Strong customer service focus. 
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to make decisions independently and within a team environment. 
  • Extremely high attention to detail. 
  • Team player, comfortable in upward/downward communication and wanting to go the extra mile. 
  • Willing to work to complex, tight, immovable timelines while maintaining a positive attitude, exhibiting patience, persistence, and experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment. 
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Working alongside the FIFA Workforce Management team based in Zurich and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations is responsible for executing all workforce planning phases and processes, ensures the organisation has the right talent in the right roles at the right time.

Workforce Strategy & Planning
• Assist with the implementation of workforce planning and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
• Support the coordination of workforce planning activities across all workforce types (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees, etc.)
• Work with the Workforce Management team to help align workforce plans with operational requirements
• Provide administrative support in maintaining workforce categories and entitlements data
• Maintain and regularly update the centralised headcount tracker, ensuring accuracy of data
• Support change management activities by tracking updates and communicating changes to relevant stakeholders
• Assist in collecting and preparing inputs for workforce budgets, timelines, and planning activities

Workforce Operations & Management
• Support the delivery of operational workforce plans during tournament time, including assisting with site operations
• Help gather and document requirements for workforce spaces, equipment, and operational needs on site
• Support the documentation and maintenance of workforce policies, procedures, and operational guidelines
• Assist in mapping and documenting workforce planning and operational processes
• Provide administrative and coordination support for workforce systems and tools
• Support the delivery of workforce training sessions, including preparation of materials and logistics
• Assist with scheduling and coordination of workforce operations teams, including staff and volunteers
• Provide on-the-ground operational support to venue managers during event delivery
• Help communicate workforce processes and procedures to ensure consistency
• Track workforce service levels and support reporting on entitlements and delivery

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
• Liaise with cross-functional teams (e.g., Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to support workforce needs
• Maintain regular communication with functional areas to gather and update operational requirements
• Provide coordination support between workforce teams, HR, and other stakeholders

  • Work Experience
    • Ideally experience with exposure to workforce planning, operations, events, or a related field
    • Basic to intermediate understanding of workforce planning systems, tools, and processes
    • Experience supporting or assisting with operational teams, preferably in event or venue environments
    • General understanding of data and its use in workforce planning and decision-making
    • Ability to organise tasks, manage priorities, and work with guidance in a structured environment
    • Experience collaborating with team members and contributing to a positive team environment
    • Good communication skills, both written and verbal
    • Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to support problem-solving and coordination activities
    • Experience working in or interacting with multicultural and/or multinational environments is an advantage
    • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
    • Portuguese language skills (basic to advanced) are an advantage

  • Technology
    • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel) 
    • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
    • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

job.title: Institutional Relations Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Coordinator Institutional Relations supports the Senior Manager Stadiums by coordinating and integrating stadium-specific public security and institutional requirements into central FIFA27 planning. 

The role works closely with Stadium Authorities, public security agencies and relevant FIFA/FIFA27 functions to identify, consolidate and track requirements relating to operational space, staging, parking, logistics, accreditation, access, client groups and FIFA-funded or supported services. The Coordinator ensures that the stadium-specific implications of agreed public security arrangements are accurately reflected in Stadium Safety & Security Plans, Site Operating Plan inputs, drawings and other relevant planning documentation.

The role does not own strategic public security commitments and does not develop or command police operational plans. Public security authorities remain responsible for their own operations, while the Coordinator ensures that relevant stadium requirements, dependencies and implementation actions are appropriately incorporated into FIFA27 planning.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Support the Stadiums Manager in coordinating central institutional and public security interfaces across all tournament stadiums.
  • Identify, consolidate and track stadium-specific public security requirements relating to operational space, staging, parking, logistics, accreditation, access, command facilities, client groups and other relevant dependencies.
  • Ensure the stadium-specific implications of agreed public security arrangements are accurately reflected in Stadium Safety & Security Plans, Site Operating Plan inputs, stadium drawings, action trackers and other relevant planning documentation.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Transport, Accreditation & Access, Ticketing, Medical, Hospitality, Broadcast, Logistics, Workforce, Guest Operations and other relevant functions to resolve dependencies arising from public security requirements.
  • Coordinate with relevant functions on public security accreditation, pass requirements, operational access permissions and vehicle/VAPP requirements affecting stadium operations.
  • Support planning for FIFA-funded or FIFA-supported public security services, ensuring that scope, responsibilities, resource requirements and operational dependencies are clearly documented.
  • Identify and escalate budget, resource or contractual implications arising from public security requirements to the Senior Manager Stadiums.
  • Maintain an accurate central record of stadium-specific public security requirements, requests, decisions, responsibilities, outstanding actions and changes.
  • Support the transition of local public security coordination to SSSMs as stadium operations decentralise, ensuring that relevant requirements, outstanding actions and dependencies are clearly handed over.
  • Continue to provide central coordination and support after SSSM deployment where issues require cross-stadium consistency, institutional escalation or resolution of budget or resource implications.
  • Prepare briefings, reports and planning materials for the Senior Manager Stadiums relating to public security and institutional requirements.
  • Ensure that the role remains focused on planning integration and coordination and does not assume ownership of strategic public security commitments or responsibility for the development or command of police operational plans.

Education
  •  Degree in public administration, international relations, security management, event management or a related field desirable.
Experience
  • Relevant experience in institutional relations, public sector coordination, major event planning, security planning or a comparable multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Experience working with public authorities, government agencies, law enforcement bodies or major event stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating complex requirements, dependencies, actions and documentation across multiple organizations.
  • Experience in stadium, sporting event or major event environments is desirable.
  • Experience supporting budget, procurement or service planning processes is desirable.
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong stakeholder management, coordination and follow-up capability.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to structure complex requirements and dependencies clearly.
  • Good judgement and diplomacy when dealing with government and public security stakeholders.
  • Ability to distinguish strategic commitments, operational requirements and planning responsibilities.
  • Advanced IT proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Protective Security Operations Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Protective Security Operations Manager owns the detailed operational planning and coordination of protective security activities within the Protective Security Operations portfolio. The role converts approved requirements and public security commitments into workable operational arrangements for protected movements, designated persons, close protection interfaces, Trophy security and designated central sites.  

The Manager also leads the Movement Security Coordinator and  Venue Safety and Security Managers (VSSMs) during tournament operations within the approved VSSM programe and host city operating model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Develop and coordinate detailed protective security arrangements in accordance with approved portfolio requirements.
  • Own the detailed operational planning and coordination of  security movement arrangements within the portfolio, including designated protected movements and the security solutions required for team and referee movements.
  • Coordinate police escort requirements, routes, departure and arrival arrangements, secure loading and unloading points, contingencies and other relevant movement security measures.
  • Lead and manage the Security Movement Coordinator and ensure that movement requirements are accurately planned, tracked and communicated.
  • Manage VSSMs during tournament operations and provide clear priorities, direction and performance oversight across assigned host cities and clusters.
  • Ensure VSSMs are appropriately prepared, briefed and deployed to deliver decentralised Protective Security Operations in accordance with the approved VSSM programe and host city operating model.
  • Oversee VSSM implementation of approved non-competition site and protective security arrangements, including local operational adjustments, supplier delivery, site readiness and public security coordination.
  • Review significant operational issues, risks and proposed changes raised by VSSMs and provide direction or escalation where required.
  • Ensure changes affecting staffing, operating hours, contractual scope, resources or budget are referred to the relevant central owner for approval.
  • Maintain oversight of VSSM support to team and referee movement readiness, including origin and destination security arrangements and other significant host city movements.
  • Monitor VSSM reporting, assurance activity and operational performance and ensure material issues are escalated to the Senior Manager Protective Security Operations.
  • Coordinate operational arrangements for designated protected persons and maintain effective interfaces with close protection teams.
  • Coordinate FIFA-provided close protection resources where applicable.
  • Own the detailed security planning and operational delivery arrangements for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Trophy, FIFA HQ, IBCC and Final Draw.
  • Act as the principal tactical and operational Safety & Security interface with public security authorities for activities within the role’s scope.
  • Coordinate with Team Security to ensure that movement security arrangements meet the security requirements established for teams and referees.
  • Coordinate with Stadium Safety and Security Managers (SSSMs) on protective security and close protection requirements within stadium environments.
  • Identify, manage and escalate material risks, resource requirements, operational dependencies and changes with contractual or budget implications.

Education
  •  Degree in security management, law enforcement, risk management or a related field desirable.
  • Relevant professional qualifications in protective security, close protection, security management or major event operations are desirable.

Experience
  • Substantial experience in protective security, major event security, law enforcement, close protection coordination or a comparable operational security role.
  • Proven experience planning and coordinating protected movements, police escorts, routes, arrival/departure arrangements and contingencies.
  • Practical experience coordinating close protection interfaces and security arrangements for designated persons.
  • Experience managing operational security personnel and decentralized delivery teams.
  • Proven experience directly managing and developing teams, including setting objectives, delegating responsibilities, managing performance and holding staff accountable for delivery.
  • Experience coordinating operational requirements with public security authorities and other government agencies.
  • Major sporting event or complex multi-site operational experience is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies
  • Strong planning, operational coordination and problem-solving capability.
  • Sound judgement and decision-making under pressure.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organizational and documentation skills.
  • Advanced IT proficiency, including Microsoft Office.

Certifications & Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended or irregular hours during tournament periods.

job.title: Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, the Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager will be a key member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Access Management team. 

The Access Management Briefing & Reporting Manager will support the planning and delivery of access management operations across the tournament stadiums, providing data analysis, reporting, training material development as well as logistics, administrative and onboarding support.

They will be responsible for providing a range of tools and reports to assist in the planning of the FWWC2027 at all stadiums.  Such tools and reports will include:

·        Utilizing existing and previous event data to identify arrival patterns of spectators and accredited personnel at the stadiums, based on client groups and stadium capacities. 

·        Creating usable reports for HQ, management and identified stake holders pertaining to the movement of spectators and staff during the tournament period. 

·        Creating and updating Tournament Time Dashboards for venues, HQ.

·        Supporting the Access Management team with Operational Readiness.

Through close coordination with the Access Management Team and other Functional Areas (FA), they ensure that the operations relating to the movements of persons holding an access device into and within the stadiums meet the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. 

The Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting will manage a Coordinator Briefing & Reporting whose primary function will be to support the Manager, and conduct data deep dives, and research as necessary.   

The Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting will be an active member of the Access Management (ACS) HQ team throughout the planning phases and the tournament period. During event time, they will support the ACS team at the HQ and if necessary, at one of the FWWC2027 venues.


The main responsibilities and oversights of the Access Management Manager Briefing & Reporting for the FIFA Woman's World Cup 2027 include:  
·        Develop training materials for ACS staff, safety & security staff and volunteers. 
·        Create, format, and maintain professional presentations, reports, and other business documentation.
·        Support the preparation of team workshops including managing calendars, team travel logistics and scheduling activities as required.
·        Maintain organized records, documentation, and shared team resources.
·        Assist with general administrative tasks and process coordination to support business operations.
·        Coordinate onboarding activities for new employees to ensure a smooth transition into the organization. 
·         Liaise with internal departments such as HR, IT, Facilities, Security, and other relevant stakeholders to facilitate new joiner setup. 
·        Creating data and intelligence formulated reports as required to assist in the safe planning of the tournament.
·        Support the preparation of team workshops including managing calendars, team travel logistics and scheduling activities as required.
·        Utilizing existing and previous event data to identify arrival patterns of spectators and accredited staff personnel at the stadiums, based on client groups and stadium capacities. 
·        Creating usable reports for HQ, management and identified stake holders pertaining to the movement of spectators and staff during the tournament period. 
·        Creating Tournament Dashboards for the FWWC27 venues and HQ.
·        Support with tournament Operational Readiness.
Education:

·        Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. 

·        If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply.

·        Football crowd dynamics knowledge. 

·        FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. 

·        Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills.

·        Strong problem solving and analytical skills.

·        Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues.

·        Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people.

Experience:

·        Minimum experience of 4 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, , safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage.

·        Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. 

·        Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure

Skills & Competencies:
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyze one’s behavior, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes.

DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances. 

INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 

INITIATIVE: Capacity to do things on one’s own initiative and to influence the course of events, assume responsibilities, and achieve objectives with a minimum of supervision and control.

INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. 

LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.

VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans.
 
Certifications & Requirements

·        Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
·        Strong knowledge of Excel and Data analysis & Interpretation.
·        Right to work in Brazil.

Languages

·        Fluent in Portuguese and English. Other languages are an advantage.

job.title: Fan Information Manager
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotions and the Senior Digital Marketing Manager (FIFA27), the Fan Information Manager will be a key member of the FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ Digital Marketing team and will work in close collaboration cross-functional teams across different Functional Areas to deliver accurate, timely and engaging fan information across FIFA's owned digital ecosystem.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the planning, delivery and continuous evolution of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ Fan Information programme, ensuring accurate and timely operational information is available across all Host Cities and tournament venues.
  • Manage the end-to-end content lifecycle for fan-facing information across FIFA.com, the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ App, CRM email campaigns, chatbots, FAQs and other owned digital platforms.
  • Develop and maintain governance, editorial standards, publishing workflows and approval processes for multilingual fan information across all digital channels.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of the centralised Information Hub, ensuring it serves as the single source of truth for tournament information.
  • Lead the planning and execution of large-scale fan communications, including Know Before You Go campaigns, lifecycle CRM journeys and matchday operational messaging.
  • Coordinate real-time operational messaging across digital platforms, including WhatsApp, providing timely updates relating to transportation, weather, venue operations, accessibility, security and other tournament information.
  • Develop digital fan guides, educational content, FAQs and campaign assets that translate complex operational information into clear and accessible fan experiences.
  • Partner closely with Digital Product and Technology teams to enhance publishing workflows and implement new digital capabilities that improve the fan experience.
  • Collaborate with Ticketing, Communications, Marketing, Venue Management, Transport, Fan Services, Hospitality, Safety & Security, Host Cities and other tournament stakeholders to ensure operationally accurate and consistent fan communications.
  • Drive cross-functional project management across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring delivery against key tournament milestones.
  • Lead knowledge management initiatives by documenting processes, improving operational efficiencies and capturing best practices for future FIFA tournaments.
  • Monitor fan feedback, digital engagement and operational insights to continuously improve fan information products and communications.
  • Ensure close collaboration and content optimisation with colleagues across the wider Digital Marketing team, supporting an integrated fan experience across all FIFA owned-and-operated platforms.
Education & Qualifications
  • Related bachelor's degree or a similar level of higher education.
  • Exceptional organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively under pressure.
  • Experience working within international and cross-cultural environments is advantageous.
Work Experience
  • Strong experience in digital content, communications, fan information, digital marketing or a related discipline, preferably within major sporting events or international organisations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering content across websites, mobile applications, CRM platforms and other digital communication channels.
  • Strong understanding of digital content management systems, publishing workflows and content governance.
  • Experience translating operational information into clear, user-focused digital content.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills across operational, technical and marketing teams.
  • Proven track of developing and maintaining complex content ecosystems.
Technology
  • Experience/Proficiency with:
  • Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams).
  • Content Management Systems (CMS).
  • CRM platforms.
  • Project management and collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge management platforms.
  • Digital publishing tools.
  • Google Analytics or equivalent digital analytics platforms.
  • Messaging platforms including WhatsApp Business (desirable).
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Global Sponsorship Sales Manager
job.html_description:
As the organiser of some of the biggest and most iconic sport events in the world, we lead the way in the sport and event industry.

Join the team and support us on our mission.
These are your key tasks:
  • Operating in a sales-focused role, working closely with the Head of Sales and the wider sales team to achieve ambitious revenue targets through the proactive pursuit of new sponsorship business worldwide 
  • Proactively identifying, calling and engaging senior decision-makers at major multinational brands to secure high-value, multimillion sponsorship deals for the FIFA World Cup, FIFA Club World Cup, FIFA Women’s World Cup, FIFAe and Other FIFA Events 
  • Owning the full sales cycle: sourcing and qualifying prospects, making outbound calls, securing face-to-face or virtual meetings, and delivering persuasive pitches and tailored proposals to leading global brands 
  • Developing bespoke sponsorship proposals to suit the needs of individual companies  
  • Leading commercial negotiations through to the successful acquisition of multimillion-value partnerships 
  • Working closely with Strategy and Planning department to identify opportunities and build sales arguments  
  • Establishing long-lasting relationships with key sponsor prospects in the medium to long-term 
  • May act as a main point of contact for Local Organising Committees of selected Other FIFA Events for sales related matters and, where required, supporting or managing the sales process 
  • Maintaining and developing knowledge of emerging sponsorship categories, industry trends and applicable industry research such as pricing and inventory in the sale sponsorship and media assets  
  • Developing strong external works, ensuring that FIFA’s opportunities and ways of working are well known in the industry to help foster inbound leads  
  • Supporting Head of Sales with regular reporting on progress towards sales revenue targets 
We work hard at FIFA.
We are dedicated, ambitious and innovative.

And we respect our values. Always.

For all roles, we seek talented people with an entrepreneurial spirit and a global mindset.

The specific competencies we require for this position are:
  • Proven track record in international business development and consultative sales, including at least 2 years in sports event marketing, sponsorship sales or a comparable commercial environment 
  • Experience in leading, supporting and developing sales teams 
  • Demonstrated success in proactively calling, pitching to and negotiating with senior decision-makers at major multinational brands, including closing high-value and multimillion sponsorship contracts 
  • A broad and active global network of relationships and contacts across leading brands, agencies and industry sectors 
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Fluency in English is a must, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage 
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required
  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills      
  • Experience in dealing and negotiating within different cultures       
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information        
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment
The biggest benefit of a career at FIFA is the privilege to work for the beautiful game and create something that matters.

Alongside that privilege, we also offer some extra perks and benefits:
  • Health and fitness: Regular football sessions for all abilities, plus on-site gym.
  • Home office: Up to two days of home office per week if work permits and home office allowance for all.
  • Language courses: Offered to all staff to aid personal and professional growth.
  • Continuous learning: We care about your development and encourage internal mobility, offering a variety of training and education to help achieve it.
  • Pension: Flexible pension benefits with generous employer contributions.
  • Relocation assistance: A dedicated team will be on hand to support your relocation.
  • Sustainability: We support all employees using public transport.
  • Vacation: Maintain a healthy work/life balance with a generous vacation allowance.
  • Volunteering: Make an impact beyond your regular role and bond with colleagues by volunteering with one of our partners.

job.title: Legal Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Legal Coordinator will work under the guidance of the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 and will provide general legal support to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ team in Brazil. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Create, review and compile PowerPoint presentations and legal documentation.
  • Enter and regularly update information in the Wetrack tool and other internal systems.
  • Provide translation and proofreading of legal documents.
  • Provide legal advice to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ team in Brazil on civil, contractual, labor, and regulatory matters.
  • Draft, review and negotiate contracts with clients, suppliers, partners, etc.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws and internal policies.
  • Identify and support the mitigation of  legal risks.
  • Support internal and external audits by organizing and compiling requested documentation.
  • Prepare legal opinions and management reports.
  • Participate in strategic projects by providing legal support
  • Assist in monitoring relevant legislative and regulatory developments.
  • Demonstrate a team-based approach to achieving the best outcomes for FWWC 2027 in accordance with FIFA’s values.
  • Build and maintain productive working relationships with relevant stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to take a hands-on approach.
  • Support tprocess efficiency and policy improvement.
  • Ensure the assigned responsibilities are delivered to a high standard of quality and timeliness and in compliance with FIFA and FWWC 2027 policies.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor of Laws.
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil
  • Fluency in English.
Experience:
  • Experience as a qualified lawyer in a law firm or in-house legal department.
  • Excellent writing skills.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.
Other knowledge and skills:
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams).
  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a solution-oriented and pragmatic mindset.
  • Team player with the ability to build relationships internally and externally.
  • Empathetic, collaborative and patient, with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience with sporting or events organisations or commercial rights holders/sponsorship is considered an advantage.
  • Strong identification with the FIFA World Cup and its potential positive impact on the Host Country
  • Passion for football is a plus.
Requiriments:
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

job.title: Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
Reporting organizationally to the Ticketing Sales Strategy Manager, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Coordinator will help serve Ticketing and Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. This role will assist the planning and the definition of the process relative to the creation of all the customer's communications and collaterals across the ticket sales process, under the applicable sales strategy and ticketing requirements, and work closely with all the other sub-teams or Functional Areas.  

The Data Engineer Specialist designs data pipelines and reports to analyze customer behavior using KPI dashboards and ensure data quality. They collaborate cross-functionally to gather and implement requirements for reports that enable the CRM team to monitor the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ project. 
  •  Design, develop, and maintain efficient data pipelines to support the Sales Strategy team in setting up various reports for monitoring project evolution, including the ingestion, processing, and transformation of large volumes of data from various sources.  
  •  Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales Strategy, Sales Collaterals and Communications, and Customer Care, to gather requirements and timelines, and translate them into technical solutions.   
  •  Define and track KPI dashboards with the Sales Strategy team to continuously review and report on customer behaviors, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the information.  
  •  Liaise with internal and external stakeholders or providers to obtain the necessary data for building required reports.  
  •  Ensure the quality and availability of data, performing data profiling, cleansing, and validation processes.
 SKILLS FRAMEWORK  
 
ACCOUNTABILITY: Demonstrate commitment to responsibilities and objectively analyse one’s behaviour, while assuming consequences of one’s own actions and/or decisions and learning from one’s mistakes. 
 
DECISION MAKING: Ability to identify and swiftly make decisions in critical situations, take initiative and calculated risks, explore alternative solutions, and respond promptly to unforeseen circumstances.    
 
INCLUSIVITY: Achieve shared organizational objectives by sharing information with colleagues across all levels and divisions, tangibly influencing others, and maintaining a network of support contacts. 
 
INITIATIVE: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
INNOVATION: Capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.   
 
LEADERSHIP: Ability to lead one’s contacts/colleagues/partners, encourage teamwork, and delegate authority / decision-making power, as needed, to produce the expected results and make efficient use of the team’s skills and talents.  
  
VISION: Ability to perceive the organization's global environmental impact, anticipate decision consequences, grasp organizational missions, and formulate strategic plans. 
 
EDUCATION & QUALIFICATIONS 
 
Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Digital Marketing, Communications, or similar.    
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
 
Minimum three years of experience creating and managing content for ticketing processes/solutions for events, ideally in the sports industry.   
 
Using content management and Marketing Automation Tools within large-scale projects, ideally inside ticketing and/or sports events, that require strong communication and organizational skills.   
 
Managing projects related to content creation and/or coordinating translations that require attention to the details, ensuring accuracy and consistency.  
 
Venue and onsite operations experience for large-scale events, ideally in the sports industry is nice to have.   
Communication and problem-solving skills.    
 
Translations experience to translate digital content and documents from English to Portuguese and vice-versa would be an advantage. 
 
LANGUAGES 
 
Fluent in English and Portuguese, spoken and written.   
 
A native level of at least one of the following: French, Spanish, German or Arabic is nice to have. 
 
TECHNOLOGY 
 
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools  
 
Marketing Automation Tools and Content management platforms.   
 
Experience with Ticketing Systems is nice to have 


Certifications & Requirements 
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Right to work in Brazil

job.title: Venue Safety & Security Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)
job.html_description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
The Venue Safety & Security Manager (VSSM) is responsible for the operational planning and delivery of safety and security across all official non-competition sites within their designated host city or host city cluster for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. This includes team base camps, training sites, official hotels, transport hubs and other designated locations, including off-city sites requiring travel. Reporting to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites, the VSSM provides senior-level operational leadership and acts as the primary safety and security liaison at host city level. The role ensures compliance with FIFA regulations, local statutory requirements and tournament operational plans, while maintaining structured coordination with public security authorities, site authorities and private security suppliers. The VSSM must demonstrate senior standing and credibility, particularly in engagements with law enforcement and public security agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Plan and deliver safety and security operations across all designated non-competition sites within the assigned host city (venue) or cluster.
  • Ensure implementation of the Safety & Security Strategy, Operational Plan, site operating plans and all relevant tournament planning documents as relevant to each venue and site
  • Conduct just-in-time planning activities including deployment planning, supplier site induction, readiness planning, training and briefings
  • Develop, review and update dot plans, deployment plans, rosters and standing instructions for private security suppliers
  • Review and update site-specific risk assessments and ensure mitigation measures are implemented
  • Manage operational delivery through appointed private security supplier(s) and other allocated workforce groups
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with local government authorities, police, law enforcement agencies and other public security partners
  • Act as the principal liaison for public security authorities in the host city for non-competition sites
  • Coordinate secure team and referee movements between official sites and stadiums in collaboration with public security partners
  • Liaise and cooperate with site authorities, hotel management, training site operators and transport stakeholders
  • Liaise and cooperate with FIFA Safety & Security Officers (FSSOs), Team Security and Referee Security Liaison Officers (TSLOs/RSLOs) deployed in the host city
  • Attend and contribute to planning meetings, joint exercises and inter-agency coordination sessions
  • Conduct site inspections to ensure compliance with planning, overlay requirements and security standards
  • Escalate safety and security issues to the Manager, Non-Competition Sites and ensure appropriate follow-up and corrective action
  • Ensure all safety and security staff under supervision are fully briefed on site-specific procedures and tournament regulations
  • Provide daily reporting to tournament HQ during operational periods
  • Attend debriefs and submit written reports and operational assessments as directed
  • Manage time flexibly and ensure attendance at official site activities involving teams, including travel to off-city base camps as required
  • Attend planning meetings, training sessions, exercises and debriefs as directed
Education
  • Higher education in security management, public safety, risk management or a related field
  • Relevant professional qualifications or licensing required by local or state legislation
Experience
  • Strong experience managing safety and security operations in major events, public security or comparable environments
  • Strong background in law enforcement, public security authority or senior private security leadership
  • Demonstrated experience liaising with public authorities and multi-agency partners
  • Experience managing operational security delivery across multiple sites
  • Experience managing staffing budgets and supplier performance
  • High level of spoken and written English

Skills & Competencies
  • Senior-level stakeholder engagement and negotiation skills
  • Strong operational leadership and decision-making capability
  • Ability to build credibility with public security authorities
  • Structured planning and risk assessment capability
  • High level of integrity and professional conduct
  • Ability to operate independently across dispersed geographic areas
  • Calm and decisive under pressure
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese
  • Strong IT literacy 

Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Valid driving licence (mandatory)
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearances (if required)
  • Right to work in Brazil. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
