job.title: Casual Football & Sports Coach - DisAbility
job.plain_text_description:
Fulham FC Foundation are currently seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and committed person to take up the casual position of DisAbility Football & Sports Coach.
Reporting directly to our Senior DisAbility Development Manager, the DisAbility Football & Sports Coaches are responsible for delivering high-quality football & sports coaching to children, young people and adults with disabilities and additional needs. This role involves delivery across a wide-range of our DisAbility Programmes, including Pan DisAbility Clubs, Active Autism, Down’s Syndrome ‘Badgers’, Blind and Partially Sighted, Cerebral Palsy and Dwarfism Football Sessions. In addition there will be opportunities to work in our DisAbility Schools programme delivering PE, Enrichment Activities and After School Clubs.
While the primary focus of this role is on DisAbility Football & Sport, there may be opportunities to contribute to other FFC Foundation activities such as Skills Club, Development Centres, Soccer Schools, Primary Education, Kicks, and Health & Wellbeing. We would encourage candidates to prioritise DisAbility Programmes where possible, while remaining flexible to support other areas as needed.
This is a casual role where flexibility is essential, as the role necessitates involvement in supporting the delivery of programme activities as and when required.
The successful candidate will be somebody who has prior experience delivering football & sports coaching sessions to children & young people with disabilities or additional needs in grassroots & school settings, holds at least a FA Level 1/Introduction to Coaching Football qualification and is committed to the charitable purpose of Fulham FC Foundation.
As this role is casual, there is no set timetable. Sessions may be offered on an adhoc or regular basis, depending on the needs of Fulham FC Foundation. It is the responsibility of the DisAbility Football & Sports Coaches to maintain consistent and effective communication with our Senior DisAbility Development Manager and Operations Officers to ensure the continuation of work.
Whilst there is no obligation for Fulham FC Foundation to provide, or for the DisAbility Football & Sports Coaches to accept, work. DisAbility Football & Sports Coaches who do not work for an extended period of time, will be deactivated.
The successful candidates should be available to work across at least one of the below times, in order to receive work. We are extremely keen to hear from those who are able to work on Saturday mornings.
Weekdays – 9am to 5 pm;
Weekday Evenings – 5pm to 9pm
Weekends – Saturdays – 8am to 12noon.
Work in other timings is available, however on a far reduced frequency.
Salary Range: £12.95 p/h to £16.50 p/h
Next steps
:
There is no closing date for this role. Applications will be reviewed on a bi-weekly basis.
If successful, you will join a vibrant team who are passionate about achieving the organisation's vision of “an active, inclusive and thriving community”, and you’ll have the opportunity to build on your existing skills through a variety of training and development opportunities and experiences
*
This job description should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive. It is intended as an outline indication of areas of activity and responsibility and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation
.
Responsibilities
- To act as an Ambassador for Fulham FC Foundation (FFCF), representing the organisation professionally in line with its values. - To plan and deliver high-quality football and sports coaching sessions to children, young people & adults in-line with FFCF standards. - To provide a safe, positive and inclusive learning environment at all times, - To adhere to FFCF’s safeguarding policies and procedures, ensuring the timely reporting of any safeguarding concerns or incidents within sessions. - To engage, include, inspire and grow participation across FFCF activities. - To support the transition of participants between different FFCF programmes and activities. - To champion opportunities for individuals from underrepresented groups within FFCF activities. - To identify and support progression pathways for talented young people. - To support the development of FFCF programmes through positive collaboration with Department Managers / Operations Officers. - To support the promotion of FFCF programmes across the local community. - To assist in data collection and completion of monitoring & evaluation on an ongoing basis.
Requirements
Essential:
Experience:
- Delivery of football coaching sessions in a grassroots environment - Delivery of sports coaching sessions to children, young people or adults with disabilities and additional needs. - Delivery within a school/college setting. - Working in a customer-facing role.
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Introduction to Coaching Football qualification - In-date FA Emergency First Aid - In-date FA Safeguarding Children certificate - Base knowledge of and willingness to learn & contribute towards FFCF strategic aims.
Personal Qualities:
- A positive role-model for children & young people. - Ability to travel independently across South-West London, including transport of equipment. - Well presented, with a professional manner. - Positive, energetic persona. Able to build rapport with participants. - Excellent time-keeping & punctuality. - Willingness to learn & develop personally & professionally.
Preferred:
Experience:
- Delivery of football & sports coaching sessions in a Club Community Organisation (CCO). - Delivery of Physical Education within a school setting. - Delivery within a classroom environment. - Marketing & Promoting participation activities in the community. - Delivery of football & sports coaching sessions to females.
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- FA Level 2/UEFA C in Coaching Football qualification (or higher). - Additional PE/HLTA qualification - Mentoring qualification - Non-football NGB sports qualifications.

job.title: Matchday Retail Assistant
job.html_description:
Position Purpose

This role involves supporting the day-to-day operations of the Club’s retail store, delivering excellent customer service, maintaining high standards of presentation, and ensuring efficient stock handling and sales processes.

Responsibilities

Essential and Desirable

  • Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to assist customers in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Able to work effectively in a fast-paced retail environment, both independently and as part of a team, while maintaining high standards of organisation and efficiency.
  • Available to work all home matchdays - weekends and evenings including bank holidays.
  • Adaptability to handle a variety of situations

Ideally, Matchday Retail Assistant will:
  • Previous EPOS experience
  • Retail Experience

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
• Provide excellent and helpful customer service, assisting customers with products and purchases.
• Operate the till and process card payments accurately.
• Print names and numbers onto replica shirts, ensuring customer orders are completed correctly and to a high standard.
• Replenish stock and keep stores and displays tidy and well-presented.
• Price and label products correctly across the store.
• Support the matchday running of the store and assist with additional tasks when required
• Work in various units across the stadium

job.title: Chef De Partie
job.html_description:
Position Purpose 
 

  • We are looking for a chef with a background in catering for professional sports teams to join our passionate nutrition focused team.

  • You will support our Head Chef and Sous Chef in providing balanced, nutritional and high quality meals to our players and support staff at the training ground.

  • A good basis of nutrition helps our players to achieve their individual nutritional goals, ultimately enhancing health, recovery and performance.

  • To lead the kitchen team in preparing and providing meals to our youth and women teams.

  • Some travel with teams to away games may be necessary, following their weekly schedule/fixtures, ensuring all food provided to them meets the presentation, taste and performance need of the group.

Requirements

Requirements and Responsibilities
 

  • Work with the Head Chef and independently to create and develop exciting seasonal menus. 

  • Prepare meals for youth and women teams working within the nutritional guidelines and ensure junior team members are working correctly to achieve this with you.

  • Instruct junior team members accordingly to ensure youth and women teams' meals are delivered on time and presented to a high standard.

  • Support and lead junior members of the kitchen team.

  • Check stock requirements and order accordingly in the Head/Sous chef absence.

  • Travel with teams in the UK and abroad when required as the catering team representative and provide food provisions as requested.

  • Assist in the preparation of all travel food requirements whilst displaying good organisational skills.

  • Support Head/Sous chef to deliver constantly high quality food in a timely manner.

  • Cover Sous chefs' role as and when required.

  • Working closely with the Supervisor to ensure the highest level of food safety and hygiene are maintained. Compliance with COSHH.

  • Flexibility to work around the teams schedules.



Essential and Desirable
 

The Chef De Partie must have: 

  • Minimum of 1 year experience providing food to sports teams/athletes
  • Level 2 NVQ Professional Cookery or equivalent
  • Excellent communication skill to lead the junior kitchen team
  • Works well under pressure with the ability to remain calm with last minute schedule changes
 
Ideally, the Chef De Partie will: 
  • Football specific experience
  • Level 2 Food Hygiene certificate
  • Performance nutrition knowledge

job.title: Casual Mini-Bus Driver
job.html_description:
Fulham FC Foundation are currently seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and committed person to take up the position of Casual Mini-Bus Driver for the Foundation. 

Reporting directly to our Football & Education Head Coaches the Casual Mini-Bus Driver is responsible for providing a safe, reliable and professional driving service for the Foundation’s Football & Education Programme. The successful candidate will be responsible for transporting our Football & Education teams safely to and from fixtures, competitions, training sessions and other programme-related activities. The role will require you to drive a 17-seater or larger minibus. 

This is a zero-hour contract with no guaranteed hours or working times, with work being offered based on the programme’s fixtures and activity schedule. The majority of these journeys will take place on Tuesday’s, Wednesday’s and Thursday’s. There may also be occasional requirements on Mondays and Fridays, depending on the fixture schedule. Most of these hours will be during the working day (9am – 5pm) however with some longer away games you may be required outside of these times. Therefore, flexibility is required for the role with some work being offered at relatively short notice. These hours will also predominantly take place during term time, with only the occasional need for drivers during the school holiday. 

The successful candidate will be someone who holds a D1 entitlement on their driving licence, has experience driving a minibus, and would be comfortable working with young people. You will also be required to hold an up-to-date DBS check and complete your FA Safeguarding and First Aid Training.  

Salary Range: £15ph 

Next steps: 
If successful, you will join a vibrant team who are passionate about achieving the organisation's vision of “an active, inclusive and thriving community”, and you’ll have the opportunity to build on your existing skills through a variety of training and development opportunities and experiences.

*This job description should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive. It is intended as an outline indication of areas of activity and responsibility and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation.


Responsibilities

  • Safely transport Football & Education participants and staff to and from fixtures, training sessions, competitions and other programme activities.
 
  • Plan journeys effectively, allowing sufficient time to account for traffic and potential delays.
 
  • Complete pre-use vehicle safety checks before each journey and report any defects immediately.
 
  • Maintain a valid D1 entitlement and cooperate with periodic DVLA licence checks as part of the Club's fleet compliance process.
 
  • Ensure all passengers follow appropriate safety procedures, including the use of seatbelts.
 
  • Follow all relevant road traffic legislation, and internal policies and procedures, such as (but not limited to) our fuel card and vehicle usage procedures.
 
  • Comply with the Club's Fleet Policy and all vehicle-related procedures.
 
  • Ensure vehicles are returned in a clean, tidy and roadworthy condition, with keys returned in line with Club procedures.
 
  • Communicate effectively with Football & Education staff regarding collection times, destinations, delays and any issues arising during journeys.
 
  • Report any accidents, incidents, damages, defects, near misses, or safeguarding concerns in accordance with organisational procedures.
 
  • Always represent Fulham Football Club and Fulham FC Foundation to a high standard in line with club values at all times.

Requirements

Essential: 
Experience: 
•  Proven experience of driving a minibus, ideally a 17-seater or larger vehicle.
•  Experience transporting passengers in a professional or organised setting.
•  Planning journeys effectively, allowing sufficient time to account for traffic and potential delays.

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
•  A full, clean UK driving licence with D1 entitlement to legally drive the required minibus.
•  A good understanding of UK road safety and relevant driving regulations.
•  The ability to work independently and manage journeys effectively.

Personal Qualities:
•  Excellent reliability, punctuality and timekeeping.
•  Good communication skills and a professional manner.
•  A flexible approach to working hours and availability.
•  The ability to work appropriately and professionally around young people.

Preferred: 
Experience: 
•  Previous experience working within football, sport, education, charity or youth programmes.
•  Previous experience transporting young people or students.

Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
•  FA First Aid & Safeguarding 
•  Ability to interact with others in a positive manner
•  Strong understanding of the local area
•  Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (Driver CPC)

job.title: Casual Academy Scout (Midlands)
job.html_description:
The National Academy scouting team is responsible for identifying and monitoring players either from grassroots or other Academies in national regions. They will complete reports on players and share information with other Academy staff to develop a range of player intelligence across the local area. 

There is a particular interest for us to recruit within the following teams: 
- Grassroots – Midlands 
- Academy- Midlands

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:
• To manage your individual weekend schedule and regularly attend fixtures within your region or
across your phase.
• To complete reports on players all players with potential across your region and phase.
• Network with other national scouts to share information on potential target players.
• To keep National and department Managers informed of high potential players across their area or
age phase.
• To support with the ongoing communication to the families of players within our TID programmes
and on trial as and when required.
• To support the delivery of Talent ID programmes and events as and when required.
• Participate in scouting team meetings to further discuss succession planning and their identified
target players.
• To attend department meetings and participate in all CPD and required safeguarding training when
appropriate.

Requirements

The Casual Academy Scout (Midlands) must have:
• Knowledge and networks within the local area they scout.
• Previous experience scouting for another Academy (Cat 1, 2 or 3)
• FA Talent ID Level 2
• FA Safeguarding

Ideally, the Casual Academy Scout (Midlands) will:
• Previous experience scouting for another Cat 1 Academy.
• FA Level 2 Coaching
• Full Driver’s License

job.title: Ticketing and Membership Executive - Match Days
job.html_description:
In this role, you will work as a casual member of the team, as part of the wider Ticket Office team at Craven Cottage to manage inbound enquiries across a number of different communication channels – phone, email, online and in person – and deliver on the sale of commercial products relating to Fulham Football Club through the Club’s ticketing system, Ticketmaster.
   
The Ticket Office team form a critical part of the sales structure of the business, and you will be required to proactively support the Club in its objective to make it easy for people to buy from Fulham FC by assisting with supporter queries on our busy matchdays.  
  
You will form part of the team working as the first line of contact for our fans’ inquiries and as such we expect a high level of customer service and support at all times.  
 
You will be asked to provide assistance to the Head of Ticketing and the Deputy Supporter Centre Manager with a variety of Ticket Office duties as required. A good level of communication will be required.  

Hours of work 
This is a casual role, and there are no guaranteed hours. Working hours will vary according to business needs, match schedules and Club events. Successful candidates must be available to work evenings, weekends and all Fulham FC home league fixtures where required.

Responsibilities

The Ticketing and Membership Executive - Match Days must have: 
  • Customer Service experience
  • A good IT and technology systems understanding
  • Competent with all Microsoft Office Products
  • Ability to deal with the public with a focus on service excellence 
  • Able to work under pressure 
  • Ability to communicate with and relate to staff members at all levels 
  • Work on own initiative / creative 
  • Respect for confidentiality 
  • Flexible attitude to work tasks 
  • Genuine commitment to provide high quality customer service 
  • Positive ‘can do’ approach 
  • Desire to learn with enthusiasm

Ideally, The Ticketing and Membership Executive - Match Days will have: 
  • Previous experience with Ticketing Systems
  • Experience in a sales role

Requirements

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
  • Providing service excellence when dealing with the Clubs customers (supporters, staff etc), at all times, serving customers in a polite, courteous and professional manner  
  • Handling any customer queries and complaints with a solution driven and positive approach  
  • Processing all ticket sales for Fulham FC products, away games and supporter travel, with daily reconciliation of all sales through the Ticketmaster system   
  • Updating and maintaining supporter database records to ensure data is accurately captured across the Ticketing System (Ticketmaster) and CRM System  
  • This role will be required to work all home league matchdays – on evenings or weekends , and an other ad-hoc fixtures or events as required   
  • You may also be required to carry out other tasks, not listed, to assist in the efficient operation of our business.  At all times you will be required to act in accordance with FFC company policies, follow departmental procedures and maintain the highest level of confidentiality.

job.title: Kitchen Porter
job.html_description:
To assist the Kitchen and Front of house staff in cleaning of all kitchen items, equipment,
machinery, floors and surfaces. Maintaining high standards and safe practices in all areas.
This is generally a Monday to Friday role however some flexibility with working hours will be
required on occasions and there is opportunity to gain basic kitchen skills.

Responsibilities

  • Manning the Pot Wash area
  • Cleaning numerous kitchen items used by the kitchen and also front of house
  • To maintain a very high standard of kitchen/food hygiene at all times
  • To maintain a high standard of personal hygiene at all times
  • The cleaning of the kitchen area including machinery, storerooms
  • Putting away incoming goods in storage areas and maintaining these areas

Requirements

Essential

  • 3 months in a similar role
  • Good command of the English language
  • Basic Food Hygiene
  • Able to work at a quick pace
  • Likes to get stuck in
  • Good team Player

job.title: Academy Kit Assistant
job.html_description:
The Academy Kit Assistant supports the smooth day-to-day running of the Academy by preparing, maintaining, and distributing training and match kit for players and staff. 

Responsibilities

The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role:  
  • Prepare and distribute training and match kit. 
  • Ensure all kit and equipment is clean, organised, and ready for use. 
  • Assist with stock control, kit issuing, and inventory management. 
  • Support academy training sessions, fixtures, and tournaments as required. 
  • Maintain high standards within the kit room and storage areas. 
  • Work closely with academy staff to meet operational needs. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate will:
  • Be organised and reliable. 
  • Have strong attention to detail. 
  • Be a positive team player with a flexible approach to working evenings and weekends. 
  • Have a Full Driving License  
  • Be able to work in a fast-paced football environment while maintaining high professional standards.

job.title: Casual Physiotherapist
job.html_description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and organised Physiotherapist to join the Fulham FC Foundation team, working in a casual capacity to support our ‘Football & Education’ teams. The successful candidate will provide injury assessment, treatment and rehabilitation services through a weekly clinic and deliver pitch-side medical support on matchdays.

This role will have two key responsibilities that will support our ‘Football & Education Programme’ to maximise player performance, enhance recovery, reduce injury risk, and minimise the risk to players during a pitch side medical emergency.

The successful candidates first responsibility will be providing a weekly injury clinic to our participants to make sure they are receiving correct treatment and advice to minimise any potential injuries. As well as supporting the coaching team to make sure that any injuries caused due to training methods are minimised.

Although this role is casual, with the hours varying across the season, meaning that there is no set timetable. There are some key times when the injury clinic and fixtures will occur. Therefore, the ideal candidate will have good availability during the late morning/early afternoons of the working week. Please be aware that some away fixtures will take up the majority of the working day.
Salary: £25 p/h


Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include:
· Deliver a weekly two-hour physiotherapy clinic for injured players.
· Assess, diagnose and treat football-related injuries.
· Develop and monitor rehabilitation programmes.
· Provide injury prevention advice and education.
· Maintain accurate treatment and injury records.

The role's second responsibility will be to provide medical and emergency support during match days across both our male and female teams. This responsibility will include:

· Attend designated fixtures as required.
· Provide pitch-side assessment and injury management.
· Deliver first aid and emergency medical care where necessary.
· Ensure medical equipment and supplies are maintained.

Requirements

The successful candidate must have an excellent knowledge of rehabilitation and injury prevention, with extensive experience of delivering these within a sporting background. You will also be expected to have experience of providing medical support during match days, and of having excellent organisation and communication skills to support the wider coaching team.

The following qualifications, skills and experience are essential:
· FA Intermediate Trauma Medical Management in Football certificate or equivalent first aid qualification. – Could get away with PHCIS Level 2.
· BSc in Physiotherapy or Sport Rehabilitation
· Sports Trauma Management or Emergency Aid in Sport qualification.

job.title: Video & Content Officer
job.plain_text_description:
The Video & Content Officer will be responsible for creating compelling visual content that showcases the impact of Fulham FC Foundation's work. The role will lead on videography and content creation across the Foundation's programmes, events and campaigns.
Working closely with delivery teams and the Communications Manager, the postholder will capture and share engaging stories that increase participation, attract supporters and partners, and demonstrate community impact.
Why Join Fulham FC Foundation?
At Fulham FC Foundation, we are committed to using the power of sport to transform lives and strengthen communities. By joining our team, you will:
• Work alongside a highly experienced, passionate, and supportive delivery team,
• Access a range of training and professional development opportunities,
• Continue to develop your coaching, facilitation, and community engagement skills,
• Play a key role in delivering life-changing programmes across South West London,
• Make a genuine difference to the lives of people within our local communities.
We strive for service excellence in everything we do and set high standards for all staff representing the Foundation. In return, we provide a supportive and inclusive environment where you can grow professionally while making a real and lasting impact on the people and communities we serve.
Further Information
Salary range is £27,000 - £28,500 for 40 hours per week.
​
Please note: closing date for applications is 25th October.
Responsibilities
- To act as an Ambassador for Fulham FC Foundation (FFCF), representing the organisation professionally in line with its values.
Videography and Content Production
• Plan, capture and edit video content for promotional, fundraising, programme and impact campaigns.
• Produce engaging short-form and long-form video content suitable for digital and social media platforms.
• Develop creative concepts and storyboards aligned with campaign objectives.
• Support regular video review and planning meetings to ensure content quality and consistency.
Storytelling and Impact Content
• Lead the planning, filming, editing and delivery of participant case study videos.
• Work directly with programme teams and beneficiaries to identify compelling stories.
• Ensure all content is captured and produced in line with safeguarding, consent and brand guidelines.
Photography
• Support on the capture of high-quality photography from Foundation programmes, events, campaigns and community activities.
• Maintain a comprehensive library of images for future communications and marketing use.
• Edit and optimise photographic content for digital, print and social media channels.
Marketing Support
• Provide ad hoc multimedia and creative support for communications and marketing campaigns. • Assist with content requirements for fundraising, events and partnership activations.
*This job description should not be regarded as exclusive or exhaustive. It is intended as an outline indication of areas of activity and responsibility and will be amended in the light of the changing needs of the organisation.
Requirements
Essential:
Experience:
• Experience in professional videography and photography.
• Experience producing content for social media, websites and digital marketing campaigns.
• Experience editing video and photographic assets.
• Experience interviewing and developing feature videos.
Skills, Knowledge & Qualifications:
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including Premiere Pro, Photoshop and Lightroom. - Strong storytelling and content-writing skills. - Excellent planning and organisational abilities. - Ability to work independently while managing multiple projects. - Strong interpersonal skills and confidence when engaging with programme participants.
Desirable
- Experience within sport, education, youth work, charity or community sectors. - Knowledge of social media content trends and platform best practice. - Understanding of safeguarding and consent processes when working with children and vulnerable adults.

job.title: u18 Head Coach
job.html_description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate coach to play a key role in delivering and enhancing our Academy Performance Plan. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning, delivering and reviewing high-quality coaching activities that support the individual development needs of Academy players. Working across the player pathway, they will help ensure smooth and effective transitions from the U16 age group into the Professional Development Phase and from the U18s into the U21 programme, maintaining consistency in player development. The role will also contribute to the ongoing development of the Academy Performance Plan and Technical Plan, helping to drive continuous improvement and maximise player potential.

Responsibilities

The U18 Head Coach must hold or have:
  • Experience of coaching adolescents in a Category 1 and/or Premier League Academy setting.
  • Experience of supporting parents/carers of adolescents within similar settings.
  • Experience of delivering individual player development programmes (ILPs/IDPs) within a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Hold appropriate and up to date qualifications to conform to Professional Game Academy Audit Company (PGAAC) and Premier League Youth Development Rules (PLYDR) requirements.
  • UEFA A Licence (FA Level 4 qualification), and remain up to date with associated CPD requirements.
  • FA Advanced Youth Award (FA Level 4 qualification).
  • Valid FA Introduction to First Aid in Football certificate.
  • Valid FA Safeguarding Children certificate.
  • Broad awareness of the football industry’s governing policies and youth football protocols, in particular the Premier League’s Youth Development Rules.
  • Knowledge of regulations, research and expected practices in relation to working with adolescents, with particular reference to safeguarding, well-being, social development and safety.
  • Be player/person-centred (individualised) in approach to development.
  • Have high-level interpersonal skills, including being an effective and adaptable communicator.
  • Demonstrate resilience towards the everyday rigours of high-performance environments.
  • Be diligent, hard-working, detail-driven and intrinsically motivated by the Academy’s mission.
  • Hold a forward-thinking, positive and optimistic mindset.
  • Be willing to hold honest and supportive conversations with parents, guardians or carers of Academy players.
 
Ideally, the Under 18 Head Coach will hold or have:
  • A minimum of 2 years’ coaching experience within the Professional Development Phase (U16–U21) at a Category 1 Academy.
  • Experience of leading or supporting the development of less experienced coaching staff.
  • Experience within the England Youth International pathway or equivalent representative football.
  • The FA Talent Identification Level 1 qualification.
  • A related higher education degree in coaching, analysis or sports science (or similar qualification).
  • Confidence, in the use of video/performance analysis platforms (e.g. HUDL or similar) to support individual player development.
  • Awareness of First Team environments and the holistic demands placed on elite level athletes.
  • Continuously demonstrates openness & inclusiveness.
  • Action orientated; solution focused.
  • Show pro-activeness and an ability to work around or overcome obstacles that others may find challenging.
  • Understand the importance of being a confident custodian for an organisation with history and tradition.

Requirements

The Under 18 Head Coach (‘U18 HC') is employed to prepare, deliver and review coaching activities in line with the Academy’s Performance Plan.
 
There is a specific requirement for the U18 HC to support individuals as they move into and through the Professional Development Phase by delivering on the agreed commitments within each players Individual Learning Plan (ILP) and leading the process of continual review and refinement supporting the programme to be suitably responsive to each individual’s dynamic needs.
 
This essentially makes the U18 HC responsible for the following, non-exhaustive list:
Preparing
  • Lead the creation and ongoing development of both Individual Learning Plans and the Age Group Plan for the U18s.
  • Play an active role in the transition of players from the U16 age group into the PDP, working closely with U16 coaching staff to ensure continuity of style, expectations and individual development priorities.
  • Lead and sustain frequent, consistent and supportive communication with all players and their families to support transitions into Professional Football.
  • Lead the Multi-Disciplinary Team to create seasonal, weekly and daily, team and individual training plans.
  • Lead the preparations of meaningful content for individual player (and parent) reviews.
  • Support the preparation of content for team and individual Performance Education, Physical Development and Psychology delivery, ensuring integration where possible.
  • Align video to team and individual commitments, supporting team and individual player development over time.

Delivering
  • Lead the delivery of team training sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan) specifically integrating team and individual outcomes into practice.
  • Lead the delivery of individual training sessions (both inside and outside of team training sessions) in line with ILP commitments.
  • Lead teams and individuals through fixtures, both home and away, as part of the age group games programme, ensuring we are appropriately competitive.
  • Lead teams and individuals through tours, tournaments and competitions aligning the environment design and coaching behaviours to the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan.
  • Lead the delivery of performance education sessions in line with the expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan).
  • Support the delivery of the U16 and U21 programmes, as needed.
  • Attend first team games and youth international football events as required.
  • Oversee the implementation of the Academy Values and Behaviours towards staff and players.

Reviewing
  • Lead the effective review of team training sessions in line with ‘reflection’ expectations outlined within the Academy Performance Plan (Technical Plan).
  • Lead the effective review of individual training sessions and their impact on player-coach relationships and player performance over time.
  • Review all team and individual match performances in all games programme, tours and tournament fixtures.
  • Coordinate the ongoing ‘rolling’ review of each player’s ILP, ensuring the creation of clear action plans, involving colleagues from different disciplinary backgrounds, through weekly MDT meetings.
  • Lead all player and parent review meetings, ensuring player and parent feedback is recorded and agreed actions are shared and followed up.
  • Ensure each player’s Performance Clock is up to date and accurate.
  • Ensure all players are provided with regular access to their personal performance data, highlighting key metrics in line with the Academy Technical Plan.
  • Support the feedback process for all trialists.

Leadership & Collaboration
  • Be an active role model for all Academy coaches across the pathway and wider Club environment.
  • Offer guidance and support to less experienced coaching colleagues, taking a specific and regular interest in the upper part of the YDP.
  • Act as a key point of connection between the U16 age group and the PDP, and support alignment between the U18 and U21 programmes.
  • Consistently demonstrate, and hold others to, the highest levels of professionalism.
  • Support the delivery of coach development events across the year, as required.
  • Be part of the Academy Technical Group, shaping the Technical Strategy for the long term.
  • In collaboration with the Head of Talent ID & Recruitment, support the retention and recruitment of Academy players, including feedback for trialists and identification of players ready to progress from the U16 age group.
  • In collaboration with the Head of Performance, coordinate the effective review of the physical development programme and performance of the age group fitness coach.
  • In collaboration with the Head of Insights, coordinate the effective review of the performance education programme and performance of the age group analyst.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on Friday 2nd October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

- Be an active role model for all Academy coaches across the pathway and wider Club environment. - Offer guidance and support to less experienced coaching colleagues, taking a specific and regular interest in the upper part of the YDP. - Act as a key point of connection between the U16 age group and the PDP, and support alignment between the U18 and U21 programmes. - Consistently demonstrate, and hold others to, the highest levels of professionalism. - Support the delivery of coach development events across the year, as required. - Be part of the Academy Technical Group, shaping the Technical Strategy for the long term. - In collaboration with the Head of Talent ID & Recruitment, support the retention and recruitment of Academy players, including feedback for trialists and identification of players ready to progress from the U16 age group. - In collaboration with the Head of Performance, coordinate the effective review of the physical development programme and performance of the age group fitness coach. - In collaboration with the Head of Insights, coordinate the effective review of the performance education programme and performance of the age group analyst.
Benefits
We expect to close applications on Friday 2nd October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: Academy Education Post-16 Teacher (Maternity Cover)
job.html_description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and organised Teacher to join our team on a fixed-term basis covering maternity leave. This role is expected to last for approximately 7 months from October 2026.

The Post-16 Teacher will lead on the delivery of the Academy’s scholarship education programme, primarily teaching the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence, as well as the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification. You will consistently deliver outstanding teaching and learning in your own practice and play a key role in driving high standards of teaching and learning across the department. You will be responsible for ensuring players make good progress towards their target grades in each qualification.
 
The successful candidate will play a key role within the pastoral team, supporting the holistic, off-pitch development of our players. Operating across phases, the role’s primary purpose is to add value to all aspects of our players’ educational programmes and to contribute towards maintaining the Academy’s Category 1 status.

Responsibilities

The Post-16 Teacher plays a central role in delivering and developing the Academy’s education programme, with a particular focus on the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence and the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification. This role involves delivering consistently high-quality teaching and learning, tracking and supporting academic progress, and contributing to the holistic development of players through mentoring, pastoral support, and leadership of key initiatives. The successful candidate will also support wider departmental responsibilities, including destination tracking, school liaison, and compliance with EPPP and Premier League education standards, ensuring that the Academy continues to provide bespoke education pathways for its players.
 
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the responsibilities of the role: 
 
  • To help ensure the Academy Mission is achieved.
  • Deliver the BTEC Level 3 in Sporting Performance and Excellence and the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) qualification.
  • Plan and deliver high-quality, engaging lessons that drive outstanding teaching and learning, ensuring all learners make sustained progress.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality departmental resources, including schemes of work and assessment materials.
  • Monitor, track, and support the academic progress of all scholars, using data to inform timely interventions.
  • Create a positive, inclusive learning environment that promotes the highest standards of behaviour for learning amongst learners.
  • Take ownership of professional development and actively engage in relevant training and CPD opportunities.
  • Coordinate and conduct regular academic and pastoral progress reviews with players and their schools across phases.
  • Support the delivery of the Academy Life Plan, ensuring alignment with player development objectives.
  • To support the Youth Development Phase Compensatory Education Programme.
  • Attend relevant department, phase-specific, and league-led education meetings.
  • Support post-scholarship destination tracking and transitions.
  • Act as a liaison for school engagement, particularly with YDP players.
  • Coordinate or support YDP education projects and events.
  • Ensure compliance with EPPP, Premier League, and external quality assurance frameworks, including preparation for audits and visits.

Requirements

The Academy Education Post-16 Teacher must have: 
 
  • Educated to degree level.
  • PGCE with QTS or equivalent.
  • Experience of delivering a BTEC at KS5.
  • Experience of delivering KS3 and KS4 curriculum.
  • A commitment to plan and deliver high-quality, engaging lessons that drive outstanding teaching and learning, ensuring all learners make sustained progress.
  • Working knowledge of BTEC qualifications.
  • A commitment and experience of supporting young people holistically.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with players, parents, and colleagues.
 
Ideally Academy Education Post-16 Teacher will have: 
 
  • Experience working within an elite sporting or performance environment.
  • Knowledge of Academy football and the Elite Player Performance Plan (EPPP).
  • Experience of delivering an A-Level.
  • Experience delivering the Sporting Excellence Professional (SEP) apprenticeship.
  • PE based teaching experience. 
  • Experience in coordinating or leading education programmes.
  • Experience of working with external partners, including schools and awarding bodies.

Benefits

The closing date for applications is Friday 4th September.

job.title: Payroll Manager
job.html_description:
At Fulham Football Club, we are looking for an experienced and highly capable Payroll Manager to take ownership of the payroll function across the Fulham Group.
 
This is an exciting opportunity to join the Finance team within a Premier League football club and a wider, growing group of businesses. The Payroll Manager will be responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely and compliant delivery of payroll across a diverse workforce, including professional football players, permanent employees and a significant casual workforce.
 
Although our brand is most closely associated with Premier League football, the Group now comprises three main businesses: 
 
  1. Fulham Football Club, incorporating the First Team and Academy, with a staff of approximately 400 permanent employees and a significant casual workforce; 
  2. The Fulham Football Club Foundation, the Club’s official charity, which engages in a range of community work and has approximately 40 permanent staff and a large casual population; and  
  3. Fulham Pier, a new 365-day venue on the banks of the River Thames, comprising bars, restaurants, conference and events spaces, a hotel and a spa, which has around 30 permanent staff.     
 
The role therefore offers the opportunity to lead payroll across an unusually varied organisation, combining the demands of elite professional sport with hospitality, events, charitable activities and other commercial operations.
 
Reporting to the Head of Finance, the Payroll Manager will have overall responsibility for the end-to-end payroll process across the Group. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across Finance, HR and the wider business and will be expected to combine strong technical payroll knowledge with excellent attention to detail, organisation and stakeholder management.

Responsibilities

Essential
  • Significant experience managing or taking senior responsibility for an end-to-end UK payroll function, ideally within a complex organisation.
  • Strong technical knowledge of UK payroll legislation and requirements, including PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pensions and RTI.
  • Experience managing a large and complex payroll, involving different employee populations, contractual arrangements and pay structures.
  • Strong understanding of payroll controls, reconciliations and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, with the confidence to challenge information, identify anomalies and resolve issues.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and consistently deliver against fixed payroll deadlines.
  • Strong systems and Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to work confidently with significant volumes of payroll data.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work effectively with employees and senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  • High levels of discretion, integrity and professionalism when handling confidential and highly sensitive information.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach, with the ability to take ownership of the payroll function and effectively manage and develop others.
 
Preferred
  • Experience working within professional football, professional sport or another complex, fast-paced organisation.
  • Experience managing payroll within a multi-entity or group structure.
  • Experience managing payroll for a significant casual or variable-hours workforce.
  • Experience with Miracle Payroll and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced payroll professional who is comfortable taking ownership of a complex payroll environment and ensuring that appropriate controls, processes and checks are maintained throughout.
 
The Payroll Manager will be expected not only to deliver an accurate payroll each month, but to understand the underlying data, challenge information where appropriate, identify potential issues and continually look for opportunities to strengthen and improve the payroll function.
 
The following is a non-exhaustive list of the key responsibilities of the role:
  • Take overall ownership of the end-to-end payroll process across the Fulham Group, ensuring payroll is delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
  • Review, challenge and approve payroll inputs including salaries, bonuses, overtime, casual hours, deductions, benefits and contractual payments, ensuring appropriate supporting information and approvals are in place.
  • Oversee all payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary amendments, contractual changes and promotions, maintaining strong controls around sensitive and high-value payments.
  • Take ownership of payroll compliance, including PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, RTI submissions, pension obligations and other relevant HMRC requirements.
  • Manage pension administration and submissions, including reconciliations and compliance with auto-enrolment requirements.
  • Own payroll reconciliations, ensuring payroll outputs reconcile appropriately to the general ledger, bank payments, pension submissions and HMRC liabilities.
  • Work closely with Finance and HR to ensure employee information is accurately reflected within payroll and payroll costs are appropriately recorded and understood within the monthly management accounts.
  • Act as the principal point of contact for payroll matters across the Group, providing a high-quality service to employees and confidently supporting senior stakeholders where required.
  • Provide effective management and development of payroll support within the team, ensuring responsibilities throughout the payroll cycle are effectively delivered.
  • Lead payroll year-end requirements, including P60s, P11Ds and other relevant statutory reporting, and support internal and external audit requirements.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records, documentation and audit trails, ensuring appropriate confidentiality, GDPR compliance and data security at all times.
  • Maintain strong payroll procedures and controls, ensuring the function is resilient, well documented and not reliant on individual knowledge.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve and automate payroll processes, systems, reporting and controls across the Group.
  • Keep up to date with changes in payroll legislation and provide payroll expertise on wider Finance and HR projects where required.

Benefits

We expect to close applications on Friday 30th October, but if we receive a high level of interest, we may close the vacancy sooner. To avoid disappointment, please submit your application at the earliest opportunity.

job.title: Employee belonging to a protected category
job.location: Viale della Liberazione, Milano, MI, 20124, IT
job.html_description:
Are you a dynamic, precise person interested in the world of sport, media & entertainment? Would you like to join an international club and work in a young and stimulating environment? FC Internazionale is constantly looking for professionals belonging to the Protected Categories (art 1 l.68/99) with whom to get in touch in order to evaluate together future collaboration possibilities for one of our departments, such as, for example:


  • Supply Chain and Procurement
  • Technology
  • E-commerce and Product Development
  • Marketing and CRM
  • Social Media & Digital
  • Ticketing & Contact Centre

In order to best align your interests and our needs, please specify function and area of potential interest when sending your application. Would you like to join our team? Then what are you waiting for, send us your CV! We look forward to getting to know you!


Those most in line may be evaluated for future needs to strengthen company structures.

job.title: Stadium Operations Crew (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for Part-Time Operations Crew supporting the Facilities and Operations Department with event set-up, execution, teardown, changeovers and daily operational tasks at Nu Stadium. 


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

  • Participate in the execution of stadium and training facility events & games, including set-up and post-event breakdown. 
  • Assist with maintenance, upkeep, and organization around the facility. 
  • Maintain a safe work environment. 
  • Perform other related duties as assigned. 
  • Must be able to lift 50+lbs and walk for extended periods of time. 

Requirements

  • Past employment or internship experience in game operations or facility management preferred. 
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication and organizational skills required. 
  • Possess strong attention to detail. 
  • Must be able to perform manual labor duties and tasks. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere. 

 

Other Details: 

  • Hours of work are based off our events schedule and may vary. 
  • Bilingual applicants not required, but preferred. 
  • All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Director, Video Production
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Director of Video Production, who will lead a team of shooter/editors, manage their workload, interface with multiple departments across the Club, solicit feedback and manage expectations during the creative process. The individual in this role must be an experienced videographer as well as manager of people, who can prioritize multiple projects at once and understands the professional sports landscape and the type of content it requires. We are seeking an excellent visual storyteller who has a fresh and edgy creative style. 


 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor a team of videographers of varying levels and skillsets.
  • Lead full-cycle video productions including capture and editing of all Club video needs, such as: Matchday coverage,
  • Digital/Social pieces, In-stadium videoboard pieces, corporate partnership fulfillment, and ticket sales video needs
  • Collaborate with all in-house departments, external agencies, and corporate partners on video projects
  • Take video briefs from start to finish (brainstorming, planning, production, post-production, delivery).
  • Manage & organize video archives for all footage (Media Asset Management)
  • Elevate our visual storytelling in alignment with the Club’s brand guidelines and marketing initiatives
  • Manage lighting and audio setups for interviews and other shoots.
  • Maintain, organize and catalogue club-owned video & lighting equipment
  • Maintain strong relationships with outside vendors and continue to grow production vendor database
  • All other related duties as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 7-10 years of relevant experience in a similar position.
  • Experience managing a team of direct reports
  • Experience with a professional sports team is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of cinema cameras and lenses (Sony systems).
  •  Advanced use of Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Audition) required.
  • Experience in producing short-form and long-form videos required.
  • Lighting and set design production knowledge
  • Exceptional creative abilities; looking to push the envelope and develop and implement fresh ideas.
  • Understanding of brand awareness.
  •  Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally.
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  •  Exceptional knowledge and passion for the sport and culture of fu´tbol preferred.
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to travel domestically and internationally and work nights and weekends as required.
  • Applicant must provide a link to reel or previous work in order to be considered.

 

Compensation: 

  • Inter Miami CF offers a competitive compensation package, medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, life insurance and 401k retirement plan.

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Coordinator, Stadium Operations
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Stadium Operations supports the execution of all stadium operations functions at Nu Stadium in Miami, ensuring events are delivered efficiently and to a high standard. This role plays a key part in coordinating event setups and breakdowns, maintaining operational readiness, and supporting a seamless experience for all events.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, hands-on, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to support and guide part-time staff while maintaining strong operational standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the preparation, setup, and breakdown of equipment and materials for all events at Nu Stadium 
  • Maintain and track assigned inventory of event and operational equipment 
  • Support and help lead part-time stadium staff on both event and non-event days, including event conversions and operational tasks 
  • Serve as a setup lead for select events, ensuring timely and accurate execution 
  • Assist with general facility upkeep to maintain a clean, safe, and operational environment 
  • Support cross-functional teams as needed to ensure successful event delivery 
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Work flexible/varied hours as scheduled, including nights, weekends, overnights, and holidays. 
  • Bachelor's Degree in Sport Management/Administration or similar field.
  • Stadium/Event Operations experience is a plus.
  • Ability to interact with stakeholders professionally and confidently at all levels in the organization.
  • Must be a self-starter who is able to multi-task, be a quick learner, and be able to work in stressful environments independently and within the group.
  • Must possess strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.
  • Bilingual preferred (Spanish)

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift to 50 pounds.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.

job.title: Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Fan Strategy & Experience is responsible for leading engagement with Inter Miami CF’s core supporter community, “La Familia,” serving as a key connection point between the Club and its most passionate fans. This role oversees all aspects of supporter group coordination, including game day operations, ticketing, away match travel, and the overall matchday environment.


The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Club’s culture, a collaborative and team-oriented mindset, and exceptional organizational skills. This individual demonstrates a high level of ownership, a strong work ethic, and a deep appreciation for the sport and fan experience, with a focus on driving engagement and delivering a best-in-class experience for supporters.

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the club and its official supporter groups (La Familia), building strong relationships and ensuring alignment with club initiatives 
  • Oversee supporter group operations on game days, including pre-game, in-game, and post-game activities to ensure a safe and engaging environment 
  • Partner with Guest Services and Security to plan and manage the experience for visiting team supporters, including coordination with league representatives to ensure safety and compliance 
  • Coordinate with visiting teams to support traveling fans, including ticketing, designated seating areas, and overall event planning 
  • Support the growth and engagement of supporter groups by helping develop programs, benefits, and experiences that enhance membership value 
  • Manage ticketing needs for supporter groups and other key audiences, including season tickets, group sales, and single-game access, in collaboration with internal ticketing teams 
  • Work cross-functionally with Guest Services to enhance the overall fan experience at the stadium 
  • Partner with Community and Foundation teams to support and execute community-focused initiatives and events 
  • Assist the Ticketing team with fan engagement initiatives such as membership events, sales activations, and conducting stadium tours 
  • Collaborate with Marketing to develop and support fan-focused digital content and storytelling initiatives 
  • Partner with Event Presentation to elevate the in-stadium experience and fan engagement during matches 
  • Develop and lead outreach initiatives, including future street team programs, to expand the club’s presence in the community 
  • Support additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in sports administration, sports marketing, hospitality, or a related field 
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus  
  • Bilingual proficiency, including Spanish, is a plus 
  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for the brand 
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges 
  • Extremely organized with high attention to detail 
  • Strong work ethic and ability to work collaboratively as part of a team with a results-driven mindset 
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines 
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning, and game production 
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook 
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

 Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Coordinator, Event Presentation
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Coordinator of Event Presentation who will be responsible for providing organizational support to the production control room and Director of Broadcast and Event Presentation. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Assist in planning, outsourcing, and execution of Private Stadium Events like client parties or meetings, ceremonial Galas. Review all audio/video requests needed throughout the facility.
  • Oversee Control Room Content for Matchday with ingesting and testing of videoboard graphics. Follow-up with respective departments such as Partnerships, Marketing and others who run in-game content. 
  • Assist in rendering and loading LED Content for all stadium matches and events. 
  • Act as producer of home and away radio broadcast setup and execution, including remote coordination and transmission support 
  • Act as the primary liaison between the Venue and outside Production Companies and Broadcast Services
  • Communicate with Rights Holders to understand their contracted requirements, and work with internal departments to ensure all outside Broadcast Support and Rights Holders are accommodated 
  • Assist with MLS Next PRO match productions, with camera setups, sending A/V feeds, working control room equipment. 
  • Assist in the scheduling and management of the Control Room Matchday Staff. 
  • Act as Control Room Operator on equipment if and when needed. 
  • Clip video of any Presentations, Anthem performances, special requests, etc., from all matches and Stadium Events, and provide to respective personnel if / when available or requested. 
  • All other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with 1 – 2 years of relevant experience in a similar position. 
  • Experience with a professional sports team (a plus). 
  • Knowledge of Control Room equipment such as on-air graphics systems, replay systems (a plus).
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast paced, team environment. 
  • Lighting, set design, and A/V knowledge (a plus).
  • Understanding of brand awareness. 
  • Superior organization, project management skills and attention to detail. 
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate, both written and verbally. 
  • Self-starter with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. 
  • Physical ability to lift heavy equipment is required.
  • Flexibility to work nights, weekends and holidays as required.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Retail Sales Associate (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops and pop-ups at Nu Stadium.


What You'll Do: 

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our stadium retail store,on game days only.
  • Engage and assist fans with enthusiasm, sharing your knowledge of the club and merchandise.
  • Operate point of sale systems efficiently to ensure smooth and accurate transactions.
  • Provide product information and communicate in-store promotions clearly.
  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

Requirements

  • Prior retail experience preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work approximately 6-to-8-hour shifts on Inter Miami CF match days.
  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
     

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law
