job.title: Senior Manager, Procurement
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

About the Company: Inter Miami CF (IMCF or the Club) is a Major League Soccer club competing in the Eastern Conference, owned by Miami Beckham United and playing at its newly developed permanent stadium (Nu Stadium) at Miami Freedom Park, a 25,000-seat stadium within a 131-acre master-planned site featuring a 55-acre public park, structured parking, and over one million square feet of mixed-use retail, entertainment, commercial, and hospitality development. The Club operates a growing and complex business spanning professional sports, live events, stadium operations, retail, food and beverage, sponsorships, and media which is supported by a lean Finance and Accounting function responsible for accounting, financial planning and analysis, cash management, procurement, and investor relations across multiple legal entities.


Position Summary:

  

The Senior Manager, Procurement will be the Club's inaugural dedicated procurement leader, responsible for architecting, implementing, and enforcing the end-to-end source-to-pay (S2P) function across Miami Beckham United (MBU). This is a rare opportunity for a seasoned procurement professional to design a procurement operating model from the ground up in a high-growth, high-visibility organization entering its most consequential phase of commercial scale.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will be responsible for enabling cost containment, cost reduction, and cost control across all third-party spend at MBU. This role will design and enforce the Club's purchase order policy, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, payment governance, and compliance reporting. The Senior Manager, Procurement will operate as the enforcement arm of the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, with explicit authority relating to non-compliant spend.

In addition to policy authorship and enforcement, this role will build the Club's vendor management infrastructure, including vendor master data integrity, competitive bidding programs (RFI/RFQ/RFP), recurring and periodic contract commercial reviews, insurance and tax compliance validation, and ongoing spend analytics for sustainable cost reduction. The Senior Manager, Procurement will drive the transition to an environment where essentially all spend flows through procedures where competitive sourcing, PO discipline, and vendor accountability are the operating standards.


The role initially covers all MBU operations, with scope expansion into Miami Freedom Park (MFP) contemplated as that business platform matures. The Senior Manager, Procurement will report directly to the MBU Chief Financial Officer, and unify source-to-pay execution under a single accountable owner and function.


The Senior Manager, Procurement will serve as a trusted operational partner across the organization, translating procurement discipline into measurable outcomes: quantified savings, improved control coverage, cleaner vendor data, and defensible spend governance visible to lenders, auditors, and ultimately the ownership group.


Key Responsibilities:


Procurement Policy and Enforcement

  • Author, publish, and enforce the Club's Cost Control Policy Framework, including purchase order requirements, approval authority matrices, vendor onboarding standards, and payment governance.
  • Exercise stop-work and stop-payment authority for any commitment or invoice that does not comply with established procurement policy, escalating exceptions to the Chief Financial Officer on a documented basis.
  • Serve as the Club's primary internal enforcement authority for third-party spend discipline, including formal partnership with cost center leaders on remediation of policy exceptions.
  • Design and administer training programs and materials for department leaders, budget owners, and approvers on procurement policy, personal accountability standards, and system workflows.
  • Establish and maintain the exceptions process, including documentation, review cadence, escalation protocol, and highly visible compliance reporting.

  

Strategic Sourcing and Cost Reduction

  • Design and lead all RFI, RFQ, and RFP activity for the Club, including scope definition, vendor identification, bid evaluation, and award recommendation for new and all existing vendor relationships
  • Build and execute a competitive re-bid program for legacy vendors who have never been formally sourced, prioritized by annual spend and strategic importance.
  • Develop category strategies for the Club's major spend categories, including retail merchandise (inventory), variable matchday operations (e.g., day of game / event), third-party outsourced professional services, marketing, and travel.
  • Identify, quantify, and deliver measurable cost savings through consolidation, competitive bidding, negotiated terms, business back, and category rationalization.
  • Oversee the Club’s corporate credit card, employee reimbursement, and capital expenditure policies and administration. 
  • Partner with department leads (i.e., cost centers) and Legal on commercial term negotiation for material third-party contracts.
  • Design regular enterprise tests to ensure effective control environment around spend.

  

Vendor Management and Master Data

  • Own the vendor master data file, including new vendor onboarding procedures, periodic re-validation, deactivation of dormant vendors, and duplicate vendor resolution.
  • Establish and enforce vendor onboarding standards including W-9 collection, banking verification, insurance and certificate of insurance validation, sanctions screening, and 1099 readiness.
  • Administer the Club's contract and renewal calendar, ensuring proactive engagement on renewals, expirations, and auto-renewal exposures.
  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual service levels and escalate non-performance to the appropriate business owner.

  

Purchase Order Governance

  • Design and administer the Club's purchase order workflow utilizing existing platforms , including approval routing, expense category discipline, and system configuration.
  • Evaluate and determine if existing procurement-related technology stack sufficiently scales to the heighted business complexity and transaction volume of the organization.
  • Drive purchase order compliance from current baseline toward best-practice benchmarks (at or above 90% of spend under PO).
  • Enforce the "no PO, no pay" standard, including formal return-to-requester process for non-compliant invoices.
  • Monitor and report to the executive leadership team and ownership group on PO compliance by cost center, category, and dollar band.

  

Accounts Payable Operations

  • Directly supervise the accounts payable function, providing day-to-day direction, quality review, and supervision.
  • Own AP operations end-to-end, including invoice intake, three-way match, payment run execution, and month-end AP close activities.
  • Administer the Club's rush payment policy, requiring documented business justification and Chief Financial Officer approval for any exception to standard payment timing.
  • Ensure integrity of the AP subledger and its reconciliation to the general ledger, in coordination with the Club’s accounting team.


Spend Analytics and Reporting

  • Establish a recurring spend analytics capability, including monthly PO compliance reporting, quarterly spend-by-category analysis, and annual savings realization tracking.
  • Deliver executive-level reporting on procurement KPIs, vendor risk exposures, and cost containment outcomes.
  • Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis on the annual budget cycle to align procurement sourcing calendars with budget commitments.
  • Support internal and external inquiries (including audit engagements) as the primary point of contact for procurement, AP, and vendor master data inquiries.

  

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary Finance interface with department leads, Legal, and executive leadership on all third-party spend matters.
  • Partner with Legal on contract commercial review, MSA and SOW structuring, and any renewal negotiations.
  • Coordinate with the Senior Director, Controller and the Senior Director, Finance on treasury, budget, and reporting alignment.
  • Support the Chief Financial Officer on ad-hoc initiatives, including cross-entity procurement, MFP scope expansion, executive-level cost management reporting, and cost reduction strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required.
  • 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment.
  • Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one.
  • Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy.
  • Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required.
  • Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance.
  • Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff.
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist.
  • Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools.
  • High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

Preferred Experience

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification.
  • Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization.
  • Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands.
  • Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion).
  • Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness.
  • Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration.
  • Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related field required. - 6+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience, including 2+ years leading procurement in a high-growth or transformation environment. - Demonstrated success authoring and enforcing procurement policy in an organization that previously lacked one. - Track record of delivering quantified cost savings through competitive sourcing, vendor consolidation, and category strategy. - Deep experience with source-to-pay technology platforms; direct experience with Tipalti and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is helpful but not required. - Working knowledge of accounts payable operations, three-way match, and vendor master data governance. - Experience managing direct reports, with a demonstrated ability to develop an AP function with procurement staff. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold firm on policy in cross-functional and executive settings. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume vendor and contract portfolio across multiple entities and stakeholders. - Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder sourcing initiatives from scoping through implementation and handoff. - Strong financial acumen with the ability to identify, quantify, and communicate savings, risk, and exposure to senior leadership. - Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority. - Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure, process, and controls where none currently exist. - Bias towards initiative, is resourceful and solutions-oriented, and can break down complex problems into digestible, actionable components. - Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and procurement/project management tools. - High degree of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
Preferred Experience
- MBA or other relevant advanced degree or professional certification. - Prior experience building a procurement function from the ground up in a scaling organization. - Background in professional sports, live events, hospitality, stadium operations, or high-growth consumer brands. - Experience with real estate development, construction procurement, or capital project sourcing (relevant to future MFP scope expansion). - Familiarity with lender-facing environments where procurement discipline supports covenant compliance and audit readiness. - Experience with vendor risk programs, insurance and COI compliance, and 1099 administration. - Bilingual English / Spanish given vendor and community mix.
Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.
All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Academy)
job.location: 1350 NW 55 Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is looking for a passionate and dedicated Coordinator, Operations (Academy) to join our Operations team. In this full-time role, you’ll play a vital part in maintaining world-class operations and facilities that meet the highest professional standards.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assist with all the academy’s operational aspects, including set-up, breakdown, scheduling, communication, event coordination, general maintenance, etc.
  • Assist with managing the department’s equipment inventory, including maintaining accurate records and ensuring the availability of necessary materials
  • Create standard operating procedures, checklists, and training manuals for all areas of oversight.
  • Responsible for event recap notes.
  • Assist with IMCF II matches in the stadium, serving as the POC for the venue.
  • Execute other projects as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management, Maintenance, or related field preferred.
  • Ability or willingness to learn how to operate necessary equipment/software to complete required tasks.
  • Availability for academy matches and other events throughout the season (primarily evenings, weekends, and holidays).
  • Event/operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Very strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish is a plus.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

job.title: Coordinator, Operations (Nu Stadium)
job.html_description:
Description

The Coordinator, Operations is responsible for daily activities required to coordinate, plan, run, maintain and service the stadium and events.


Responsibilities & Duties

  • Responsible for the planning and execution of special events including partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Develop a complete understanding of the requirements for every special event.
  • Assist researching vendors and make selections based on their creativity, quality, and cost.
  • Participates and leads client tours, coordinating the event needs with the client, and helping to determine relevant equipment, personnel and services required and estimated costs.
  • Responsible for making all departments aware of special event needs by generating event orders, diagrams, etc. to internal departments and 3rd party providers as needed.
  • Assist in regularly tracking the overall event finances.
  • Ensure all events are ready for guests, clients and teams as required.
  • Support and assist Operations Managers in large scale events and operations projects.
  • Act as the Event Manager on Duty for partner, client, and hospitality events.
  • Carefully supervise load-ins and event preparation activities.
  • Offer solutions to resolve problems in a timely manner.
  • Create event sheets and post-event summaries for partner, client, hospitality events etc.
  • Provide regular feedback to leadership and participates in continuous improvement for efficiency of operations and events.
  • Assist in maintaining the events calendar.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Facilities / Event Management or related field preferred.
  • Event / operations management in sports & entertainment venues preferred.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of practices and procedures related to event planning, set-up and conversions.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and teamwork skills.
  • Team player able to handle a variety of tasks.
  • Ability to speak and understand Spanish a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.
  • A passion for fútbol is a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to move and/or lift up to 50 pounds.
  • This position requires work inside and outside of the building and some exposure to adverse conditions.
  • Ability to work extended hours, weekends, evenings and holidays as needed.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Merchandise Planner (Retail)
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking a Merchandise Planner to support the financial planning, forecasting, and inventory optimization of the club’s retail and e-commerce merchandise business. This role is responsible for driving data-informed planning decisions that maximize sales, margin, and inventory productivity across channels. The ideal candidate is analytically strong, detail-oriented, and collaborative, with experience balancing financial targets, inventory health, and business needs in a fast-paced retail environment.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


Financial Planning & Forecasting

  • Develop and manage seasonal and annual merchandise plans, forecasts, and budgets.
  • Own sales, margin, and inventory forecasts across retail, stadium, and e-commerce channels.
  • Partner with Finance to align merchandise plans with broader financial targets and reporting.
  • Monitor performance against plan and proactively recommend adjustments to optimize results.


Inventory Management & Optimization

  • Manage inventory flow, depth, and timing to support demand while minimizing risk.
  • Analyze sell-through, weeks of supply, and inventory turns to drive replenishment and exit strategies.
  • Identify risks and opportunities related to overages, shortages, and aging inventory.
  • Support allocation and replenishment strategies to ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Produce regular reporting on sales performance, inventory health, and margin trends.
  • Partner with Merchandising and Licensing teams to provide insights that inform assortment and buy decisions.
  • Analyze product-level and category-level performance to support future planning cycles.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Merchandising, Licensing, Retail Operations, and Supply Chain to align planning assumptions and execution.
  • Support go-to-market planning for key launches, events, and peak business moments.
  • Translate data and insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.


Ownership

  • Maintain accurate planning tools, forecasts, and documentation with high attention to detail.
  • Continuously refine planning processes to improve accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Operate with a solutions-oriented mindset, balancing precision with business agility.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in merchandise planning, retail planning, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel or planning tools.
  • Experience forecasting sales, managing inventory metrics, and analyzing performance.
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to both analytical and non-analytical partners.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment.

job.title: Store Supervisor (Fort Lauderdale International Airport)
job.location: 100 Terminal Drive, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33315, US
job.html_description:
Description

A Store Supervisor for the Inter Miami CF retail location at Fort Lauderdale International Airport leads daily operations in a fast-paced, high-traffic environment driven by passionate fans and international travelers. This role focuses on maximizing sales of official club merchandise, maintaining strict compliance with airport security and safety regulations, and delivering an exceptional customer experience that reflects the energy and identity of the club. 


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Maintain high store standards and adhere to airport security protocols. 
  • Oversee all warehouse shipping and receiving functions, ensuring timely and accurate processing of incoming and outgoing merchandise. 
  • Manage the replenishment process to ensure the retail floor is consistently stocked with merchandise.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe store environment.
  • Work with the General Manager to determine the most efficient layout and storage solutions.
  • Ensure all stock is clearly labeled, stored systematically, and accessible for restocking and inventory management. 
  • Keep accurate records of all shipping, receiving, and inventory processes.
  • Audit markdowns and inventory processes for accuracy and compliance with standards.
  • Partner with the General Manager to train and develop store associates, fostering a positive and productive work environment. 
  • Recognize and encourage team members through regular feedback and collaboration.
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Inter Miami CF, ensuring merchandise operations reflect the club's professionalism and values. 
  • Ensure exceptional customer service to travelers in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Support additional projects and duties as assigned by the General Manager, including assisting with retail initiatives, seasonal promotions, and operational improvements. 
  • Support scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure proper staffing coverage aligned with business needs. 
  • Provide hands-on leadership, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and holding team members accountable to operational and customer service standards.

Requirements

  • 1-5 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or inventory management, preferably in a retail or merchandising setting. 
  • Proven leadership and problem-solving skills. 
  • Attention to detail and ability to maintain an efficient and well-organized workspace. 
  • Maintain full-time availability to work rotating shifts and ensure continuous, smooth operation of the Inter Miami CF airport retail store. 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for dealing with staff, airport authorities, and diverse customers. 
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. and work in demanding environments. 
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred but not required. 
  • Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops at Fort Lauderdale International Airport.

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our FLL Airport retail store.

  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
  • Ability to pass comprehensive airport background checks.

job.title: Manager, Sales
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Sales will report to the Senior Director of Ticket Sales & Service and plays a key leadership role in driving Inter Miami CF's Membership Sales efforts. This position will be responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Membership Sales Executives while maintaining a strong focus on revenue generation, new business development, sales performance, and achieving both individual and departmental goals.


The ideal candidate is an experienced sports sales leader with a proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets. This individual should possess a strong understanding of the professional sports ticketing industry, demonstrate exceptional leadership and coaching abilities, and thrive in a competitive, fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.

The Manager will be highly involved in the day-to-day sales operation, including pipeline management, KPI tracking, sales strategy, prospecting initiatives, account development, training, and performance management. Success in this role will be measured by the ability to develop a high-performing sales culture, maximize revenue opportunities, and consistently deliver against aggressive membership sales goals.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, motivate, and develop Membership Sales Executives to achieve and exceed individual and team revenue goals.
  • Establish clear expectations around daily, weekly, monthly, and annual sales activity and performance.
  • Partner with the Director of Membership Sales to develop and execute strategies designed to maximize new Membership revenue.
  • Monitor and manage individual and team KPIs, including calls, appointments, presentations, proposals, deposits, closes, revenue, and other key sales metrics.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, pipeline reviews, coaching sessions, and team sales meetings.
  • Provide ongoing sales training focused on prospecting, discovery, presentation skills, objection handling, closing techniques, and account management.
  • Hold sales representatives accountable to established activity and revenue goals while identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Actively participate in the sales process by prospecting, making outbound calls, conducting appointments, presenting Membership opportunities, and closing business.
  • Manage and optimize the team's sales pipeline to ensure a consistent flow of qualified prospects and opportunities.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, events, partnerships, group opportunities, and other business development initiatives.
  • Assist in developing and executing sales campaigns, promotions, incentives, and strategic initiatives designed to drive Membership sales.
  • Utilize CRM and ticketing systems to ensure accurate account information, consistent sales activity, pipeline management, and reporting.
  • Analyze sales performance and provide regular reporting and recommendations to the Director of Membership Sales and senior leadership.
  • Help establish and maintain sales processes, standards, and best practices that can be replicated across the Membership Sales team.
  • Recruit, onboard, train, and develop new Membership Sales Executives as needed.
  • Assist with interviewing and evaluating prospective sales team members.
  • Represent Inter Miami CF at sales events, networking functions, community events, matches, and other club initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Membership Services to ensure a seamless transition from the sales process to the Membership experience.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the professional sports ticketing marketplace and competitive landscape.
  • Assist with match-day and stadium events as needed to support sales and revenue-generating initiatives.
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Sports Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of successful sales experience within professional sports, collegiate athletics, entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual and team sales and revenue goals.
  • Previous sales leadership, management, or supervisory experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing, coaching, and developing sales professionals in a performance-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success in developing sales strategies, managing pipelines, and converting prospects into revenue.
  • Experience with season tickets, memberships, premium seating, suites, group sales, or other sports/entertainment revenue streams strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the sports ticketing sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, appointment setting, presentations, closing, and account development.
  • Experience with CRM and ticketing platforms; Archtics and Ticketmaster experience preferred.
  • Experience using data, reporting, and KPIs to evaluate and improve sales performance.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Highly competitive, self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented with a demonstrated desire to win.
  • Ability to effectively coach and hold team members accountable while creating a positive and collaborative team environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and make sound business decisions.
  • Strong work ethic with a “get the job done” mentality.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, matches, and events.

Core Competencies

  • Sales Leadership: Ability to lead from the front, establish expectations, coach performance, and consistently drive results.
  • Results Orientation: Demonstrated history of achieving and exceeding aggressive sales and revenue targets.
  • Accountability: Ability to establish clear KPIs, monitor performance, and hold team members accountable to results.
  • Coaching & Development: Ability to identify individual strengths and opportunities while developing sales professionals into higher-performing representatives.
  • Business Development: Ability to identify new prospects, build relationships, generate opportunities, and convert business.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly changing, high-pressure sports environment.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

Assist in developing and executing sales campaigns, promotions, incentives, and strategic initiatives designed to drive Membership sales. - Utilize CRM and ticketing systems to ensure accurate account information, consistent sales activity, pipeline management, and reporting. - Analyze sales performance and provide regular reporting and recommendations to the Director of Membership Sales and senior leadership. - Help establish and maintain sales processes, standards, and best practices that can be replicated across the Membership Sales team. - Recruit, onboard, train, and develop new Membership Sales Executives as needed. - Assist with interviewing and evaluating prospective sales team members. - Represent Inter Miami CF at sales events, networking functions, community events, matches, and other club initiatives. - Collaborate with Membership Services to ensure a seamless transition from the sales process to the Membership experience. - Maintain a strong understanding of the professional sports ticketing marketplace and competitive landscape. - Assist with match-day and stadium events as needed to support sales and revenue-generating initiatives. - All other responsibilities as required.
Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sports Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred. - Minimum of 5+ years of successful sales experience within professional sports, collegiate athletics, entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry. - Proven track record of consistently meeting and exceeding individual and team sales and revenue goals. - Previous sales leadership, management, or supervisory experience strongly preferred. - Experience managing, coaching, and developing sales professionals in a performance-driven environment. - Demonstrated success in developing sales strategies, managing pipelines, and converting prospects into revenue. - Experience with season tickets, memberships, premium seating, suites, group sales, or other sports/entertainment revenue streams strongly preferred. - Strong understanding of the sports ticketing sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, appointment setting, presentations, closing, and account development. - Experience with CRM and ticketing platforms; Archtics and Ticketmaster experience preferred. - Experience using data, reporting, and KPIs to evaluate and improve sales performance. - Strong presentation, negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills. - Highly competitive, self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented with a demonstrated desire to win. - Ability to effectively coach and hold team members accountable while creating a positive and collaborative team environment. - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. - Ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and make sound business decisions. - Strong work ethic with a “get the job done” mentality. - Fluency in English and Spanish preferred. - Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred. - Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol is a plus. - Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook. - Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, matches, and events.
Core Competencies
- Sales Leadership: Ability to lead from the front, establish expectations, coach performance, and consistently drive results. - Results Orientation: Demonstrated history of achieving and exceeding aggressive sales and revenue targets. - Accountability: Ability to establish clear KPIs, monitor performance, and hold team members accountable to results. - Coaching & Development: Ability to identify individual strengths and opportunities while developing sales professionals into higher-performing representatives. - Business Development: Ability to identify new prospects, build relationships, generate opportunities, and convert business. - Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills. - Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly changing, high-pressure sports environment.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Manager, Membership Services
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Membership Services will support and report to the Director of Membership Services with the development, fulfillment, execution and overall service management for Inter Miami CF Membership Service Department. The Manager will also assist in providing leadership to the service team. Main goal is providing trainings, KPI tracking and be the day-to-day point of contact.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support the Director of Membership Services with the development, fulfillment, execution and overall service management for Inter Miami CF season ticket members.
  • Provide leadership, direction, training and support to Membership Services Executives.
  • Collaborate with CRM/BI department to assign all season ticket members to Membership Service Executives.
  • Reach an agreed upon goal for renewal of season ticket members.
  • Work with Director of Guest Experience on match day to help troubleshoot game day challenges.
  • Field and respond to all season ticket member inquiries, requests, concerns, feedback, etc.
  • Ensure customer data and profile requirements are accurately represented in database.
  • Accurately and successfully convey all key messages to all season ticket members.
  • Work with Director of Membership Service to create all applicable Membership benefits, programs, rewards, experiences and events.
  • Identify opportunities to add-value to Membership benefits, programs, rewards, experiences and events.
  • Identify areas to improve on and off game day experience.
  • Reporting of various individual and/or departmental efforts.
  • Plan, facilitate and execute exclusive season ticket member events throughout the calendar year.
  • Act as information liaison for all Inter Miami CF home games and stadium events.
  • Survey and analysis of various reporting (attendance, game day experience, etc.).
  • All other responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sports Management, Marketing or related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 5+ years’ related experience working in professional or collegiate sports preferred.
  • Experience in the Florida marketplace preferred.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish preferred.
  • Experience with Archtics & Ticketmaster ticket systems preferred.
  • Understanding of Sales and Renewal Process and be able to lead trainings around specific areas.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international soccer a plus.
  • Highly proactive, goal oriented and motivated with a positive attitude.
  • Very strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for providing great customer service.
  • Coordinate changing priorities in a dynamic, high pressure, fast paced environment.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong work ethic – must be a team player with a “get the job done” attitude.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Power Point, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Sr Account Executive, Sales
job.html_description:
Description

Position Summary: As a Senior Account Executive, you are responsible for generating new business and driving revenue by selling Inter Miami CF ticket inventory across designated seating categories. This role will focus on developing new business through strategic prospecting, cold calling, face-to-face appointments, networking, referrals, and business-to-business relationship building. The Senior Account Executive will also serve as a leader within the sales team by helping drive team performance, sharing best practices, and supporting the development of fellow Account Executives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prospect, research, develop, and close new business through cold calling, face-to-face appointments, networking, referrals, and other outbound sales strategies.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through closing, account development, and retention.
  • Consistently meet or exceed individual weekly, monthly, and annual revenue and prospecting goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with businesses, organizations, community groups, and other key partners throughout the South Florida market.
  • Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects and effectively manage sales activity within the organization's CRM.
  • Provide a high level of customer service throughout the sales process and develop relationships that lead to repeat business and referrals.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor to Inside Sales and Account Executives by sharing successful sales strategies, prospecting techniques, and best practices.
  • Participate in team meetings, sales training, role-playing sessions, and other initiatives designed to improve individual and team performance.
  • Represent Inter Miami CF at games, networking events, community initiatives, and other organizational events.
  • Play an active role in the Inter Miami CF gameday experience and assist with hosting clients and prospects.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activities, prospect information, and account details as defined by the organization.
  • Demonstrate leadership, professionalism, and a positive attitude while helping contribute to a high-performance sales culture.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

  • Minimum 4+ years of successful sales experience, preferably within professional or collegiate sports, entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, close new business, and develop long-term client relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. 
  • Bilingual skills are a plus.
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a highly collaborative team environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, mentor, and positively influence fellow team members.
  • Exhibit sound judgment, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude.
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, including nights, weekends, and event days, in a fast-paced sports environment.
  • Strong interest in soccer, sports, and the Inter Miami CF brand is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is preferred.
  • Experience with ticketing CRM systems; Salesforce and Archtics preferred.
  • Experience working in the Florida/South Florida marketplace is preferred but not required.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Applicants must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Retail Sales Associate (Fort Lauderdale Training Facility)
job.location: 1350 NW 55th Street, Fort Lauderdale, FL, 33309, US
job.html_description:
Description

As a Retail Sales Associate, you’ll help fans show their pride and take home a piece of Inter Miami CF. Be part of the energy in our shops and pop-ups at the Fort Lauderdale Training Facility.


What You'll Do: 

  • Deliver a world-class fan experience in our stadium retail store, on game days only.
  • Engage and assist fans with enthusiasm, sharing your knowledge of the club and merchandise.
  • Operate point of sale systems efficiently to ensure smooth and accurate transactions.
  • Provide product information and communicate in-store promotions clearly.
  • Keep the store organized and visually appealing throughout the shift.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support store operations.

Requirements

  • Prior retail experience preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Must be available to work during home matches, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to work approximately 6-to-8-hour shifts on Inter Miami CF match days.
  • Physical ability to lift, move, and organize inventory in both indoor and outdoor settings.
  • Dependable transportation required.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) candidates are a plus.
     

Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. 


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law

job.title: Manager, Partnership Activation
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

The Manager, Partnership Activation, is responsible for managing all partner related activities including activation and execution of all contractually obligated sponsorship elements. This person will build strong relationships with current partners to aid in the renewal and retention of partners and work to continuously increase the level of service and support offered by the team to corporate partners.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

  • Provide the highest level of service to all existing corporate partners.
  • Gather, plan and execute all contractual elements for each partner.
  • Conceptualize, develop, and map out programs that focus on achieving our partners goals.
  • Act as a sponsorship agency-like consultant internally and on behalf of clients.
  • Collect and maintain partner KPIs, ensuring a focus on partner objectives, tracking ROI and ROO, media and promotional valuations, results, measurements, etc.
  • Create an annual partner activation strategy plan for designated partner accounts to align with the commercial partnerships department and Inter Miami CF goals and objectives. This will include the development of big-idea creative activation programs and co-branded marketing opportunities.
  • Lead all upsell and renewal efforts for assigned corporate partners.
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships with clients. Learn and understand the nuances of the business of each of the organization’s partners and help them achieve marketing goals through the use of Inter Miami CF assets.
  • Plan and manage VIP hospitality events, unique experiences, and special events for partners.
  • Participate in cross functional department meetings and provide regular updates to leadership.
  • Route through the appropriate review and approvals processes all collateral material featuring the Club’s logo for correct usage, i.e., sponsor artwork, radio copy, public address script, videos, logos, print, web, and other relevant items.
  • Produce designated accounts partner recaps, assist in compiling all proof of performance and research data and lead assigned partner recap meetings..
  • Work all home games and assist with on-site partner activations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum 3+ years of extensive and proven integrated marketing experience with demonstrated success in the media, sports partnerships, fulfillment or entertainment fields required.
  • Strong understanding of MLS and international fútbol a plus.
  • Fluency in Spanish a plus. 
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential for interactions with clients, operational leaders and other senior executives.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and creatively solve day-to-day challenges.
  • Extremely organized with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong work ethic – must be a team player with a “get the job done” attitude.
  • Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing multiple projects and timelines.
  • Knowledge of marketing, promotions, event planning and game production preferred.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Power Point, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Intern, IT | Sprint Season
job.html_description:
Description

  

About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. We challenge convention, celebrate what makes Miami extraordinary and bring world-class fútbol to a world-class city. We are here to change the game.


Number 10 Internship | Be a Playmaker

The Number 10 Internship is our commitment to developing the next generation of leaders in sports and entertainment. Inspired by fútbol’s No. 10, the visionary, creator and playmaker, our interns gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, cross-functional collaboration and full immersion in the Club’s day-to-day. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game.


Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, IT to support technological troubleshooting and customer service within a dynamic environment. 


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist in responding to internal & external technical support requests via phone, email, and ticketing systems.
  • Troubleshoot hardware and software issues for end-users.
  • Document support requests and solutions in the ticketing system to ensure proper follow-up and resolution tracking.
  • Support the installation and set-up of new computer equipment and software.
  • Assist in maintaining inventory of IT equipment and supplies. 
  • Collaborate with team members on IT projects and initiatives to improve user experience and operational efficiency. 
  • Participate in training sessions to enhance technical knowledge and skills.
  • Assist with the setup and preparation of events and game days, and provide on-site IT support during these activities

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Basic understanding of computer hardware, software and networking concepts
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills 
  • Strong reliability and organizational skills
  • Ability to professionally and confidently interact professionally with members at all levels of the organization
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus 

  

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Foundation to to support the Foundation team with fundraising initiatives, game day operations, administrative projects, and community impact programs. This role will assist with the planning, coordination and execution of Foundation campaigns and events while providing exposure to nonprofit operations within professional sports.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with Foundation fundraising initiatives, including the 50/50 Raffle, Round-Up Campaign, Scoreboard Shoutouts, and Florida Specialty License Plate Program.
  • Support Foundation matchday activations by assisting with event setup, breakdown, logistics, and fan engagement.
  • Assist with recruiting, scheduling, communicating with and managing Foundation volunteers for events and matchdays.
  • Provide administrative support, including data entry, organizing documents, preparing reports, and maintaining records.
  • Assist with project management and task tracking using Monday.com.
  • Coordinate prize fulfillment, donor acknowledgments, and supporter communications.

  • Assist with Foundation events and fundraising activations throughout the season.

  • Collaborate with internal departments and external partners to ensure successful execution of Foundation programs.

  •  Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Sports Management, Nonprofit Management, Business, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Video Production to support the creation of video content across the Club. This role will assist with shooting, editing and producing content for matchdays, events and other Club initiatives.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Shoot matchday footage for social media and news outlets.
  • Capture daily events in an ENG format, as well as creative content.
  • Edit footage into deliverable content within established deadlines. 
  • Edit video projects from initial footage through final delivery.
  • Assist with post-production by identifying and organizing footage that aligns with the team’s creative vision.
  • Assist with setting up camera, lighting, and audio equipment for shoots. 
  • Contribute creative ideas for new content and opportunities.
  • Organizing assets and log footage. 
  • Assisting with matchday operations for the Video Production Team.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Film, Video Production, Digital Media, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Experience with basic video editing
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) is a plus
  • Basic lighting and audio knowledge
  • Creative thinker with the ability to collaborate within a team, develop solutions and identify new opportunities in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours and in various settings within a team environment
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus


All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

End date: June 4, 2027

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Software Engineer to support the development of internal applications, tools, and technology solutions. This role will contribute to both front-end and back-end development, helping build scalable solutions that improve internal processes, data accessibility, and business operations across the organization.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of internal web applications and tools.
  • Contribute to both front-end and back-end development. 
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using PHP, Java, JavaScript, or similar programming languages.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between internal applications, databases, APIs, and third-party systems.
  • Work with SQL and relational databases to retrieve, manage, and structure data used by internal applications.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and improve existing applications and technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with the BI team and other departments to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Support the documentation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance of internally developed applications.
  • Research and apply software development best practices and emerging technologies.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Knowledge of front-end and back-end development and general software development principles
  • Experience or coursework using programming languages such as PHP, Java, JavaScript, Python, or similar
  • Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, APIs, and web application development
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development concepts
  • Familiarity with Git/version control and software development workflows is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Business Intelligence to assist the BI team with routine and ad hoc customer insights research and reporting. This position is designed to develop foundational skills in business intelligence and customer behavior analytics.


This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market research to help ideate and develop innovative activation concepts and marketing campaigns for prospective and existing partners.
  • Generate targeted lead lists to support sales efforts for both ticketing campaigns and corporate sponsorship procurement.
  • Update and maintain accurate tracking of sponsorship asset inventory.
  • Compile weekly newsletters summarizing trends, financial news, and significant developments within the sports industry.
  • Monitor and track the performance of the team’s social media channels, creating reports to summarize engagement and ways to improve performance.
  • Execute industry research to inform team of trends emerging across brands, teams, and leagues to assist in the development of new business for the club.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Working knowledge of algorithms for classification, regression, clustering, and anomaly detection 
  • Excellent communication and organization skills, capable of conveying complex data in a clear and concise manner
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus

All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.

job.title: Activations Ambassador
job.html_description:
Description

Join our Event Operations Team as an Activations Ambassador at Nu Stadium and help bring the brands behind Inter Miami CF to life on match day. Activation Associates build, run and break down the partner activations fans experience across Miami Freedom Park, from the Fan Zone and terraces to halftime moments on the pitch. This part-time role is built for early career professionals looking to gain hands-on event operations experience in professional sports. 


What You'll Do

  • Arrive early on match days to set up partner activation spaces in the Fan Zone, terraces, suites and in-stadium locations.
  • Serve as on-site support for partner staff and agencies with check-in, credentials, water and ice, and load-in/load-out.
  • Uphold Fan Zone guidelines for giveaways, sampling and prohibited items in a polite, professional, and friendly manner.
  • Break down and store all equipment or activations after each match.
  • Work with your Activation Lead and other staff members to ensure a quality match day experience for partners and fans.
  • Available to work all Inter Miami CF home matches during the 2027 MLS Sprint Season and select partner events.
  • All other related duties as required.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in sport management, event management, hospitality, business, marketing or related field.
  • Highly proactive, reliable, adaptable, and motivated with a positive attitude.
  • Comfortable interacting with fans, partners and club staff in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bilingual - English and Spanish a plus.
  • Must possess reliable transportation to and from work for all matches.
  • Ability to stand and move for 7+ hours at a time in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to, heat or rain.
  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including but not limited to evenings, weekends and holidays.


Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Vice President, Partnership Activation
job.location: 800 S Douglas Road, Coral Gables, FL, 33134, US
job.html_description:
Description

Inter Miami CF is seeking an accomplished Vice President of Partnership Activation to lead the Club’s Partnership Activation department and oversee the strategic management, delivery and long-term development of its premium global commercial partnership portfolio.


Reporting to the Senior Vice President of Partnerships, this executive will provide VP level leadership to the department’s Directors and their teams, establish best in class standards of partner service and operational accountability, and personally develop trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers at the Club’s most significant partners, in close collaboration with the Senior Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer.


The role is central to protecting and growing the long-term value of the Club’s partnerships, ensuring exceptional experiences and measurable business outcomes as Inter Miami CF and Miami Freedom Park enter their next chapter.


Responsibilities & Duties:  

  • Lead the entire Partnership Activation function, providing strategic direction, coaching and performance oversight to Directors and their respective account management teams.
  • Establish clear departmental objectives, service standards, KPIs, accountability frameworks and consistent operating processes across the partner portfolio.
  • Build a high-performance culture rooted in ownership, creativity, commercial awareness, collaboration and continuous improvement; develop talent and succession plans.
  • Oversee departmental resourcing, prioritisation, budgets and workload allocation to ensure scalable, consistently excellent delivery.
  • Executive Relationships & Strategic Partner Management
  • Personally own and cultivate executive-level relationships with C-suite leaders and senior stakeholders at the Club’s most significant global partners, alongside the Senior Vice President of Partnerships and Chief Revenue Officer. 
  • Set multi-year strategic account plans informed by each partner’s business priorities, brand objectives and measures of success.
  • Lead senior partner business reviews and strategic discussions; serve as an executive escalation point for complex issues and lead timely, solutions-oriented resolution.
  • Ensure Directors and account teams build strong day-to-day relationships while maintaining clear executive sponsorship and coordinated engagement across accounts.
  • Activation Strategy & Partner Experience
  • Oversee the planning and fulfilment of all contractual partnership rights and obligations, with a focus on quality, timeliness and measurable partner impact.
  • Drive innovative, integrated activation across matchday, stadium, digital, content, experiential, retail and community platforms, leveraging Club and Miami Freedom Park assets.
  • Partner across Marketing, Communications, Digital, Operations, Finance, Legal and other functions to deliver coordinated, premium partner experiences.
  • Implement robust account planning, partner feedback, reporting and executive recap processes that demonstrate value and inform continuous improvement.
  • Retention, Renewal Readiness & Commercial Growth
  • Own departmental accountability for partner satisfaction, retention and renewal readiness, identifying risks early and implementing proactive recovery plans.
  • Work closely with the Senior Vice President of Partnerships and Partnership Development to strengthen renewal positioning, identify organic growth opportunities and support commercial negotiations.
  • Track partner health, delivery performance, engagement and commercial outcomes through regular reporting and actionable insights.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sponsorship, strategic account management, integrated marketing or commercial partnerships within sports, entertainment, agencies or leading global brands.
  • Proven senior leadership experience managing managers and developing high-performing, multi-layered teams.
  • Demonstrated success overseeing complex, high-value global partnerships and engaging credibly with C-suite executives.
  • Strong strategic, commercial, financial and operational judgement, with experience driving retention, renewal readiness and partnership value.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, communication, presentation, negotiation and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred. English fluency required; Spanish proficiency preferred.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, matchdays and special events as business needs require.

  

Equal Opportunity Statement

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Must have work authorization to work in the U.S. on a permanent and ongoing basis and must not require work visa sponsorship from Inter Miami CF now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

job.title: Intern, Human Resources | Sprint Season
job.html_description:
Description

  

About Us: Miami is a global city fueled by culture, connection and ambition. At Inter Miami CF, we reflect the community we call home through our courage, creativity and passion for the game. We challenge convention, celebrate what makes Miami extraordinary and bring world-class fútbol to a world-class city. We are here to change the game.


Number 10 Internship | Be a Playmaker

The Number 10 Internship is our commitment to developing the next generation of leaders in sports and entertainment. Inspired by fútbol’s No. 10, the visionary, creator and playmaker, our interns gain hands-on experience through meaningful projects, cross-functional collaboration and full immersion in the Club’s day-to-day. It’s an opportunity to learn, contribute and make an impact while building your career in the game.


Position Summary: Inter Miami CF is looking for an Intern, Human Resources to work on a wide range of projects related to HR compliance, recruiting, onboarding and administration support. This person will also be responsible for helping develop and execute various managerial projects and completing special projects as delegated by the Human Resources team.

This is a paid, part-time internship within our Number 10 Internship program for the 2027 Sprint Season cohort.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist in recruitment efforts for all personnel, interns, Gameday staff and temporary employees. 
  • Assist in onboarding process including generating offer letters, preparing new hire packets, drafting internal communications, revising organizational chart and scheduling meetings. 
  • Assists in organizing and conducting new hire orientations, training and development sessions, and employee events. 
  • Conduct audits of personnel files and assists with filings to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations.
  • Assists with planning and preparation for employee appreciation events. 
  • Responds to all staff and employment inquiries promptly and professionally. 
  • Maintains the highest levels of confidentiality of sensitive information. 
  • Performs organizational and special projects as assigned. 

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field, or recently graduated from a related program
  • Ability to professionally and confidently interact with members at all levels of the organization. 
  • Exceptional reliability, interpersonal, communication and organizational skills required. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of products. 
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. 
  • Ability to work non-traditional hours, in non-traditional settings, within a team atmosphere. 
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) fluency is a plus 
  • Passion for fútbol is a plus
  • All applicants must pass a pre-employment background check.


Additional Information:

Start date: January 11, 2027

End date: June 4, 2027

Schedule: Part-time, fewer than 20 hours per week

Inter Miami CF is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status,  or any other characteristics protected by the law.

job.title: Commercial Matchday Hosts
job.html_description:
Job Title: Commercial Matchday Hosts

Responsible to: Head of Commercial

Apply here: https://forms.office.com/e/12c4GXBGmg

About The Role:

As a host at Elland Road, you will be the first point of contact for many of our VIP hospitality guests. In this role you would be required to act as the face of the Club within your allocated hospitality lounge, creating a seamless link between our hospitality department, our catering department and our VIP matchday guests. This will ensure that our guests receive the highest possible standard of service and have an exceptional hospitality experience.

Allocation Main Responsibilities

  • Positions are offered for matchdays only, with a typical shift lasting approximately seven to eight hours.

  • Attending pre-match hospitality host / hostess briefing prior to each shift;

  • Familiarise yourself with your designated suite (which may change each shift), checking the suite and other guests facilities meet required standards and ensuring corporate lanyards and programmes are set out as per the guests chosen package;

  • Welcoming all guests into your suite, building relationships by using eye contact and escorting guests to their assigned dining area / table;

  • Build relationships with customers pre-match, at half time and full time.

  • Continuously managing the flow of guests in to the suite ensuring all

    guests catering needs are being met and all guests are happy;

  • Be particularly attentive to new guests to ensure they are comfortable in their surroundings whilst being observant towards and engaging with all guests at all times to ensure the highest levels of service throughout the day;

  • Resolving any issues as they arise to ensure the guests' matchday experience is not effected, raising to the next level and / or appropriate departments as required (usually Duty Manager in your allocated lounge)

  • Directing guests to the appropriate match seats;

  • Answering any questions hospitality guests may have about other events

    and fixtures;

  • Report any faults with facilities and any catering issues without delay;

  • Any other reasonable duties

Required Technical Skills

  • Previous experience as a host or hostess, or hospitality waiter or waitress in a hospitality environment, or front of house experience, is preferred.

Required Behavioural Attitudes

  • Strong interpersonal skills

  • Candidates must be well presented, mature, professional and have an outgoing personality

  • The ability to work efficiently in a high pressured and dynamic sporting environment

  • A good approach to teamwork and ability to manage a busy hospitality area

  • Ability to troubleshoot under pressure

  • Excellent customer service skills and spoken English required

  • Ability to use initiative and be creative

  • Strong customer service skills

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Ability to prioritise case load and manage time effectively

  • Confident and assertive

  • Ambition, passion and willingness to learn
