job.title: Performance Nutritionist
job.html_description:
Position Summary

Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines.
  • Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated.
  • Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk.
  • Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health.
  • Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes.
  • This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues.
  • Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases.
  • Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK).
  • Implementation of hydration testing and strategies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

 

Requirements

  • Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. 
  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field.
  • Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel.  Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week.
  • Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software.
  • Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.

 

Preferred but not required:

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD).
  • Soccer experience
  • Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association)
  • ISAK certified 
  • Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential
  • Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols
  • Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.
job.plain_text_description:
Position Summary
Under the direction of the Director of High Performance, the Performance Nutritionist is primarily responsible for the development and execution of nutrition services for the first team, providing individualized and team-based nutrition support that optimizes player health, adaptation, recovery, and performance. This role requires a high level of organization and communication to facilitate collaboration with team operations, high performance staff, and the culinary team.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Develop, implement, and evaluate a comprehensive nutrition program designed for optimal performance: the evaluation, interpretation, and monitoring of the nutritional status and nutritional needs of the team, using established standards of care and practice guidelines. - Conduct nutrition assessments, care planning, education, and counseling of athletes and staff, including personalized nutrition services and medical nutrition therapy for athletes with clinical nutrition needs and food allergies, integrated with the individual athlete’s nutrition goals as indicated. - Design, implement, and oversee an evidence-based supplementation program, prioritizing NSF Certified for Sport (or equivalent third-party banned-substance-tested) products, with ongoing education and monitoring to ensure compliance with MLS rules, regulations, and nutrition-related bylaws and to minimize inadvertent doping risk. - Order, interpret, and act on blood biomarker panels (e.g., iron/ferritin, vitamin D, complete metabolic and lipid panels, CBC, inflammatory markers) in collaboration with team physicians, translating findings into individualized lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations that optimize athlete performance and health. - Leads and conducts individual and team nutrition counseling and education sessions; development of effective individual nutrition prescriptions and educational materials for athletes. - This position will require strong communication skills, both verbal and written and the ability to collaborate with Coaches, Sports Medicine staff, Strength and Conditioning staff, physicians, and other support staff to ensure a collaborative and comprehensive approach to training, nutrition and recovery, as well as aiding in the treatment of diet and nutritional related medical issues. - Coordinate and implement nutritional recovery process through pre- and post-competition menus with training ground chefs; oversee and implement catering and meals during team travel with hotels. Coordinate/manage quantity food production, inventory and distribution, of other food products, supplements and beverages. oversee ordering, vendor relationships, procurement of goods and payment of purchases. - Body Composition testing (DEXA and other) including assessment, education, and programming regarding the nutritional needs. Conduct body composition assessments by utilizing and maintaining appropriate technology (i.e. DEXA, BodPod or InBody) and other manual anthropometric testing (i.e. ISAK). - Implementation of hydration testing and strategies. - Perform other related duties as assigned.
Requirements
- Registered Dietitian, by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, must be Registered and Licensed by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics and licensed in the state of Tennessee of a minimum of 2 years. - Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Dietetics, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, Biology, or other Health Sciences related field. - Excellent multi-tasking and prioritization skills. - Ability to work flexible hours, including: evenings and weekends, with possible travel. Must be available for in-person work/team interaction at an average of 15-25 hours per week. - Candidate should possess strong computer knowledge including proficiency utilizing Microsoft Office and other relevant software. - Professional, collegiate or club level sport nutrition experience. - Demonstrated proficiency interpreting blood biomarker panels and translating results into actionable lifestyle, fueling, and supplement recommendations, with working knowledge of third-party supplement testing/certification standards (e.g., NSF Certified for Sport) and anti-doping regulations relevant to professional sport.
Preferred but not required:
- Bilingual in English and Spanish - Eligible to be Board Certified as a Specialist in Sports Dietetics (CSSD). - Soccer experience - Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist, through NSCA (National Strength & Conditioning Association) - ISAK certified - Certified in Sports Nutrition (CISSN, ISSN) or comparable applied supplementation credential - Experience partnering with physicians on blood panel-driven nutrition and supplementation protocols - Experience in research, data collection, analysis of monitored stats, and evaluation of technology used by Sports Science/Performance department.

job.title: I.T. Network Administrator
job.html_description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

The IT Network Administrator supports Nashville SC’s technology infrastructure across the Club’s facilities, with a primary focus on maintaining a reliable, secure, and well-documented network environment. This role requires a hands-on technical operator who can support network administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, end-user needs, and event technology in a small IT team. The ideal candidate brings strong network infrastructure experience, practical troubleshooting ability, clear communication skills, and sound judgment around security, confidentiality, and escalation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Install, configure, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network equipment and infrastructure across Club facilities
  • Maintain and document network assets, configurations, procedures, and escalation paths to support operational continuity
  • Support end-user helpdesk needs as part of a small IT team
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to wired/wireless networks, VLANs, firewalls, and related network services
  • Contribute to technology planning and execution for matchdays, concerts, international matches, and other major events
  • Work closely with IT staff, end users, external stakeholders, and technology partners to identify issues, implement solutions, and support system improvements
  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating issues and next steps as needed
  • Work nights, weekends, and holidays as required, including matchdays and stadium events
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT administration, network administration, or related technical support
  • Strong hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, and maintaining Cisco-based enterprise network environments
  • Working knowledge of IP networks, routing protocols, LAN/WAN configurations, firewalls, VPNs, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and VMware
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills
  • Comfortable working in a small IT team where priorities can shift quickly between helpdesk requests, network issues, event support, and longer-term project needs
  • Sound judgment in handling network access, systems, credentials, confidential information, and appropriate escalation practices

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft, or VMware certifications
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki, enterprise wireless environments, and advanced VLAN troubleshooting
  • Experience supporting technology operations across multiple facilities or event-based environments
  • Experience working with external vendors, managed service providers, or technology partners

job.title: Account Executive, Ticket Sales
job.html_description:
The Account Executive, Ticket Sales is responsible for generating new revenue through the sale of season tickets, premium seating, and group ticket packages for Nashville SC. This role will have a primary focus on full season memberships and premium inventory, while also contributing to group sales and select non-soccer events at GEODIS Park (concerts, international matches, and more). The Account Executive will report directly to the Manager of Ticket Sales.  

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business by selling season tickets, premium seating, and group ticket packages.
  • Consistently meet and exceed weekly, monthly, and annual sales goals.
  • Execute outbound sales strategies including cold calls, prospecting, networking, and referral generation.
  • Conduct a pre-determined number of weekly face-to-face meetings and outbound calls to develop new opportunities.
  • Deliver a best-in-class customer experience for all clients, from first touch to post-sale service.
  • Develop and implement creative sales strategies to maximize revenue.
  • Actively contribute to a collaborative, high-energy sales team culture.
  • Participate in regular sales meetings, training sessions, and ongoing professional development.

Qualifications: 

  • Minimum of 6 months of sales experience, preferably in sports, entertainment, or a related industry, 1 year of sales experience preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.
  • High energy, self-motivated, and team-oriented with a passion for driving results.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with Salesforce and Archtics preferred. 
  • Flexible work schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Soccer knowledge a plus, but not required.

job.title: Graphic Designer, Partnerships & Revenue
job.html_description:
The Graphic Designer, Partnerships & Revenue will gain hands on experience in partnership visual storytelling, presentation design, brand integration, sports marketing, and cross-functional creative collaboration. This is an opportunity to build a creative career in professional sports while contributing work that reaches partners, fans, and the matchday experience

 

Reporting to the Creative Director and serves as a liaison between the Partnerships and Marketing creative teams, the graphic designer will help bring partnership opportunities, ticketing initiatives, and operational needs to life while maintaining Nashville SC brand standards. The role will also provide photography support at matches, events, and activations as needed.

 

Responsibilities

Corporate Partnerships and Ticketing Support

  • Create compelling sales presentations, pitch decks, renewal materials, PowerPoint templates, and visual mockups that support partnership and ticketing revenue efforts.
  • Translate outlined partner, prospect, and internal stakeholder concepts into clear, polished visual storytelling.
  • Develop branded partnership assets, including proposed activations, sponsored spaces, signage, social and email graphics, digital content, and in-game visuals.
  • Design sales collateral for existing and future products, spaces, tickets, and other revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Maintain thoughtful visual hierarchy when integrating partner brands with Nashville SC branding.
  • Support partnership fulfillment through sponsorship assets, mock advertisements, presentations, signage, and activation materials. 

Operations and Event Support

  • Assist the Partnership Marketing, Ticketing, and Operations teams with design-related assignments.
  • Support Operations with design needs for matchdays, events, special activations, wayfinding, large-format graphics, and other event-facing materials.
  • Prepare print-ready and digital files that meet production specifications and quality standards.
  • Design assets for LED ribbons, virtual signage, stadium displays, and other in-venue systems as assigned.
  • Provide photography coverage for matches, events, activations, and internal needs when required.
  • Organize, store, and archive design files and photography assets for efficient team use.

Marketing and Brand Support

  • Assist the Marketing team with campaigns, promotions, theme nights, match graphics, social media, web, email, advertising, giveaways, and physical signage when capacity allows.
  • Contribute original ideas during creative brainstorming and help keep work current, relevant, and aligned with fan and industry trends.
  • Support the Creative Director and Marketing Designers in maintaining and evolving Nashville SC brand standards.
  • Respond to creative requests from internal departments and manage several assignments within a deadline-driven environment

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of professional design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating presentation design, branding, digital graphics, layout, and visual storytelling.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint; experience with Canva and Adobe Express is a plus.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics is a plus.
  • Experience in sports, live events, partnership marketing, or ticketing is preferred.
  • Photography experience, particularly sports or events, is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of typography, composition, brand standards, and design for both digital and print environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain close attention to detail.
  • Comfortable receiving creative direction, incorporating feedback, and working collaboratively across departments.
  • Clear communicator who can build productive relationships with Marketing, Partnerships, Ticketing, and Operations colleagues.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and works well as part of a collaborative team.
  • Self-motivated and able to create polished partner mockups from outlined concepts.
  • Available to work select evenings, weekends, and matchdays as needed.

job.title: Manager, Video Production
job.html_description:
The Manager, Video Production will ensure that all video projects are accounted for and produced on time. You will also collaborate with the digital marketing and creative teams to create dynamic content for multiple platforms. You will shoot (matches, practices and events), edit (highlights, social content, paid advertising) and produce a high volume of projects throughout the year. This position will report to the Director of Video Production.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day responsibilities of the video production team by assessing requests, assigning projects and ensuring that each video is produced and delivered on time.
  • Conceptualize and create dynamic video content for multiple platforms, including Nashville SC social channels, the Nashville SC YouTube channel and MLS Season Pass on Apple TV, that aligns with organizational messaging.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Video to advance and elevate the Nashville SC video brand

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4-5 years of video production experience.
  • Previous management experience preferred but not required.
  • Ability to teach and guide video producers through the full video production process.
  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects.
  • Advanced knowledge of DSLR and cinema cameras.
  • Advanced understanding of the principles of cinematography: composition, lighting and framing.
  • Advanced experience producing videos in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of the social media landscape and the ability to analyze social media content from an analytical perspective.
  • Ability to be a team player, contribute ideas and thrive in a collaborative, creative environment.
  • Willingness to contribute creative ideas and experiment with various cinematic styles.
  • Understanding of the traditional story arc and ability to edit a piece through the viewer/fan perspective.
  • Available to work matches and events on select nights and weekends.

job.title: Groundskeeper - Part Time
job.html_description:
The Groundskeeper, in conjunction with the Groundskeeping staff, will be responsible for maintaining the natural grass and synthetic fields at a designated Nashville SC facility. This is a part-time position with majority of the hours worked being in the afternoons and weekends at either the first-team training facility (Vanderbilt Health Training Center) or at the academy facility (Currey Ingram Academy), occasionally working at the other facilities (including Geodis Park) as needed.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist with maintenance of natural grass, as well as synthetic fields at Nashville SC facilities - including but not limited to Nashville SC’s trainings, home matches, concerts, football games and rugby matches.
  • Complete preventive maintenance on various pieces of equipment and ensure all equipment remains in working and operational condition.
  • Repair and maintain exterior grounds (in conjunction with landscaping services), including snow and ice removal.
  • Maintain daily field maintenance.
  • Perform other duties to support the Nashville SC facilities.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2 years of relevant work experience in maintaining sports fields, golf courses or home lawn/landscape (preferred).
  • Must have high level of interpersonal skills to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented, and deadline driven.
  • Hours are variable and will include early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays in addition to the traditional Monday through Friday hours.
  • Ability to perform physical labor in various degrees of outdoor weather conditions, including but not limited to, extreme heat and cold or rain for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds of weight frequently throughout assigned workday.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including but not limited to, stooping, standing, bending over, sitting, kneeling, and squatting for extended periods of time.

job.title: IT Systems Administrator
job.html_description:
The IT Systems Administrator role will focus on maintaining and supporting our IT infrastructure, with a strong emphasis on Microsoft 365 administration, Okta user access management, and end-user technical support. The ideal candidate will also provide assistance with basic networking and hardware support, working with third-party IT vendors as needed, while contributing to the security and efficiency of our systems.

Key Responsibilities:
• Technical Support:

o Provide day-to-day support for hardware (PCs, Macs, printers), software, and cloud-based services.

o Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for end-users efficiently and professionally.

o Assist users with Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and OneDrive.

• System Administration:

o Administer and maintain the Microsoft 365 Admin Center, including user accounts, mailboxes, licenses, and application settings.

o Manage user identities and access via Okta Single Sign-On (SSO) and multi-factor authentication (MFA).

o Perform routine maintenance, updates, and patches for workstations and servers.

o Support backup processes and assist with disaster recovery procedures.

o Oversee the procurement, issuance, and collection of company devices, such as laptops, and peripherals.

o Maintain an inventory of IT assets, ensuring proper tracking and compliance.

• Cloud & Application Support:

o Provide support for cloud-based systems and services, with a focus on Microsoft 365.

o Assist with the evaluation, deployment, and documentation of new applications and services.

• Security and Compliance:

o Support and enforce IT security best practices, including endpoint protection and access controls.

o Assist in ensuring compliance with organizational security policies.

• Basic Networking Support:

o Provide first-level support for Meraki and Cisco network devices, including basic troubleshooting of LAN/WAN and VPN issues.

o Escalate advanced networking issues to the Network Administrator as needed.

• Collaboration & Projects:

o Work closely with the Network Administrator and other departments to support IT-related initiatives.

o Document system configurations, processes, and updates.

• Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
• Education:

o Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

o CompTIAA+, Security+, or Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-100) are a plus.

• Experience:

o 3-5+ years of experience in IT support or systems administration.

o Strong experience with Microsoft 365 Admin Center, including Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange Online.

o Experience with Okta or other identity management systems.

• Technical Skills:

o Proficiency with Windows and macOS operating systems.

o Familiarity with virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

o Basic knowledge of Meraki and Cisco networking equipment is preferred.

o Understanding of cloud services and endpoint management.

• Soft Skills:

o Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

o Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

o Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Other:

     o Availability to support IT operations

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics
job.html_description:
As the Senior Manager, Business Strategy & Analytics, you will play a key leadership role in driving data-informed decision making across the organization. This role will provide strategic ownership of the Club’s CRM and business intelligence initiatives, leveraging customer, ticketing, attendance, marketing, and operational data to identify opportunities for revenue growth, improved fan engagement, and organizational efficiency. The Senior Manager will help lead the development and execution of the Club’s data strategy, establish scalable analytical processes and reporting capabilities, and partner with leaders across other departments to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.

A successful candidate will be excited to tackle data initiatives daily, develop user interfaces and visualizations that are streamlined and insightful, and balance independent work with a healthy dose of collaboration across several departments. We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn, welcomes challenges with a positive attitude, and exhibits intelligence and flexibility when strategizing on how best to solve a problem or answer a question. The ideal candidate will be comfortable setting priorities, leading cross-functional initiatives, developing and mentoring team members, challenging existing processes, and independently identifying opportunities to improve how the organization uses data to make decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the Club’s CRM strategy, including system design, automation, training, processes, updates to existing data, and coordination with IT and external technology partners.
  • Oversee day-to-day CRM administration including data entry, data cleansing, user support and training for new and existing users.
  • Lead the analysis and interpretation of CRM, ticket sales, attendance, marketing, and other customer data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Develop and oversee strategies for building high-quality lead lists, audience segmentation, lead scoring, and targeted campaigns within CRM.
  • Lead the ongoing development and optimization of processes for scoring, evaluating, nurturing, and converting current and prospective customers.
  • Establish and maintain executive-level reporting and business intelligence capabilities to track sales, renewals, invoicing, sales pipelines, customer engagement, and other key performance indicators.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and technologies, establish best practices for responsible adoption, and serve as a subject-matter resource for AI applications within the organization.
  • Partner with Marketing, Ticket Sales, Partnerships, Finance, and other business units to improve lead generation, customer acquisition, retention, and lifecycle marketing strategies.
  • Integrate with internal and external data systems to create in-depth customer records and send targeted communications
  • Identify and drive opportunities to maximize revenues, profitability and organizational efficiency through disciplined adherence to research, analytics, automated reporting, and data-informed recommendations.
  • Organize, analyze, and present data from ticket sales and operations, marketing campaigns, merchandise sales, social media interaction, survey responses, capital expenditures, corporate partnerships, and other business areas.
  • Oversee data imports, audits, validation, and quality-control processes supporting the Club’s Data Warehouse and broader analytics environment.
  • Use programming languages, such as Python or SQL, to help develop efficiencies and automate processes.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and practices across professional sports and other industries to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with IT and other stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are implemented with appropriate data governance, security, privacy, accuracy, and user adoption standards.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule and sometimes work evenings or weekends to cover events.
  • Complete other strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned.

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a closely related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in business strategy, analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Advanced knowledge of SQL required; experience with Python or other programming languages preferred.
  • Experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Tableau preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing CRM strategies and initiatives; Salesforce experience preferred.
  • Experience working with email marketing tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing AI-enabled business solutions, automation, or analytical applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and effectively communicate findings to executive leadership.
  • Experience managing, mentoring, and developing junior team members.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect analytics, technology, and customer data to revenue and organizational objectives.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

job.title: Safety & Security - Venue Security Officer PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

POSITION OVERVIEW:
The Venue Security Officer will provide prevention activities and contribute to the building safety and security by monitoring and reporting physical security and safety conditions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium including registering and directing visitors.  Visually inspect the ID card of each person entering the building and verify that the individual and the cardholder are the same.
  • Help with writing reports on all accidents or potential problems that shall occur, as well as notifying the Security management team.
  • Issue temporary access badges to authorized personnel as required by procedures.
  • Escort visitors and other personnel as required by procedures.
  • Inspect packages and other designated items as required (including assignment as a searcher).
  • Conduct foot patrol and Stadium security checks.
  • Visually inspect and monitor designated post area(s).
  • Assist with monitoring performance of security/safety equipment.
  • Investigate and report any unusual or unauthorized activity within the area.
  • Verify credentials to control access in restricted areas.
  • Assist with inspecting bags and purses at all entry points for prohibited items, as well as operate a walk-through metal detector (WTMD) or Evolv machine. 
  • Be observant for fires and suspicious packages.
  • Be observant for spills and alert to odors and unusual sounds.
  • Check and report condition of area, exit, and emergency lighting.
  • Check external access to vital areas of the facility.
  • Monitor access through designated doors as required.
  • In the event of alarm conditions, assist in the safe and orderly evacuation of facility personnel if warranted.
  • Respond to local audible alarms on HVAC and electrical equipment.  Report and silence alarms as instructed by procedures and Facility Operations personnel during after-hours operations.
  • Identify and turn-off electrical appliances such as space heaters, fans, coffee pots, etc., that might be left on after normal work hours and could pose a source of heat and ignition for fire.
  • Be observant for trespassers and unauthorized persons.
  • Inspect designated areas for unauthorized activity.
  • Operate and monitor CCTV and access control systems where required.
  • Operate computer-based security/safety-related software and applications as required.
  • Assist with controlling access to the Stadium utilizing access control system.
  • Complete required testing of security and fire systems-related equipment as required by security procedures.
  • Operate and monitor alarm systems where required.
  • Initiate appropriate response as required for various alarms.
  • Initiate and maintain 24/7 communication with the Security management team. 
  • Dispatch other Security Force personnel and/or check alarms as required.
  • Additional duties as assigned. 
 
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Minimum of a high school education or have passed a General Educational Development (GED) equivalency test.
  • Ability to be trained to operate a golf cart, magnetometer wand, and walk-through metal detector and Evolv machine.
  • Able to obtain a State of Tennessee Security Guard License.  
  • Previous security, law enforcement and/or military experience strongly preferred.
  • Effective verbal and written communications skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and remain calm during times of stress.
  • Ability to lift, pull, push and/or carry 25-60 lbs. as necessary.
  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions to include extreme heat, cold and rain.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including but not limited to days, nights, weekends and holidays.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Data Analyst
job.html_description:
The Data Analyst supports decision-making across the Club's sporting organization through data analysis and visualization. The position will primarily answer ad-hoc questions from across the sporting organization while also supporting recurring match reporting and broader analysis projects.

The Data Analyst will work with event, tracking-derived, physical, and other soccer data and collaborate with stakeholders across the Front Office, Scouting & Recruitment, Analysis, and High Performance departments.

The position reports directly to the Head of Analytics. The Data Analyst will receive direction on departmental priorities while being given autonomy to determine appropriate approaches to their work.

Responsibilities

  • Answer ad-hoc questions related to team performance, player evaluation, recruitment, opposition analysis, physical performance, and other sporting needs.
  • Analyze soccer data and translate findings into clear, actionable insights through effective visualizations, reports, metrics, models, and tools.
  • Produce and maintain recurring reporting around First Team matches.
  • Develop and maintain accurate, reproducible workflows within the Club's existing Python-based environment.
  • Balance short-turnaround requests, recurring responsibilities, and longer-running projects while collaborating with stakeholders across the sporting organization.
  • Apply soccer knowledge and tactical understanding when framing questions, interpreting results, and communicating findings.

Key Deliverables

  • Timely ad-hoc analysis supporting sporting and player-personnel decisions.
  • Recurring pre- and post-match reporting.
  • Clear, reliable visualizations, metrics, tools, and workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Sports Analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Experience using Python for data analysis and developing statistical or machine-learning models, with strong data manipulation, visualization, and statistical skills. Additional experience with SQL, APIs, Git/version control, or data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of soccer, including tactical concepts, and the ability to connect quantitative analysis to the game.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including structuring open-ended questions, working independently, and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Effective management of competing priorities, openness to direction and feedback, and attention to accuracy in high-pressure and time-sensitive environments.
  • Availability to work in person and accommodate non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends, when needed around matches and team operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with soccer event, tracking-derived, or physical-performance data through professional work, academic research, or independent projects.
  • Demonstrated success in professional or collegiate sports, or another high-performance environment.

Nashville Soccer Club is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

job.title: Event Operations - Event Operations Associate PT
job.location: GEODIS Park, 2226 Bransford Ave, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
job.html_description:
NO PHONE CALLS OR EMAILS, PLEASE.  Thanks for your interest! Due to the volume of applications, we’re unable to respond to individual status inquiries. If selected to move forward, you’ll hear from our HR team at Nashville Soccer Club.

Department:  Event Operations
Reports to:  Director, Event Operations

ABOUT NASHVILLE SC:
Nashville is America’s “It City” and one of the fastest-growing soccer hubs in the country. From hosting the CONCACAF Gold Cup to FIFA World Cup Qualifiers and the FIFA Club World Cup, Music City has quickly become a destination for some of the sport’s most prominent events. Nashville SC has the largest soccer-specific stadium in Major League Soccer and in 2025 made Tennessee state history by becoming its first professional sports team champion! 
Position Summary:
Nashville Soccer Club is currently seeking an Event Operations part-time associate. This position will support the GEODIS Park Event Operations team in the planning and execution of Major League Soccer matches, as well as other major events, while also providing day-to-day support to the club's operations.  
Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Assist the Event Operations department on the planning and execution of Major League Soccer games, third-party ancillary events, and other major events.
  • Ensure Club and Stadium standard operating procedures are compliant with Major League Soccer’s operational regulations.
  • During Major League Soccer events:
  1. Ensure locker room set-ups meet MLS standardization requirements.
  2. Assist in servicing the needs of visiting teams and league officials on game day.
  3. Provide support for the referee crew before, during and after the game.
  4. Assist with match credential production and distribution.
  5. Lead, brief, and oversee ball retrievers during the event.
  6. Assist various departments with match day responsibilities.
  • During third-party/major events:
  1. Assist in ensuring that client needs, and expectations are met.
  2. Work with the Event Management Team in planning operational details of the event.
  3. Help with the movement and storage of the department’s equipment.
  4. Setting event day spaces to meet needs of various departments.
  • Other duties as assigned.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Knowledge and interest in sports and entertainment.
  • Computer proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong communication skills and professional etiquette.
  • Strong worth ethic with a positive, team-oriented approach.
REQUIREMENTS
  • Available 20-25 hours per week, including nights and weekends and often under extreme weather conditions. A typical game day can require early hours and late nights amounting to a 12 hour event day commitment.
  • Ability to lift and carry at least 50 pounds.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

job.title: Academy Scouting Coordinator
job.html_description:
The Academy Scouting Coordinator supports the Head of Academy Scouting through our player tracking system, scouting administration, talent identification support, recruitment coordination, recruiting logistics, trial management, and local scouting coordination. This position creates operational efficiencies that let scouting staff maximize time spent evaluating players, building relationships, and identifying elite academy talent.

 

The Academy Scouting Coordinator is responsible for maintaining and updating the operational systems that support Nashville Soccer Club Academy player scouting and recruitment activities.  This role serves as the primary administrator of scouting infrastructure, player databases, reporting systems, video resources, and talent identification workflows, supporting the club's efforts to identify, evaluate, recruit, and monitor elite youth talent.

 

Responsibilities

Player Database Administration

  • Maintain scouting and recruitment databases
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity
  • Generate dashboards and reports

Recruitment Pipeline Management

  • Manage recruitment pipeline and player tracking
  • Maintain prospect records and watchlists
  • Monitor recruitment timelines and follow-up actions

Scouting Operations Support

  • Coordinate scouting schedules for homegrown reporters’ program
  • Track scouting reports
  • Prepare recruitment briefing materials

Trial Coordination

  • Coordinate academy trials
  • Manage registrations and documentation
  • Collect evaluations and communicate outcomes
  • Support strategic planning

Family and Player Communication

  • Serve as recruitment point of contact
  • Manage trial invitations
  • Coordinate recruitment visits

Compliance and Safeguarding

  • Ensure SafeSport and league compliance
  • Maintain required documentation
  • Support audit readiness

 

Required Qualifications

Proficiency with Airtable, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and reporting tools.

Experience working with databases, CRM systems, or spreadsheet-based tracking systems through academic, internship, volunteer, or professional experiences.

Ability to manage and interpret large volumes of information accurately.

Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work evenings and weekends as required by academy events and competitions.

Excellent organizational, project management, written, and verbal communication skills.

Valid driver's license and ability to work evenings, weekends, and travel regionally.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, volunteer, or part-time experience in soccer operations, scouting, recruitment, video analysis, performance analysis, or sports administration.

Spanish language proficiency.

Experience with Hudl, Veo, Wyscout, Spiideo

Experience tagging, clipping, and organizing video footage.

Experience building reports, dashboards, or tracking systems in Excel, Airtable, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

Knowledge of Tennessee, Alabama, Kentucky and Mississippi youth soccer markets.

Knowledge of MLS NEXT, ECNL, USL Academy, elite youth soccer, or player development pathways.

job.title: Analyst, Lifecycle Marketing
job.html_description:
The Analyst, Lifecycle Marketing will assist in executing the Club’s direct-to-fan marketing strategy. Working directly with the Senior Manager, Digital Strategy & Paid Media, this role will manage campaign timelines and creative requests, support paid media campaigns across digital and traditional channels, and build and deploy email and SMS campaigns to targeted segments of the fanbase.

 Responsibilities: 

  • Build, test, and deploy email campaigns that support ticketing, merchandise, partnership, and community initiatives
  • Manage the Club's SMS messaging program, including content creation, scheduling, and list management
  • Work with the Business Strategy and Analytics team to segment the fan database by behavior, preferences, and fan journey stage
  • Develop personalized messaging for key audiences, including season ticket members, single-match buyers, and prospective fans
  • Coordinate and track paid media campaigns with internal stakeholders
  • Maintain consistent messaging across email, SMS, and paid media
  • Monitor campaign performance and report on key metrics, including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, and revenue
  • Run A/B tests and recommend improvements to increase engagement and retention
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of email and SMS platforms (such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, or Attentive), plus the ability to segment audiences and analyze campaign performance data
  • Strong copywriting and editing skills
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities at once
  • Effective verbal and written communication, and comfort working across departments
  • Ability and internal drive to demonstrate a positive attitude and strong work ethic in the performance of all job responsibilities
  • Ability to be a team player and thrive in a collaborative, creative environment
  • Graphic design and/or video editing skills are a plus
  • Ability to work long, flexible hours including gamedays, evenings, weekends and holidays as requirered
  • Experience with Airtable or similar project management tools is a plus

- Build, test, and deploy email campaigns that support ticketing, merchandise, partnership, and community initiatives - Manage the Club's SMS messaging program, including content creation, scheduling, and list management - Work with the Business Strategy and Analytics team to segment the fan database by behavior, preferences, and fan journey stage - Developpersonalized messagingfor key audiences, including season ticket members, single-match buyers, and prospective fans - Coordinateand trackpaid media campaigns with internal stakeholders - Maintain consistent messagingacross email, SMS, and paid media - Monitor campaign performance and report on key metrics, includingopen rates, click-through rates, conversions, and revenue - Run A/B tests and recommend improvements toincreaseengagement and retention - Perform other duties as assigned
Qualifications:
- Working knowledge of email and SMS platforms (such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, or Attentive), plus the ability to segment audiences and analyze campaign performance data - Strong copywriting and editing skills - Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities at once - Effective verbal and written communication, and comfort working across departments - Ability and internal drive to demonstrate a positive attitude and strong work ethic in the performance of all job responsibilities - Ability to be a team player and thrive in a collaborative, creative environment - Graphic design and/or video editing skills are a plus - Ability to work long, flexible hours including gamedays, evenings, weekends and holidays as requirered - Experience with Airtable or similar project management tools is a plus

job.title: NUW Recruitment Analyst
job.html_description:
Recruitment Data Analyst 

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary 

Closing Date:26/10/2026

 

Be part of something bigger. Turn insight into opportunity and help shape the future of Newcastle United Women. 

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and play your part in a high-performance environment, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

 

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition at the heart of everything we do.

 

We’re looking for a passionate and knowledgeable football professional to help us nurture talent and support performance on and off the pitch. This role plays an important part in delivering high standards, supporting player development, and helping us create the best possible environment for success across the Club.

 

About the role 

We are looking for a knowledgeable and detail-focused Recruitment Analyst to join our Newcastle United Women Player Recruitment team. Working closely with the Lead Recruitment Analyst, you will provide video scouting and analysis, with occasional live scouting, to support the identification of potential First Team and Emerging Talent targets.
You will produce evidence-based player reports, video presentations and supporting documentation in line with the recruitment strategy, using football knowledge, performance insight and available data to inform recommendations. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to player recruitment decisions within a high-performance football environment.

 

What you'll do

 

*       Analyse prospective First Team and Emerging Talent targets through video and, where required, live scouting.

*       Use football knowledge and available data to identify potential target players and produce substantiated recommendations.

*       Create and upload detailed reports and evidence-based video presentations to the Club's digital platforms.

*       Use Sportscode and telestration software to highlight relevant Newcastle United Women player-profile traits.

*       Support the production of clear documentation and presentations for senior leaders and recruitment decision-makers.

*       Relay information efficiently and ensure key targets move quickly through the department's recruitment workflow.

*       Attend occasional live matches to provide further analysis of potential and priority targets.

*       Work collaboratively across the Player Recruitment department and with Newcastle United Women colleagues.

*       Manage multiple assignments, changing priorities and strict deadlines while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality.

*       Contribute constructively to process and departmental improvements, while continuing to develop your professional knowledge and skills.

 

The team 

You’ll join a committed football department working collaboratively across coaching, performance, analysis, medical and player care teams. Together, we work with pace, purpose and a shared commitment to excellence, creating an environment where every player and colleague can thrive.

 

We are united by a One Club mindset, supporting each other, taking accountability for our work, and continually looking for ways to improve.

 

United As One 

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

 

Safeguarding 

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

 

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here

 

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

 

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

 

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK.

 

All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work.

 

Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

job.title: Positional Scouting Analyst – (Goalkeepers)
job.html_description:
Positional Scouting Analyst – (Goalkeepers)

Permanent, Full Time

Remote

Competitive Salary 

Closing Date:  27 October 2026

 Be part of something bigger.  Turn insight into an edge across recruitment.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you're driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you'll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

This role sits at the centre of how we identify future talent. You’ll help shape evidence‑based decisions that matter — supporting Emerging Talent and First Team recruitment with insight that cuts through the noise.

About the role 

As a Positional Analyst, you’ll deliver detailed video and live analysis on players in key positions across assigned markets. Working closely with our Head of Scouting Analysis, data team and international scouts, you’ll build clear, objective evidence that supports recruitment strategy and future transfer planning.

Your work will inform real decisions. Your detail will make a difference.

What you’ll do 

*                 Analyse prospective target players using video, data and live observation where required

*                 Create evidence‑based clips and reports aligned to our positional profiles and recruitment framework

*                 Identify new potential targets and ensure they move quickly through the recruitment workflow

*                 Use industry‑standard software (including Wyscout, Hudl and Sportscode) to support clear insight

*                 Upload and manage reports and presentations across internal digital platforms

*                 Work flexibly to meet deadlines and the demands of the football calendar

What you’ll bring 

*                 A strong understanding of football game models, playing styles and positional profiles

*                 Experience analysing player potential and performance, including emerging talent

*                 High attention to detail with the ability to turn insight into clear recommendations

*                 Confidence working independently while contributing fully to a collaborative team

*                 Experience using industry analysis and video editing software

*                 A growth mindset, curiosity, and the confidence to challenge constructively

*                 Experience working within an elite football or sports environment

*                 Progress towards FA Talent ID qualification

The team 

You’ll join a committed recruitment and analysis group working closely with coaching, performance and data colleagues. We value trust, clarity and shared standards — and we back people who take responsibility for their work.

United As One 

We're committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

Safeguarding 

We're committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care. This role is subject to an Enhanced DBS Check with Barred List Check.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Medical and sports science Job type: Permanent Job ref: 011882 Published: 9 days ago Expiry date: 28 Oct 2026 11:00
job.html_description:
Psychologist (Talent Management and Transitions)

Permanent

Location: The Knox, Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 28 October 2026

Be part of something bigger. Raise standards every day — where detail, data and discipline collide.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and play your part in a high-performance environment, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition at the heart of everything we do.

We’re looking for a passionate and knowledgeable football professional to help us nurture talent and support performance on and off the pitch. This role plays an important part in delivering high standards, supporting player development, and helping us create the best possible environment for success across the Club.

About the role 

We are building an environment where talented players can thrive, develop and successfully navigate the critical transitions that shape elite careers. You will play a key role in supporting high-potential players through important stages of their development journey.

What you’ll do

Working within our Psychology Department, you will lead psychologically informed approaches to talent management and player transitions, ensuring players receive exceptional support during some of the most significant moments of their careers. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, coaches, recruitment staff and external clubs to create seamless player experiences that drive positive outcomes both on and off the pitch.
Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading psychology practice relating to talent management and player transitions.
  • Supporting high-potential players preparing for key career transitions.
  • Developing and implementing effective communication and handover processes with clubs.
  • Monitoring player integration, performance and wellbeing across transition environments.
  • Supporting recruitment through psychological and behavioural assessment processes.
  • Developing psychological resources to enhance player development and wellbeing.
  • Collaborating with internal and external experts to ensure evidence-based practice.
  • Contributing to wider psychology and wellbeing projects across the Club.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications in Psychology, Sports Psychology or a related discipline.
  • Accreditation with the British Psychological Society (BPS) or British Association of Sport and Exercise Sciences (BASES).
  • HCPC registration.
  • Experience delivering psychology programmes within elite or professional sporting environments.
  • Experience developing and implementing psychological assessment processes.
  • Strong understanding of athlete performance, wellbeing and development.
  • Experience translating evidence-based research into practical interventions.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to work across diverse and multicultural environments.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including working with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong IT skills and confidence using data and performance information to inform practice.

 

The team

We are not just another psychology team. Our approach is holistic where we cultivate resilience, emotional agility and nurture a culture of growth, where individuals not only perform at their peak, but also navigate the mental demands that accompany elite football.

Join us and be part of a team that empowers individuals to reach their full potential. This is your chance to work in a team where psychology and well-being is not just valued but celebrated.

United As One

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK.

All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work.

Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

job.title: NUW Assistant Performance Analyst
job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Coaching and development Job type: Fixed-Term Job ref: 011922 Published: 9 days ago Expiry date: 26 Oct 2026 07:00
job.html_description:
NUW Assistant Performance Analyst

Newcastle United Women 

Fixed-term until 30th June 2027- 32 hours per week

Newcastle upon Tyne

Competitive Salary
Closing Date: 26/10/2026

Be part of something bigger. Turn insight into performance and help shape the future of Newcastle United Women.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you are driven to raise the bar, make an impact and play your part in a high-performance environment, you will find the platform, people and pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition at the heart of everything we do.

About the role

We are looking for a knowledgeable, motivated and detail-focused Assistant Performance Analyst to join the Newcastle United Women Performance Analysis team.

Working closely with the Head of Analysis, you will help deliver elite-level performance analysis support across the Newcastle United Women First Team and Academy.

What you’ll do

*       Produce high-quality pre-match, live and post-match analysis for Newcastle United Women.

*       Create individual player analysis, reports, video clips and presentations.

*       Build and maintain player video, statistical and performance-analysis databases.

*       Lead analysis support for the Academy Under-16s and support the wider Professional Game Academy.

*       Support the First Team analysis provision as required.

*       Deliver opposition analysis, including data collection to identify strengths, weaknesses and key trends.

*       Support set-piece analysis and other targeted areas of performance.

*       Film Academy training sessions when required.

*       Conduct background research on squads and help develop analysis templates and visual content.

*       Attend opposition matches to support the scouting and analysis of upcoming opponents.

*       Work collaboratively with coaching, technical and performance colleagues while managing changing priorities and strict deadlines.

About you

You will have a strong understanding of football, including playing styles, player traits and positional profiles, together with experience of working within a performance-driven football or sporting environment.

You will be confident using key industry software, including Hudl, Sportscode, Studio and Wyscout, alongside Microsoft Office or Keynote. You will bring excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to transform footage and information into clear, meaningful insight.

Experience essential

*       Women’s football.

*       Interpreting numerical performance data.

*       Data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

*       Professional football analysis, coaching, scouting or playing.

*       A sport-related undergraduate or master’s degree.

*       A UEFA B coaching qualification.

The team

You will join a collaborative Performance Analysis department supporting players and staff across the Newcastle United Women First Team and Academy.

Working alongside coaching, technical and performance colleagues, you will help create a thorough, evidence-led analysis provision that supports player development, team preparation and continued improvement across the women’s football programme.

United As One

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

Due to the responsibilities of this position involving children under the age of 18 and/or adults at risk of harm, the successful candidate will be required to complete an enhanced criminal records check with a barred list check considered suitable by the Club.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role, please click here.

For further information about the role and the Club, please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible, as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

This position is UK-based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon the completion of appropriate background checks, including references, criminal records checks and verification of eligibility to work

job.html_description:
Job Title: African Scout Analyst

Permanent

Location: Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 2 November 2026

Be part of something bigger. Turn insight into an edge across recruitment.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and play your part in a high-performance environment, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition at the heart of everything we do.

We’re looking for a passionate and knowledgeable football professional to help us nurture talent and support performance on and off the pitch. This role plays an important part in delivering high standards, supporting player development, and helping us create the best possible environment for success across the Club.

About the role

This is an opportunity to turn video analysis, scouting intelligence, market knowledge and data into clear, evidence-based recommendations. Your work will support recruitment decisions and help shape the Club’s pipeline of priority targets for future transfer activity.

What you’ll do

Working within the Club’s recruitment framework and methodology, you will:

*       Scout and analyse prospective players across multiple levels of African football, primarily through video.

*       Proactively identify players who could meet Newcastle United’s recruitment strategy, playing philosophy and squad requirements.

*       Produce concise, evidence-based player reports, recommendations and presentations.

*       Assess players’ current ability, potential and future development trajectory.

*       Research African football markets, competitions, academies and player pathways.

*       Use scouting intelligence and available data to place emerging talent into the department’s recruitment workflow quickly.

*       Create and store video clips and telestrated presentations that demonstrate relevant player traits.

*       Upload reports and presentations to the Club’s designated digital platforms.

*       Conduct detailed evaluations of priority targets ahead of transfer windows.

*       Attend occasional live matches and travel domestically or internationally when required.

What you’ll bring

*       An undergraduate degree in sport, performance analysis, sports science or a related discipline.

*       Strong football knowledge, including player profiling and the technical, tactical, physical and psychological attributes required at an elite level.

*       A good understanding of talent identification and player recruitment processes.

*       Knowledge of African football markets, competitions, academies and player pathways.

*       Experience of video scouting and producing evidence-based player reports and recommendations.

*       Experience using industry-standard platforms such as Wyscout, Hudl, Sportscode or Studio.

*       The ability to assess and communicate a player’s potential and likely development trajectory.

*       Strong presentation, video-editing and written communication skills.

*       The ability to make clear, substantiated recommendations.

*       Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.

*       Willingness to travel within the UK and internationally when required.

The team

You’ll join a committed recruitment department working collaboratively across coaching, performance, analysis, medical and player care teams. Together, we work with pace, purpose and a shared commitment to excellence, creating an environment where every player and colleague can thrive.

We are united by a One Club mindset, supporting each other, taking accountability for our work, and continually looking for ways to improve.

United As One

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK.

All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work.

Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.
