job.location: Newcastle upon Tyne Discipline: Medical and sports science Job type: Permanent Job ref: 011962 Published: 4 days ago Expiry date: 02 Nov 2026 07:00
job.html_description:
NUW Academy Physical Performance Lead

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 2nd November

Be part of something bigger. Help shape the next generation of players through world-class physical development.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.

About the role

As Academy Physical Performance Lead, you’ll lead the design and delivery of age-appropriate, evidence-informed athletic development programmes for Newcastle United Women Academy players. You’ll play a key role in enhancing physical performance, supporting long-term athletic development and reducing injury risk across the Academy programme.

Working closely with coaches, medical colleagues and the wider multidisciplinary team, you’ll help create an environment where players can maximise their physical potential while developing healthy habits and behaviours that support long-term success.

What you’ll do

*         Design, deliver and review evidence-informed strength and conditioning programmes aligned to the NUW Performance Plan.

*         Conduct physical testing and monitor player progression to inform individual and group development plans.

*         Support rehabilitation, return-to-play and injury prevention programmes in collaboration with the wider multidisciplinary team.

*         Provide physical performance support during training sessions and matchdays, both home and away.

*         Maintain accurate player records and physical performance databases in line with professional and league standards.

*         Educate and support coaches to integrate physical development outcomes into technical programmes.

*         Deliver player education on nutrition, recovery and healthy lifestyle habits.

*         Maintain and develop the Academy’s physical performance monitoring systems.

*         Support the management and development of strength and conditioning equipment and facilities.

*         Contribute to departmental projects, meetings, professional development and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you’ll bring

You’ll be passionate about developing young athletes and have experience delivering physical development programmes within women’s and girls’ sport. You’ll enjoy working collaboratively with coaches and practitioners while balancing individual player needs with long-term development objectives.

You’ll also bring:

*         A BSc in Strength & Conditioning, Sport Science or a related discipline.

*         UKSCA accreditation, or be actively working towards accreditation.

*         Excellent knowledge of long-term athletic development principles.

*         Experience delivering physical development programmes within women’s and girls’ sport.

*         Experience working effectively within a high-performing multidisciplinary team.

*         Excellent communication, motivation and interpersonal skills.

*         The ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

*         A reflective mindset and commitment to continuous professional development.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people feel trusted, included and empowered to do their best work.

We work with high standards and a continuous improvement mindset,  supporting each other as One Club and taking pride in doing the right thing.

United As One.

We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.

We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

How to apply

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

Please apply as soon as possible as this vacancy may close early should we receive a high volume of suitable candidates.

This position is UK based and requires proof of the right to live and work in the UK. All job offers are conditional upon background checks, including reference history, DBS checks, and verification of your eligibility to work. Please note, we do not sponsor applicants without the right to work in the UK.

Academy Physiotherapist (FP & YDP)

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Closing Date: 2nd November

**Please note we will also be holding an assessment day for this role on Sunday 15th November, so please try to ensure you are available on this date**

Be part of something bigger. Support the development and wellbeing of future players through outstanding medical care.

We are the heartbeat of the city, a club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar, make an impact and contribute to a high-performance culture, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

We work as One Club, with excellence, integrity, accountability and relentless ambition shaping how we work together.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.

About the role

As Academy Physiotherapist (FP & YDP), you will deliver high-quality, evidence-based physiotherapy services to players within the Academy U9-U16 pathway. Working within a Category 1 environment, you will provide injury assessment, treatment, rehabilitation and prevention support as part of an interdisciplinary team, contributing to player welfare, long-term athletic development and performance optimisation.

What you’ll do

*         Deliver expert assessment, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation for Academy players.

*         Design and implement individualised rehabilitation and return-to-play programmes.

*         Provide pitchside trauma care for training and matchdays in line with FA and Premier League standards.

*         Maintain accurate and timely medical documentation on the Club’s electronic systems.

*         Support screening, profiling and monitoring processes across Academy age groups.

*         Work collaboratively with sports science, strength and conditioning, psychology, nutrition and coaching colleagues.

*         Communicate clearly with players, parents and coaches regarding injury status and rehabilitation progress.

*         Support clinical education, CPD initiatives and physiotherapy service development.

*         Uphold safeguarding, clinical governance and EPPP audit standards.

*         Contribute to player and parent education on injury prevention, recovery and wellbeing.

What you’ll bring

You will be an experienced and player-focused physiotherapist with strong clinical expertise in musculoskeletal assessment, rehabilitation and pitchside trauma management.

*         BSc (Hons) in Physiotherapy or equivalent.

*         FA Level 5 ATMMiF.

*         CSP Membership.

*         HCPC Registration.

*         FA Safeguarding Certificate.

*         Strong understanding of youth development and the Elite Player Performance Plan.

*         Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

*         Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.

*         Highly organised approach with strong professional standards.

*         Flexibility to work irregular hours and travel in line with Academy football.

An MSc in Sports Physiotherapy, Sports Medicine or a related discipline, Category 1 Academy experience and familiarity with electronic medical records or athlete monitoring systems would be advantageous.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people feel trusted, included and empowered to do their best work.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment. You’ll be encouraged to bring curiosity, take ownership, share ideas and keep improving, helping us move Newcastle United forward, together.
About the role
As Academy Physiotherapist (PDP), you will deliver high-quality, evidence-based physiotherapy services to players within the Academy U18-U21 pathway. Working within a Category 1 environment, you will provide injury assessment, treatment, rehabilitation and prevention support as part of an interdisciplinary team, contributing to player welfare, long-term athletic development and performance optimisation.
What you’ll do
* Deliver expert assessment, diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation for Academy players.
* Design and implement individualised rehabilitation and return-to-play programmes.
* Provide pitchside trauma care for training and matchdays in line with FA and Premier League standards.
* Maintain accurate and timely medical documentation on the Club’s electronic systems.
* Support screening, profiling and monitoring processes across Academy age groups.
* Work collaboratively with sports science, strength and conditioning, psychology, nutrition and coaching colleagues.
* Communicate clearly with players, parents and coaches regarding injury status and rehabilitation progress.
* Support clinical education, CPD initiatives and physiotherapy service development.
* Uphold safeguarding, clinical governance and EPPP audit standards.
* Contribute to player and parent education on injury prevention, recovery and wellbeing.
What you’ll bring
You will be an experienced and player-focused physiotherapist with strong clinical expertise in musculoskeletal assessment, rehabilitation and pitchside trauma management.
* BSc (Hons) in Physiotherapy or equivalent.
* FA Level 5 ATMMiF.
* CSP Membership.
* HCPC Registration.
* FA Safeguarding Certificate.
* Strong understanding of youth development and the Elite Player Performance Plan.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary environment.
* Highly organised approach with strong professional standards.
* Flexibility to work irregular hours and travel in line with Academy football.
An MSc in Sports Physiotherapy, Sports Medicine or a related discipline, Category 1 Academy experience and familiarity with electronic medical records or athlete monitoring systems would be advantageous.
The team
You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach, and we’re committed to creating an environment where people feel trusted, included and empowered to do their best work.
We work with high standards and a continuous improvement mindset, supporting each other as One Club and taking pride in doing the right thing.
United As One.
We’re committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone feels safe, respected and able to thrive. Equality, diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, and we believe the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths.
We work as One Club, reflecting the communities we serve, acting with integrity, and creating an environment where everyone can be their authentic self and achieve their full potential.
Safeguarding
We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive. Safeguarding and welfare are central to the way we work, and we expect everyone to play their part in doing the right thing and upholding the highest standards of care.

job.title: Motion and Video Designer
job.html_description:
Motion and Video Designer

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger. Bring the story of Newcastle United to life through dynamic motion, video and creative content seen by millions of supporters around the world

We are the heartbeat of the city.  A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As Motion & Video Designer, you will create high-quality motion design, animation and video content across Club, partnership, sponsorship and co-branded campaigns. You'll bring creative concepts to life through animation, video and motion graphics, helping to strengthen storytelling and supporter engagement across social, digital, matchday, partner and broadcast environments.

Working within the Creative team and reporting to the Art Director, you'll play an important role in shaping how Newcastle United moves, not just how it looks. Through engaging and high-quality motion design, you'll help bring energy and consistency to the Club's creative identity and support meaningful connections with supporters across a range of platforms and environments

What you’ll do

*       Produce high-quality motion graphics, animation and video assets across Club and partner campaigns, matchday content, merchandise launches, and digital and social channels.

*       Translate strategic and creative briefs into engaging motion-led content that meets the Club's creative standards.

*        Animate existing Club and partnership design systems across multiple formats and platforms.

*       Support concept development, animation direction and visual storytelling.

*        Contribute innovative motion-led ideas to campaigns, creative reviews and planning sessions.

*        Collaborate with production teams, editors, agencies and external suppliers to maintain creative quality through to final delivery.

*       Maintain high standards across animation, transitions, typography and visual effects.

*        Develop reusable motion systems and templates that improve consistency and efficiency.

*       Stay current with developments in motion design, sports broadcast, social video and digital storytelling

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

Safeguarding

We’re committed to being a place where everyone is safe, heard, valued and able to thrive so we place high value on the safeguarding and welfare of everyone we engage with.

To access the full job description for this role please click here.

For further information on this role and about the club please visit our careers page.

job.html_description:
Club Designer

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger. Shape how millions of supporters experience Newcastle United through creative storytelling, iconic design and unforgettable club moment

We are the heartbeat of the city.  A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As Club Designer, you will create and deliver high-quality creative work that brings Newcastle United's visual identity to life across key Club touchpoints. Working across matchday, campaigns, social content, merchandise and commercial projects, you'll translate creative vision into distinctive, culturally relevant design while helping to protect and evolve the Club's visual identity.

Your work will help shape how supporters see and experience Newcastle United, from everyday Club content through to some of its biggest moments. Through distinctive and consistently high-quality creative, you'll help strengthen the Club's visual identity, bring its stories to life and ensure Newcastle United feels recognisable and relevant wherever the brand appears

What you’ll do

*       Design and deliver high-quality creative assets for the men's and women's first teams across matchday, campaigns, merchandise and digital content.

*        Translate briefs from the Lead Club Designer and Art Director into compelling creative work across different channels and formats.

*       Apply the Club's visual identity consistently while identifying opportunities to evolve and strengthen it.

*       Contribute to photoshoots, video shoots and creative productions, maintaining design integrity throughout.

*       Support major Club moments, including kit launches, signings, cup competitions and European fixtures, with design that reflects the significance of the occasion.

*        Identify opportunities to introduce fresh visual approaches, creative techniques and new ways of telling Club stories.

*       Ensure creative output consistently meets high professional, technical and brand standards.

*       Contribute to the development of scalable design systems and templates that improve creative consistency and efficiency.

*       Maintain awareness of global football design, technology and visual storytelling trends to support the continued evolution of the Club's creative output.

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. job.title: Creative Artworker
job.html_description:
Creative Artworker

Permanent

Newcastle Upon Tyne

Competitive Salary

Be part of something bigger. Turn creative ideas into world-class assets, ensuring every supporter touchpoint reflects the quality, ambition and identity of Newcastle United.

We are the heartbeat of the city.  A club with bold ambitions on a global stage and deep roots in our community. If you’re driven to raise the bar and make an impact, you’ll find the platform, the people and the pride to do your best work here.

This is a great opportunity to develop, learn and make a real contribution in a fast-paced and exciting environment.

About the role

As Creative Artworker, you will provide technical, production and finishing expertise across the Club's creative output, ensuring every visual asset meets the highest brand, quality and technical standards. Working across digital, print, retail and social channels, you'll transform approved creative concepts into accurate, production-ready assets while maintaining the original creative intent.

Working closely with the wider Creative team, you'll play a vital role in ensuring work is practical, consistent and delivered to the correct specification. Through your technical expertise and attention to detail, you'll help the Club deliver high-quality creative work efficiently while reducing production risks and ensuring assets are ready for their intended platform, supplier or environment

What you’ll do

*       Prepare accurate, high-quality artwork for print, digital, social and retail channels, ensuring all assets meet the required technical and brand standards.

*       Translate approved creative concepts into final production-ready assets without compromising the original creative vision.

*       Configure and optimise files for their intended platform, format, supplier or production process.

*       Maintain and update design templates, style guides, asset libraries and production files to support consistency and efficiency.

*       Work closely with designers to ensure technical execution aligns with agreed creative direction.

*       Act as a technical checkpoint between the Creative team and external suppliers, including printers, manufacturers and agencies.

*        Review production specifications and proactively identify technical risks, limitations or errors before final production.

*       Support creative colleagues by providing guidance on production requirements, technical limitations and best practices.

*       Recommend improvements to workflows, templates, file management and quality control processes.

*        Help introduce new tools, systems and production techniques that improve efficiency and maintain quality standards

The team

You’ll be part of a friendly, supportive and dedicated team who will help you settle in and succeed. We value curiosity, teamwork and a positive approach

United As One.

We’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and believe in equal opportunities for all. We recognise that the diversity of our people is one of our greatest strengths. We work together to reflect the communities we serve and to maintain an inclusive environment in which everyone can be their authentic self and is enabled to achieve their full potential.

job.title: Host Family Provider
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Contract: Temporary engagement

Location: Within three miles (15 minutes), easy access to The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR

Working Arrangements: Remote

Closing Date For Applications: INSERT

About the Role:

We are recruiting for host families who can provide accommodation for our Academy players to support them living away from home. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to their experience and provide vital support to the players as they develop as young people alongside their football.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Provide a homely and friendly environment for our young people

  • Support with the development of our young people in your care with their independent living and self-care skills

  • Include our young people in family life as much as they feel comfortable with

  • Provide access to a private bedroom, bathroom, laundry facilities, and communal areas of the house

  • Provide a nutritious evening meal 

  • Report any welfare concerns to the Safeguarding and Welfare team should they occur.

  • Allow access from the Club for regular inspection and visits throughout the season.

  • Adhere to any further and ongoing requirements of Host Families, as outlined in the application process, guidance will be provided by the Club on this. 

What are we looking for:

  • Provide a warm, welcoming and safe environment for our young person

  • Provide the young person with their own private bedroom and relevant amenities 

  • Excellent communication and listening skills

  • Ability to cope with the young person's flexible schedule throughout the football season

  • Previous experience of working with young people

  • Ability to promote and demonstrate anti-discriminatory practice

job.title: Financial Controller
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 37.5 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Finance, Procurement and Estates

Reporting to: Cheif Financial Officer

Closing Date For Applications: 30th October 2026

About the Role:

Nottingham Forest is looking for a Financial Controller to take charge of the club’s core finance function. You will run the finance team day to day and be responsible for the accuracy and integrity of the club’s numbers, from the ledgers and month-end close through to the statutory accounts, cash forecasting and the financial content of regulatory submissions.

The club is investing in its finance function. Alongside the core controller remit, this role will play a key part in developing the club’s internal management and KPI reporting.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

1. Financial control and the balance sheet

  • Establish and maintain a finance reporting timetable, ensuring management accounts, reconciliations and cash forecasts are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.

  • Run the month-end and year-end close, including group consolidation, with accountability for every balance sheet account and the reconciliations behind it, including intercompany and related-party balances across the ownership group.

  • Design, document and maintain the club’s financial controls, including segregation of duties and delegated authorities, and produce a formal finance procedures manual.

  • Oversee transactional finance, covering purchase and sales ledgers, credit control, payment runs, payroll and staff expenses.

2. Cash, treasury and tax

  • Prepare and maintain the club’s cash flow forecasts, including the timing of transfer instalments, to give the CFO a clear view of liquidity and headroom.

  • Manage day-to-day banking, payments and foreign currency transactions, and support the CFO on wider treasury and financing matters.

  • Manage tax compliance, including VAT, employment taxes and corporation tax, working with the club’s external advisers to meet all HMRC obligations.

3. Management reporting and planning

  • Prepare the monthly management accounts, with clear commentary on performance against budget and forecast.

  • Develop the club’s internal reporting, building a consistent suite of KPI and performance reports for the CFO, Executive team and Board.

  • Lead the annual budget and reforecast process, supporting department heads in preparing their numbers.

  • Work with budget holders to understand variances, agree corrective actions and monitor delivery, and support the CFO with financial analysis for key decisions.

4. Statutory and regulatory reporting

  • Prepare the statutory financial statements and manage the annual audit through to sign-off, as day-to-day contact for the external auditors.

  • Prepare the financial content of football regulatory submissions for CFO review, covering the Premier League’s Squad Cost Ratio (SCR) and Sustainability and Systemic Resilience (SSR) rules, the UEFA Club Licensing and Financial Sustainability Regulations, and the Independent Football Regulator’s licensing requirements.

  • Build and maintain the models, reconciliations and workings that support each submission, so that every filing is accurate, fully evidenced and delivered on time.

  • Manage relationships with tax advisers, insurers, banks and other providers, and support due diligence and other projects as required.

5. Systems and improvement

  • Own the finance systems, protecting data integrity and supporting system implementations and automation.

  • Keep improving how the function works so that reporting becomes faster, more reliable and more useful to the people who rely on it.

6. Leading the team

  • Lead, coach and develop the finance team, setting clear objectives, standards and development plans for each direct report.

  • Build a culture of ownership, mutual support and open communication, particularly when deadlines are tight.

What are we looking for:

Essential

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with strong technical knowledge of UK GAAP, IFRS and UK tax compliance.

  • A proven record of running the close, controls, cash forecasting and statutory reporting in a complex organisation, with direct ownership of the balance sheet.

  • Experience leading and developing a finance team.

  • Experience developing management and KPI reporting for senior stakeholders.

  • Advanced Excel skills and confidence with ERP and accounting systems.

  • A clear communicator who stays calm and organised under pressure, with a track record of hitting hard deadlines.

Desirable

  • Audit training in professional practice.

  • Experience in football, wider sport or entertainment, particularly with Premier League, UEFA or other football financial regulation.

  • Involvement in a finance system implementation or process automation project.

  • Experience of foreign currency transactions and multi-entity group reporting.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.

job.title: Hospitality Sales Executive
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 37.5 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Hospitality

Reporting to: Head of Hospitality Sales

Closing Date For Applications: 3rd November 2026

About the Role:

To maximise matchday hospitality revenue through proactive sales, business development and high-conversion enquiry management, while building and maintaining strong client relationships that drive retention, renewals and repeat business.

The role will also support the successful operational delivery of matchdays, taking ownership of a designated hospitality area and assisting with pre-matchday preparation, client management and the smooth running of the hospitality operation.

The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership of their sales performance, proactively create new business opportunities and consistently deliver an excellent client experience, while being able to switch seamlessly between a sales-focused and operational mindset depending on the demands of the football calendar.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Sales & Business Development

  • Proactively generate new hospitality sales through outbound calling, email prospecting, networking, referrals and other sales activity.

  • Respond quickly and professionally to inbound hospitality enquiries, taking ownership of the sales process from initial enquiry through to confirmed booking.

  • Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell across Nottingham Forest's range of hospitality packages and experiences.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing clients, encouraging repeat business and maximising retention.

  • Proactively contact previous hospitality clients and lapsed customers to identify opportunities for future fixtures.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective clients and consistently work towards agreed sales targets.

  • Research and identify new corporate and private client opportunities within relevant markets.

  • Develop relationships with businesses, agencies, event organisers and individuals who may have an interest in Nottingham Forest hospitality.

  • Follow up all enquiries, leads and opportunities effectively and ensure no potential sales opportunity is left unattended.

  • Support the Head of Hospitality Sales, Senior Hospitality Sales Manager and wider team with sales campaigns, initiatives and promotional activity.

  • Take ownership of personal sales targets and contribute to the wider team's commercial objectives.

  • Attend networking events, client meetings and other opportunities to represent Nottingham Forest and promote the Club's hospitality offering.

Matchday & Operations

  • Take ownership of your designated hospitality area on matchdays.

  • Ensure your allocated hospitality space is fully prepared and ready for clients ahead of kick-off.

  • Assist the Operations Manager & Senior Hospitality Sales Manager with pre-matchday preparation, including table plans, seating allocations, guest lists and other operational requirements.

  • Liaise with internal departments and matchday teams to ensure the smooth running of your designated area.

  • Welcome and look after hospitality clients within your allocated area.

  • Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the matchday experience.

  • Deal professionally and promptly with client comments, queries and complaints, escalating issues where appropriate.

  • Complete other matchday operational duties as reasonably required by the Hospitality Management team.

What are we looking for:

  • Proven experience in a proactive sales environment, with the ability to generate new business through outbound calling, prospecting and relationship building, alongside responding effectively to inbound enquiries.

  • Demonstrable experience of working towards individual and team sales targets, with a strong commercial focus and a track record of converting opportunities into revenue.

  • Experience within football, sport, hospitality, events or a similar fast-paced customer-facing environment is desirable.

  • An understanding of the behind-the-scenes operations of a football club, with an appreciation of the demands and time-sensitive nature of matchdays.

  • Excellent attention to detail, with strong numeracy and administrative skills.

  • Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise effectively, manage your own workload and take ownership of tasks without requiring constant supervision.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence dealing with clients, prospective customers, colleagues and members of the public at all levels.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.

job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:

Contract: Full Time, 37.5 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Finance, Procurement and Estates

Reporting to: Financial Controller

Closing Date For Applications: 6th November 2026

About the Role:

The Accounts Assistant looks after the Club’s day-to-day cash and banking transactions. The role covers daily bank reconciliations and postings, Ticket Office banking, allocating customer receipts and chasing overdue debts, the fixed asset register, and processing staff expense claims and company credit card spend.

You will prepare reconciliations for review by the Management Accountant, support the wider finance team at month-end and audit, and help keep the finance inbox and records in good order

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Cash and banking

  • Reconcile all Club bank accounts daily, investigating and clearing reconciling items, for review by the Management Accountant.

  • Post bank receipts, direct debits and other bank transactions on Business Central, making sure they are correctly coded and allocated.

  • Reconcile the Ticket Office banking sheets daily, confirming all figures agree to cash received and resolving any queries.

Receivables

  • Allocate cash received to customer accounts promptly and accurately.

  • Chase overdue balances and escalate long-standing debts.

Fixed assets

  • Maintain the Club’s fixed asset register, making sure new assets are captured and the correct depreciation policies applied.

  • Prepare and post the monthly depreciation journal, making sure it agrees to the fixed asset register.

Balance sheet and audit

  • Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations for bank, floats, petty cash, sundry debtors, sundry creditors and fixed assets, for review by the Management Accountant.

  • Provide supporting information for your areas to the interim and year-end audits within the timeframe set.

Expenses and credit cards

  • Process staff expense claims and company credit card statements in the expense system, chasing any missing receipts.

  • Flag any spend outside the expenses policy to the Management Accountant.

Finance administration

  • Help manage the finance inbox, responding to routine enquiries and passing supplier invoice queries to the purchase ledger team.

  • Keep electronic and physical finance records organised and retained in line with Club procedures.

General finance support

  • Support the wider finance team with month-end and ad hoc projects as required.

  • Suggest practical improvements to finance processes.

  • Carry out any other ad hoc duties required.

Essential

  • AAT qualified or part-qualified, or studying towards AAT, CIMA or ACCA.

  • Previous experience in a finance or accounts role.

  • Experience of bank and balance sheet reconciliations and cash allocation.

  • Good Excel skills and competent with Microsoft Office applications.

  • Strong attention to detail and able to manage high transaction volumes to daily deadlines.

  • A clear communicator, confident dealing with customers and colleagues across the Club.

  • Able to handle confidential financial information with discretion.

Desirable

  • Experience within the sports, leisure or events environment.

Personal attributes

  • Professional, reliable and trustworthy.

  • Positive and flexible approach to work.

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. job.title: Management Accountant
job.location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 37.5 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Finance

Reporting to: Financial Controller

Closing Date For Applications: 6th November 2026

About the Role:

The Management Accountant produces monthly cost centre reports, prepares departmental budgets and forecasts, reconciles the balance sheet and supports the Club’s cash and treasury management. The role leads on all financial matters for Nottingham Forest Women, looks after the Club’s expense and credit card system, and helps with regulatory submissions, month-end and the audit.

You will work closely with the finance team and managers across the Club and help improve how we report and control our numbers.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Departmental reporting and budgets

  • Produce accurate monthly cost centre reports to help managers make good decisions.

  • Lead monthly meetings with department managers so they understand their monthly and full-year numbers.

  • Work with cost centre managers to prepare their departmental budgets and forecasts.

  • Write clear commentary explaining what has changed against budget, and why.

  • Look at financial data to spot trends, risks and savings, and raise them early.

Cash and treasury

  • Prepare the daily cash position across all Club bank accounts.

  • Update the rolling cash flow forecast each week and explain any changes from the previous version.

  • Prepare payment runs for approval, making sure every invoice is properly approved before it is paid.

  • Review the daily bank reconciliations and make sure unmatched items are cleared quickly.

  • Track loan and facility balances, interest and repayment dates, and help prepare lender reporting.

  • Manage foreign currency payments and receipts, and keep bank mandates and signatory lists up to date.

  • Report on money owed to the Club and agree on actions on overdue amounts.

Month-end and balance sheet

  • Post month-end journals, accruals and prepayments for your areas.

  • Complete monthly balance sheet reconciliations, investigating and clearing any differences quickly.

Nottingham Forest Women

  • Manage day-to-day finances under the Financial Controllers oversight.

  • Prepare budgets, forecasts, monthly board packs, VAT returns and league financial submissions for review.

  • Prepare payment runs for approval and maintain the player registrations schedule.

  • Complete monthly balance sheet reconciliations and prepare audit information.

  • Act as the main finance contact for the Women’s Team, escalating significant matters to the Financial Controller.

Regulation, audit and controls

  • Help prepare the Club’s regulatory submissions, such as Premier League financial returns, by providing accurate schedules and data on time.

  • Keep up to date with football finance rules and accounting standards, so the Club stays compliant.

  • Prepare audit schedules and work with the external auditors on the interim and year-end audits, for Nottingham Forest Women and the wider Club, so sign-off happens on time.

  • Own the expenses and company credit card policy and review the claims and card spend processed by the Accounts Assistant.

  • Help keep strong financial controls and suggest and make practical improvements to processes and reporting.

Working with others

  • Work with other departments, such as commercial, retail, ticketing, HR and legal, to get the right information and keep reporting consistent.

  • Use Excel, Jet Reports and AI tools such as Copilot to make reporting quicker and more accurate.

  • Carry out any other ad hoc duties required

What are we looking for:

Essential

  • CIMA, ACCA or ACA qualified, or part-qualified and actively studying.

  • Proven experience of cost centre reporting, budgeting, month-end and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Experience of cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliations.

  • Strong Excel skills, and confident using AI tools such as Copilot to work more efficiently.

  • A clear communicator, able to explain the numbers to people at all levels, in writing and in person.

  • Able to manage several deadlines at once in a fast-moving environment.

  • Able to handle confidential financial information with discretion.

Desirable

  • Experience in professional sport, ideally football and women’s football.

  • Experience of Business Central/Dynamics 365 and Jet Reports.

  • Treasury experience, including loan facilities and foreign currency.

  • Understanding of football finance rules and regulatory returns.

  • Audit experience, either in practice or supporting audits in industry.

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. job.title: PDP Physiotherapist
job.location: The Nigel Doughty Academy, Nottingham, NG2 7SR, GB
job.html_description:
Salary: Please state your expectations within your application

Contract: Full Time, 42 hours a week

Location: The City Ground, Nottingham, NG2 5FJ

Department: Academy Sports Science and Medical

Reporting to: Head of Academy Physiotherapy

Closing Date For Applications: 6th November 2026

About the Role:

This post is expected to involve contributing significantly to both the Medical and Performance departments to optimise the availability and enhance the long-term athletic development of Nottingham Forest Academy players through optimal service provision in the medical department. The role will require the individual to assist in the medical management, co-ordination and supervision of the of the PDP players, including all aspects of medical screening, injury assessment, diagnosis, management and prevention strategies in line with evidence-based practice. To assist the Head of Academy Physiotherapy in the day-to-day running of the medical department, working as a mentor for the junior staff.

The Perks of the Job:

  • Opportunity to access tickets for events at The City Ground.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.

  • Access to high street and gym discounts.

  • Discount within our Club shop.

  • Free on-site parking.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

Management of Injuries:

  • To primarily work with the B Team squad providing physiotherapy services.

  • To lead on the treatment and management of injuries sustained to players in the PDP squads, working closely with the performance staff to co-ordinate and deliver evidence and performance-based rehab programmes.

  • To standardise the management of injuries by assisting in the development and structure of injury rehabilitation protocols and philosophy.

  • To monitor the effectiveness of injury management principles through clinical injury audits and training availability.

  • To ensure effective, appropriate and thorough communication of injury updates are provided to the player, coaching staff and other relevant staff members.

  • To assist the Head of Academy Performance & Medical and Head of Academy Physiotherapy in the provision of physiotherapy services across all age groups and to help oversee the use of part time physiotherapists and sports therapists in their provision of medical care to all players in the Academy.

Injury Prevention:

  • To provide musculoskeletal screening/profiling for all Academy players and integrate this with the Club medical records.

  • To lead the musculoskeletal screening/profiling for PDP players and assist with the process for all Academy players and integrate this with the Club medical records.

  • To work alongside the performance staff to deliver individualised effective injury prevention strategies in both individual and group sessions.

  • To liaise effectively with the Academy coaching staff on a daily basis to keep them informed of players’ availability for Academy matches and training.

  • To work alongside the performance staff to deliver first class recovery and injury prevention strategies to all players both immediately after games and on recovery days.

  • To ensure all players are educated on the importance of recovery, health and athletic development.

Pre-Signing Medicals & Medical Consultations:

  • To assist co-ordinate the pre-signing medical assessments of all Academy players and trialist as required including the writing of formalised pre-signing medical reports.

  • To assist the Head of Academy Performance & Medical and Head of Academy Physiotherapy in escalating clinical cases for imaging and/or consultant referrals.

  • To accompany players to medical consultations at short notice either in this country or abroad. Ensuring best practice is always followed and ensuring the player receives optimal care and advice, providing clinical handovers pre and post appointment.

  • To assist the Academy Doctor in co-ordinating the cardiac screening for the PDP squads in line with FA regulations.

  • To manage the FA whereabouts schedule for the PDP squads and assist with the education of players regarding their anti-doping responsibilities.

Medical Provision at Matches/Training Sessions/Tours:

  • To provide physiotherapy match day cover for B Team games and assist other age groups when needed.

  • To assist in organisation and implementation of the medical provision for all training camps for the PDP squads as required.

  • To ensure all medical equipment and procedures are regularly reviewed and maintained at the training ground and at all training and match venues under the guidance of the Head of Academy Physiotherapy.

Management Responsibilities:

  • To take an active role in all medical meetings, MDT meetings and other planning meetings.

  • To take a mentoring role within the department, working as a mentor for junior physiotherapists and being pro-active with assisting CPD for the part time physiotherapists.

  • To assist in the production of an injury audit on a monthly and annual basis for the Academy and feedback to provide accountability for the department and actively seek to follow best practice.

  • To ensure appointments are made for consultations and appropriate travel arrangements made for all Academy players as required, ensuring the 1st Team Medical Department are notified in advance to manage the Club’s Health Partners insurance scheme.

CPD:

  • To assist with delivery and organisation of in-service training sessions in conjunction with the Head of Academy Performance & Medical and Head of Academy Physiotherapy, including the creation of a CPD department pathway to ensure the on-going development of knowledge and skills.

  • To take responsibility for continued professional development to ensure regular attendance of appropriate courses, conferences and keep an up-to-date file of CPD achievements, feeding back any relevant learning points to the department.

Professional Standards:

  • To produce daily reports of injured development players, ensuring all medical notes are up to date within 24 hours of treatment and in line with CSP core standards.

  • To ensure all medical documents are maintained in line with information governance principles.

  • To work with the Safeguarding team to highlight cases for attention through the appropriate channels as required and ensure all relevant training qualifications are maintained.

  • To always maintain a flexible approach to work, including the requirement to undertake other duties and responsibilities as required from time to time.

  • To keep confidential any information gained regarding the charity, Club and its personnel.

  • To ensure compliance with all relevant Club policies, including health and safety policies.

  • To always support Nottingham Forest FC in their aims and objectives.

  • To always represent Nottingham Forest FC in a professional manner.

What are we looking for:

Essential:

  • BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy or higher degree

  • Member of the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC)

  • Member of the Chartered Society of Physiotherapists (MCSP)

  • Valid ATMMiF Qualification

  • Indemnity through professional registration to £5 million liability

  • Minimum of 2 years post qualification experience

  • Experience of working within a multidisciplinary team

  • Sports Medicine environment preferably with younger athletes

  • Excellent clinical reasoning and manual therapy skills

  • Excellent problem solving and decision-making skills

  • Excellent range of clinical treatment skills an emphasis on rehabilitation

  • Excellence in the understanding and delivery of rehabilitation

  • Medicine from plinth to pitch

  • Management skills to manage a multidisciplinary group of part time practitioners within the Academy Medicine department

  • Set and maintain high standards of work performance and deliver quality consistently and effectively

  • A good understanding of the principles of human performance and how they relate to clinical sports medicine

  • A learning pathway showing the development of a strong evolving clinical paradigm in the field of Physiotherapy (minimum of 36 hours CPD annually to maintain professional registration)

  • Good knowledge of injury screening, diagnostics, manual therapy, injury prevention and recovery strategies

  • Ability to lead group sessions and deliver gym and pitch-based programmes to groups and individuals particularly to adolescents

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills that are clear, engaging and responsive to convey complex information

  • Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage competing demands and deadlines

  • Hold a full current up to date driving licence

  • Proactive and engaging style with a winning attitude and co-do approach. Flexible approach and attitude to working hours

  • Highest standards of professionalism and personal conduct – especially around the issue of confidentiality

  • Long term commitment to working within a multi-disciplinary medical team

Desirable:

  • Higher (MSc) Sports Medicine Degree

  • Sports Science Diploma/Degree

  • UKSCA/strength and conditioning qualifications

  • Playing experience to a high level

Forest For Everyone

We aim to create a culture which embraces and celebrates our differences, enables individuals to feel comfortable, maximise their potential and eliminate discrimination.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified persons, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital / civil partnership status, pregnancy / maternity leave, race, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Nottingham Forest Football Club is a signatory of the FA’s Football Leadership Diversity Code. We are committed to developing policies to promote equal opportunities and diversity within our workforce. To monitor our progress against these commitments, we Invite all applicants to provide diversity data during the application process.

Disability Confident Committed Employer

We are a Disability Confident Committed employer.  We encourage applications from people with disabilities and long-term health conditions.  If you need disability-related adjustments to the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application.

If you are likely to meet the definition of being a "disabled person" according to the Equality Act 2010, you may be eligible to apply for an interview via the Disability Confident Scheme - please indicate this in your application form below.  The information you share with us about your health or disability will not be used in recruitment selections.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

As part of the Club’s commitment to safeguarding, the successful applicant may be required to undergo a Disclosure Barring Service (“DBS”) check. The level of check required will depend on the requirements of the role. Individuals will be asked to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, warnings or bind-overs that they are required to disclose for the level of check applicable to the role, in accordance with the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 (as amended) and the DBS filtering rules. The results of any check will be considered on an individual basis, and the Club will act proportionately in deciding whether to proceed with the appointment. The Club reserves the right to carry out risk assessments where content has been disclosed if it feels that it is relevant to the job requirements of the role. Failure to satisfy the Club, FA’s and the PL's safeguarding requirements may lead to the job offer being withdrawn or, if they have already started employment, summary termination of the employment, in accordance with the Club's disciplinary procedures

Health and Safety

Nottingham Forest is committed to maintaining a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, visitors, and guests. All employees are expected to comply with company health and safety policies, procedures and risk assessments, use equipment and PPE correctly and report any hazards, accidents and near misses. Appropriate training will be provided to ensure everyone understands their health and safety responsibilities.

job.title: Commercial Sustainability Intern
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: UEFA / Social & Environmental Sustainability
Contract type: Maximum-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: asap
End date: 30/04/2027

Main goal

UEFA’s mission is to inspire, activate and accelerate collective action to generate social impact and respect for the environment across European football.
The role will support the Senior Commercial Sustainability Expert in implementing the UEFA Football Sustainability Strategy 2030 in collaboration with commercial partners.

The Commercial Sustainability Intern will work in close collaboration with UEFA's sustainability team and other internal and external stakeholders to support the roll-out and review of the commercial sustainability strategy, the management of UEFA sustainability partners' accounts, community and partner engagement projects, marketing intelligence and reporting, and asset development.

Key responsibilities

Commercial sustainability strategy and value creation
• Supporting the roll-out and review of the commercial sustainability strategy
• Contributing to the development of business cases, presentations and briefing materials that demonstrate the benefits and impact of commercial sustainability initiatives
• Helping to identify opportunities to strengthen sustainability integration across UEFA competitions, events and stakeholder activities

Account management and commercial partner sustainability community
• Supporting with account management tasks relating to existing impact partnerships
• Assisting in weekly meetings and steering committee meetings
• Supporting engagement activities with UEFA stakeholders, national associations, leagues, clubs, commercial partners and sustainability experts
• Helping to prepare community initiatives, e.g. workshops, webinars, events and working groups
• Providing project management support

Market intelligence and reporting
• Monitoring sustainability trends, regulatory developments, stakeholder expectations and emerging best practices relevant to sport and entertainment
• Conducting benchmarking and competitor analysis to identify opportunities and innovations that can support UEFA's sustainability ambitions
• Preparing concise research papers, market insights and executive briefings for internal stakeholders
• Contributing to the preparation of reports, dashboards, presentations and performance updates

Operational support
• Providing administrative and organisational support for sustainability initiatives, meetings, events and stakeholder engagements
• Supporting with budgeting, procurement, logistics, agenda planning and documentation processes
• Maintaining project records and supporting effective knowledge management within the team
• Performing project management tasks relating to business and asset development

Requirements

Experience:

  • Previous experience in sponsorship and account management would be a plus

Education:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in business management, economics, sustainability, environmental sciences, sports management or a related field

Languages:

  • English / Proficient
  • Knowledge of one or more European languages would be an asset

Other requirements:

  • Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected
  • Strong interest in sustainability as a driver of organisational value, innovation and stakeholder engagement
  • Knowledge of sustainability frameworks, standards, and emerging ESG developments
  • Affinity with football and the wider sports industry
  • Experience conducting research and analysis and preparing presentations or business reports is an asset

Want to stay updated on our latest job opportunities, events, and behind-the-scenes insights? Join us on LinkedIn.

UEFA welcomes applications from all, actively working to ensure that we are an inclusive employer that finds the best candidate for our positions, regardless of aspects such as sex, gender identification, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity or nationality.

job.title: Maps & Plans Coordinator
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: UEFA Tournament Operations / Venue Operations
Contract type: Maximum term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)

This role is based at UEFA’s Headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland for the UEFA EURO 28 tournament. If you are looking for roles based in the UK & Ireland, please visit the UK & Ireland 2028 Limited page.

Start date: asap
End date: 31/07/2028

Main goal

The Maps & Plans Coordinator creates architectural plans for all UEFA competitions, tournaments and events.

Key responsibilities

    • Creating detail plans to be used by the various competence centres for all UEFA operations, with a focus on UEFA EURO 2028
    • Ensuring that the information on the plans is accurate and up to date
    • Cross verification of briefing and layout quality, with a focus on clarity and uniformity
    • Helping maintain a team back-office block library and templates in AutoCAD

Requirements

Experience:

  • from 3 to 5 years' experience working in a technical drawing company or architect’s office
  • from 3 to 5 years' experience creating technical plans in AutoCAD for a large-scale sports event would be an asset
  • from 3 to 5 years' experience working with infographics in Illustrator or InDesign would be an asset
  • Experience in large-scale sports events and working in a multicultural environment would be an asset

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in architecture or a similar field

Languages:

  • English / Proficient

Other requirements:

  • Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected
  • AutoCAD

job.title: EURO Ceremonies Manager
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Club Competitions Operations & Events / Division Management
Contract type: Max-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: 01/03/2027
End date: 31/08/2028

Main goal

The Ceremonies project provides a compelling experience and amazing images to all target groups in the UEFA EURO 2028 stadiums and for millions of television viewers worldwide. The Ceremonies Manager serves as the primary point of accountability for the delivery of the UEFA EURO opening, closing and cup ceremonies, and acts as the senior representative of the Ceremonies project within UEFA and across external partners.
This role is based in Nyon and covers Cardiff, Manchester and London. As a result, travel will be required for venue working visits, to meet with the agencies and suppliers, and to deliver on-site operations.

Key responsibilities

Project management

  • Overseeing the end-to-end delivery of the UEFA EURO 2028 ceremonies
  • Leading the master planning process, ensuring all milestones are achieved for a seamless execution
  • Monitoring project timelines, risks and dependencies across the project workstream
  • Establishing reporting structures and providing regular updates to the Senior Manager
  • Developing contingency and crisis-management plans to ensure smooth operations

Operations

job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Club CompetitionsOperations & Events / Brand Operations
Contract type: Fixed-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: January 2027
End date: 31/08/2031

Main goal

To plan, coordinate, and oversee the end-to-end delivery of VBR & LED, Signage and Artwork Services by managing supplier workflows, technical operations, and stakeholder coordination, while ensuring all productions meet the highest operational and technical standards through effective on-site and remote support, for UEFA Club and National Team Competitions.

Key responsibilities

VBR & LED Support

  • Support in the delivery of all VBR & LED operational requirements for Club Competitions and National Team Competitions
  • Manage and support all LED and VBR centralised artwork deliverables for all UEFA stakeholders

Experience:

job.title: EURO Commercial Operations Specialist
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: UEFA Events SA / Revenue Operations
Contract type: Max-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: 01/02/2027
End date: 31/08/2028

Main goal

The Commercial Operations Specialist is responsible for implementing operational projects that ensure the professional delivery of on site sponsorship rights to commercial partners to a high professional standard for UEFA EURO 2028, taking place in the UK & Ireland.

This includes thorough planning and coordination with relevant EURO 2028 structures (UEFA / UK&I 2028 Ltd), other internal divisions and units, and external stakeholders throughout the preparation phase. The role serves as a dynamic interface between organisational teams and marketing teams or appointed third parties, including UEFA’s commercial agents.

The role may also include responsibilities as a local commercial domain leader and/or representing the overall commercial domain leadership and contributes to the delivery of the on-site sponsor rights and ensures a smooth handover to the Venue Marketing Teams before and during the tournament. Rights include, for example:


• Partner guest-related rights
• Partner activation rights and promotional opportunities
• Partner “Sole & Exclusive” programmes and other individual rights
• Partner on-site sales rights
• Product supply management (value-in-kind services)
• Partner commercial association exclusivity and UEFA rights protection
• Any additional rights granted to commercial affiliates in the future

Key responsibilities

  • Manage and/or coordinate the delivery of partners’ rights for UEFA national team final tournaments, ensuring they are delivered to a high quality, on time and within budget
  • Maintain effective cooperation with internal and external stakeholders to proactively support the partner-related aspects of organisational projects
  • Propose, develop and implement innovative processes, tools and communication solutions that maximise the value of marketing rights within UEFA’s operational framework
  • Maintain detailed project plans and other essential documentation as required, produce post-event reports, and share knowledge transfer and best practices
  • Prepare the delegation of responsibilities and information flow to the on-site venue marketing teams, briefing and supporting them to ensure delivery of all on-site sponsorship rights at the venues during the competition
  • Act as the project/operational lead and point of contact for specific on-site rights during final tournaments, with temporary assignments at venues as required

Requirements

Experience:

  • More than 4 years of experience in commercial rights delivery and tournament operations or event organisation at an international level
  • At least 2-3 years of experience in a sponsorship environment at international level

Languages:

  • Proficient in English

Other requirements:

- Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected

  • Proficiency in MS Office applications
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects end-to-end with advanced project-management expertise
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills, with excellent attention to detail
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to manage and engage diverse stakeholders
  • Willingness to travel (working visits, final tournaments, etc.)

Division/Unit: UEFA Events SA / Ticketing
Contract type: Fixed-Term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: ASAP
End date: 31/07/28

Main goal

The Ticketing Administration Specialist is responsible for various administrative and paralegal tasks within the Ticketing unit, including supervising tenders and reviewing legal documents, suppliers’ contracts and other contractual matters. You will be an active link between the unit and various stakeholders, ensuring effective coordination, compliance and communication across UEFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing contracts and agreements with suppliers

  • Performing ad hoc ticketing tasks as required

Experience:

  • from 4 to 6 years in managing legal documents
  • from 4 to 6 years supporting contract or procurement processes
