job.title: Medical Data Coordination Intern
job.html_description:
Job information
Division/Unit: Finance, Financial Sustainability & Research / Data & Innovation
Contract type: Maximum-term
Location: Nyon (WFH up to one day per week)
Start date: 16/11/2026
End date: 16/05/2027

Main goal

The Medical Data Coordination Intern will support the coordination of data-related activities for UEFA’s future medical platform, helping to connect medical, business and technical stakeholders and ensuring that data requirements are clearly defined, documented and followed through during the platform’s development.

The internship is designed for a recent graduate interested in data coordination, digital platforms and healthcare or sports medicine. It offers hands-on exposure to a strategic UEFA initiative, with a focus on data quality, governance, integration and effective collaboration across functional teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Coordinating data-related activities for the future UEFA medical platform across medical, business and technical teams
  • Collecting, structuring and documenting data requirements, definitions, workflows and priorities with relevant stakeholders
  • Helping to define and maintain data models, business rules, data dictionaries and reference documentation
  • Coordinating data mapping, migration, integration and validation activities, following up on dependencies, actions and timelines
  • Helping to monitor data quality, completeness and consistency and facilitating the resolution of identified issues
  • Supporting appropriate data governance, access, privacy and confidentiality practices for sensitive medical information
  • Preparing clear status updates, meeting materials and coordination documentation for project stakeholders

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's, master's or PhD in information systems, data management, health informatics, biomedical sciences, business, engineering or a related field, completed no more than one year before the internship start date

Languages:

  • English / Proficient
  • Knowledge of French would be a strong asset

Other requirements:

  • Relocation to Switzerland/France is expected
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to follow several workstreams and dependencies
  • Good understanding of data concepts, including data quality, data models, integrations and governance
  • Ability to translate stakeholder needs into clear data requirements and structured documentation
  • Clear communication skills and confidence working with medical, business and technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with AI and data tools, visualisations, databases, APIs or cloud data platforms is an asset
  • Interest in sports medicine, digital health or medical information systems would be a strong asset
  • High level of discretion and awareness of the sensitivity of medical and personal data

job.title: Senior CRM Marketing Manager
job.html_description:
Description

  

U.S. Soccer Overview 


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good. 


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S. 


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results. 


Position Description 


U.S. Soccer is seeking a data and result-driven Senior CRM Marketing Manager who will oversee the design and execution of data-driven, personalized marketing campaigns that deepen engagement, drive retention, and grow the federation’s audience. Operating at the intersection of technology, marketing, and revenue, the Senior CRM Marketing Manager will set the strategic direction for CRM marketing initiatives, ensure alignment across departments, and drive measurable business outcomes through advanced segmentation, marketing automation, and performance analytics.


As Senior CRM Marketing Manager, you will be experienced in leading audience development and segmentation, working with marketing automation tools, understanding data workflows, and can execute personalized campaigns across email, SMS, push notifications, and digital ads.


As a strategic leader and executional expert, the Senior CRM Marketing Manager will set best practices, establish measurement frameworks, and manage cross-functional collaboration to ensure that U.S. Soccer’s data-driven marketing efforts are maximized. This role will play a key part in revenue growth by leveraging CRM to support ticket sales, membership programs, sponsorship activations, and content monetization.


You will manage the Manager, Lifecycle Marketing, leading understanding our audience needs, behaviors and preferences and using this knowledge to create personalized and impactful marketing efforts that drive results. You’ll also work closely with other Federation teams across Commercial, Advancement, Referring and Coaching with strategic ownership of the CRM marketing roadmap and lifecycle architecture.


This mid-level position is perfect for someone who is a marketing expert, specializing in CRM and marketing technology including Braze and who is looking to take the next step in their career. The ideal candidate can parse technical solutions into tasks quickly, detail-orientated, and brings process management skills to complicated project. 


Primary Responsibilities


Strategic Leadership & Best Practices

  • Define and own the long-term CRM marketing roadmap, ensuring alignment with organization priorities across the Federation including audience development, fan engagement, revenue and brand growth.
  • Lead, establish and implement CRM marketing best practices across the organization, ensuring data-driven decision-making.
  • Act as the central air traffic controller for CRM marketing efforts, balancing multiple priorities across ticketing, membership, sponsorship, and fan engagement.
  • Serve as the go-to expert for marketing automation, leading internal education on CRM marketing capabilities and optimization.
  • Lead, develop and refine measurement frameworks, ensuring campaigns align with key business objectives and drive revenue growth.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership across marketing, sales, partnerships, and analytics to align CRM marketing efforts with organizational goals. Partner with Data, Technology and Marketing leadership to enhance data infrastructure and campaign personalization capabilities.
  • Mentor and support Manager, Lifecycle Communications, fostering a data-drive culture and operational excellence.

Audience Segmentation & Data Management

  • Own and evolve the federation’s audience segmentation strategy, ensuring personalization scales effectively across all channels.
  • Build and maintain audience segments for personalized fan engagement, leveraging first-party, second-party, and third-party data.
  • Lead and manage audience targeting, integrating behavioral, transactional, and engagement data to tailor outreach across CRM, CDP, and digital marketing platforms.
  • Define and execute dynamic audience rules for automated lifecycle campaigns.
  • Partner with analytics and data engineering teams to influence how fan data is collected, unified, and activated across CRM and digital ecosystem.
  • Work closely with the data analytics team to refine segmentation strategies based on campaign performance and fan behavior.
  • Ensure data cleanliness and compliance with CCPA, and other data privacy regulations.

Campaign Strategy, Execution & Automation

  • Oversee campaign strategy and ensure execution excellence by guiding the Lifecycle Marketing team and cross-functional partner.
  • Define CRM contact strategy and oversee orchestration of multi-channel campaigns to ensure alignment, efficiency, and fan-centric engagement. 
  • Build and execute highly personalized, multi-channel campaigns (email, SMS, push notifications, paid media audience targeting) to drive fan engagement and business growth.
  • Create automated workflows for fan onboarding, retention, and win-back campaigns.
  • Conduct A/B testing to optimize subject lines, content, and audience targeting.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot campaign performance, adjusting strategies in real-time.
  • Manage CRM calendars to ensure timely delivery of campaigns supporting ticket sales, events, content engagement, and sponsor activations.

Operational & Technical Execution

  • Oversee and optimize the performance of key marketing technology platforms, ensuring integrations and automations support scalable fan engagement.
  • Ensure operational excellence and governance in CRM marketing execution including across marketing technology platforms, including CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), Mobile Measurement Platforms (MMP), and marketing automation tools to enhance fan engagement.
  • Own day-to-day execution within CRM platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or similar).
  • Lead the execution of marketing email campaigns including ensuring compelling copy including editing, proofing, stakeholder approvals, and final deployment.
  • Configure and update campaign templates, customer journeys, and automation triggers.
  • Coordinate with IT and data teams to enhance CRM integrations and resolve technical issues.
  • Oversee UTM tracking, tagging, and attribution for performance analysis.

Measurement, Reporting & Optimization

  • Lead on best-in-class and data driven measurement approach for CRM channels including email, push and SMS, feeding into a multi-channel and multi-touch attribution modelling, and showing performance in engagement, revenue and ROI.
  • Define and own CRM marketing KPIs and measurement frameworks that link engagement to business outcomes such as ticket sales, membership growth, sponsorship value and other business priorities.
  • Optimized based on performance, reacting and responding to data in real-time and depending on the needs of the business. 
  • Track and report on CRM campaign performance, providing insights on key metrics (open rates, CTR, conversion rates, etc.).
  • Identify trends in fan engagement and recommend data-driven optimizations.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders, ensuring CRM efforts align with broader marketing objectives.

Requirements

  

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation
  • Proven experience leading CRM strategy and cross-functional execution across marketing, data, and technology teams
  • Expertise in CRM tools (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)
  • Strong leadership skills to influence cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, personalization, and data-driven marketing
  • Experience in multi-channel marketing, including email, SMS, and push notifications
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance and optimize accordingly
  • Knowledge of data privacy regulations (CCPA) and compliance best practices
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously
  • SQL proficiency for audience querying and reporting
  • Familiarity with paid media platforms and CRM-to-advertising integrations
  • Experience with A/B testing methodologies and lifecycle marketing strategies
  • Experience with digital attribution, conversion tracking, and marketing analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tableau)
  • Team-first attitude and excellent interpersonal skills
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional time management skills
  • Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments 
  • Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission 
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook) 
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed (USMNT and USWNT match days)


Desired Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Passion for soccer and a solid understanding of the soccer landscape in the United States



U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development. 


U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.

job.title: U.S. Soccer Summer 2027 Internship Program
job.html_description:
Description


U.S. Soccer Overview


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitions plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.

  

We are thrilled to launch our third annual Summer Internship Program, specifically for college students who live in the metro Atlanta, Georgia area either during the school year or over the summer.

Position Description


We are seeking motivated and enthusiastic interns to join our team for a 12-week internship program. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in your chosen department, work on meaningful projects, and develop valuable professional skills. You will collaborate with experienced professionals, attend training sessions, and participate in networking events designed to enhance your career development.


 ***IMPORTANT: Before proceeding please review the descriptions of participating departments, below, along with unique preferred qualifications.***

 

Accounting Intern

As an Accounting Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting U.S. Soccer’s accounting team in a fast-paced environment. You’ll contribute to day-to-day financial operations through activities such as month-end close, data entry and analysis within the accounts payable system, and special projects. You’ll also have opportunities to support improvements to financial reporting and accounting processes while developing a deeper understanding of U.S. Soccer’s business through an accounting lens.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Business with a concentration in Accounting 
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel 
  • Familiarity with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) 
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills 
  • Interest in accounting and financial operations

  

Business Ventures – Data Science Intern
As a Data Science Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s growing use of data, analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI) to better understand and engage fans. You’ll work on projects involving fan data strategy, audience insights, marketing effectiveness, membership growth, ticketing, revenue opportunities, and internal AI tools. Responsibilities may include cleaning and analyzing datasets, building dashboards and reports, supporting predictive models, documenting data processes, and translating findings into recommendations. You’ll gain hands-on experience applying data science to real business challenges in the sports industry.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Junior or senior pursuing Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Analytics, or a related technical field 
  • Proficiency in Python 
  • Strong interest in data science, machine learning, AI, and solving business problems with data 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and attention-to-detail skills 
  • Experience with SQL, data visualization, statistics, or machine learning is a plus


Coaching Education Intern
As a Coaching Education Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to develop and deliver quality coaching education across the country. You’ll contribute to projects that blend strategy, operations, education, and stakeholder engagement while gaining insight into how the coaching ecosystem is developed and implemented at a national level. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about coaching and growing the game, thinks strategically, takes initiative, and enjoys turning ideas into action.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Business major with an interest in coaching and/or operations 
  • Passion for developing coaching education at a national scale 
  • Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with external stakeholders 
  • Strategic thinker who can also execute operationally 
  • Proactive, curious, and eager to learn


Consumer Products Intern

As a Consumer Products Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience across U.S. Soccer’s Nike partnership, Retail/Marketplace, and Licensing teams. You’ll support product strategy, retail development, competitive analysis, licensing initiatives, brand collaborations, and fan engagement programs. You’ll work closely with team leaders and cross-functional partners on projects supporting major global events, including the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup and 2028 Olympics. This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to product development, strategic brand alignment, retail, licensing, and one of U.S. Soccer’s largest commercial partnerships.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field 
  • Interest or experience in product management, marketing, licensing, or marketplace operations 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including with external partners 
  • Willingness to learn and contribute across diverse projects


Customer Experience Intern

As a Customer Experience Intern, you’ll help U.S. Soccer better understand and improve the experiences of our fans and customers through Customer Service. You’ll analyze customer feedback, identify trends and pain points, support Voice of the Customer initiatives, and conduct research to generate actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with Customer Service, Product, Commercial, and Participation & Environments teams while owning a project from start to finish. This role offers hands-on experience using customer insights to inform products, programs, and services while contributing to initiatives that enhance the U.S. Soccer experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in customer experience, research, product, analytics, operations, or a related field 
  • Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills 
  • Experience working with data and spreadsheets, such as Excel or Google Sheets 
  • Strong attention to detail 
  • Interest in sports and/or the soccer ecosystem is a plus


External Communications Intern

As an External Communications Intern, you’ll help tell stories that connect fans, media, and stakeholders to U.S. Soccer and the game. You’ll support communications across National Team competitions, business initiatives, partnerships, and community impact. Responsibilities include drafting press materials, monitoring media coverage, researching media opportunities, and supporting communications campaigns and major events. You’ll collaborate with teams across the Federation while gaining hands-on experience in media relations, strategic communications, executive visibility, and storytelling in a fast-paced sports environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field 
  • Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills with a passion for sports and storytelling
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects 
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with media monitoring tools is a plus


Hospitality & Events Intern

Join U.S. Soccer’s National Training Center Operations team for a hands-on internship supporting hospitality and events at a world-class sports facility. You’ll assist with event coordination, guest experiences, hospitality standards, tours, and the NTC ambassador program, with opportunities to collaborate with Facilities and Event Conversion. You’ll gain project ownership, mentorship, live event experience, and exposure to sports facility operations while building skills in hospitality, event management, and cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Event Management, Hospitality, Communications, Business, or a related field 
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities 
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills 
  • Prior event, hospitality, customer service, or athletics experience is a plus 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace; proactive and service-oriented mindset

Human Resources Intern

As a Human Resources Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to create a positive, engaging, and high-performing employee experience. You’ll contribute to key HR initiatives across recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, and HR data and reporting. This role offers hands-on experience across a broad range of human resources functions within a dynamic and growing organization. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your HR knowledge, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to initiatives that help build a strong and engaged workforce.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field
  • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborative, proactive, and eager to learn
  • Interest in human resources and creating a positive employee experience


Integrated Performance Support Intern

This internship offers the unique opportunity to work across Performance Science and Performance Innovation to gain hands-on experience in applied sport science and performance research. You’ll support the implementation and evaluation of the Recovery Subsystem and other initiatives through camp-based activities, data collection, compliance monitoring, educational resources, and research deliverables. This cross-functional role provides exposure to high-performance sport while developing skills in research, athlete monitoring, data collection, communication, and translating performance science into practical applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physiology, Biomechanics, Sports Nutrition, or a related field 
  • Interest in applied sport science or high-performance sport, particularly soccer 
  • Research, athlete monitoring, or recovery experience is a plus 
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Soccer background as a player, coach, referee, or in another capacity is ideal


Internal Communications Intern

As an Internal Communications Intern, you’ll help create communications that inform, engage, and connect employees across U.S. Soccer. You’ll contribute content for our intranet, draft internal emails and announcements, support editorial planning and employee engagement campaigns, and help develop stories highlighting the people and teams behind our mission. You’ll gain exposure to executive communications, organizational storytelling, digital content strategy, employee engagement, and cross-functional collaboration, while building a portfolio of published work and developing skills for careers in corporate communications, public relations, and employee experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Creative Writing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • Interest in writing, storytelling, and employee communications 
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Canva, content management systems, or AI tools are a plus


Markets & Pathways Intern

As a Markets & Pathways Intern, you’ll support strategic initiatives that increase access to soccer and strengthen the sport’s ecosystem across the United States. You’ll assist with research, data analysis, project coordination, and stakeholder engagement related to grassroots participation, community engagement, and long-term growth. You may analyze participation trends, prepare presentations and reports, support meetings with member organizations and partners, and develop resources for players, coaches, referees, and communities. You’ll gain hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams and national soccer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field 
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, presentation, and communication skills 
  • Creative problem-solving and strategic-thinking abilities 
  • Comfortable conducting research and analyzing information 
  • Organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn 


Safeguarding Prevention Intern

As a Safeguarding Prevention Intern, you’ll help U.S. Soccer develop meaningful education and resources that protect and empower young athletes. Bringing a player’s perspective, you’ll support athlete-facing educational materials, awareness campaigns, and practical tools for Youth National Teams and Youth Referees. You’ll research how young people learn, translate complex safeguarding concepts into relatable messaging, and contribute to projects that strengthen athlete welfare and wellbeing. You’ll collaborate across the Federation and contribute to a growing and high-priority function.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing Education, Communications, Marketing, Public Health, Psychology, Sport Management, or a related field 
  • Current or recent competitive or pre-professional athlete with firsthand youth athlete experience 
  • Strong writing and content-creation skills, with the ability to make complex topics clear and relatable 
  • Interest in youth development, athlete welfare, and player wellbeing 
  • Collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with sensitive topics 


Partnership Development Intern

As a Partnership Development Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to build purpose-driven, long-term commercial partnerships with leading companies. You’ll contribute to strategic initiatives across platform innovation, partner storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration. This role offers hands-on experience in a dynamic, revenue-generating team during an exciting period of growth for soccer. You’ll have the opportunity to balance creativity with business thinking, develop compelling ideas, and contribute to initiatives that help advance U.S. Soccer’s mission and grow the game at all levels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in business development, marketing, commercial strategy, or a related field 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail 
  • Ability to craft compelling stories and balance creativity with a commercial mindset 
  • Curious, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity 
  • Passion for growing the game of soccer; soccer background (in any capacity) is a plus


Performance Medicine Intern

As a Performance Medicine Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience within the high-performance sports medicine environment at U.S. Soccer’s National Training Center. Under the guidance of the sports medicine leadership team, you’ll support daily clinical operations, player care, injury prevention, rehabilitation and recovery, medical documentation, and administrative projects. You will also contribute to data collection, research, quality improvement, and event preparation while observing collaboration among physicians, athletic trainers, physical therapists, sports scientists, and performance staff.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing Athletic Training, Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Sports Medicine, Pre-Med, or a related field 
  • Strong interest in sports medicine and high-performance athletics 
  • Strong organizational and attention-to-detail skills 
  • Interest in research, injury prevention, rehabilitation, or athlete care 
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment


Soccer Forward Intern

As a Soccer Forward Intern, you’ll provide hands-on support to the Soccer Forward team while gaining exposure to community impact, sports administration, and program management. You’ll collaborate with teams including Communications, Events, and Stakeholder Engagement and support leadership-level coordination through meeting preparation, event logistics, and other team initiatives. This role offers an opportunity to gain real-world experience in a fast-paced environment while contributing to work that leverages the power of soccer to create meaningful social impact.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field 
  • Prior experience in event coordination, administrative support, community engagement, or sports programming is a plus 
  • Strong organizational skills and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and engage stakeholders professionally
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Airtable; passion for soccer and social impact is a plus
  • Ability to work flexible hours in a fast-paced environment


Sporting Strategy Intern

The Sporting Strategy Intern will support the Sporting department in advancing The U.S. Way, the strategy for developing winning Senior National Teams through excellence in player development. You’ll conduct research and analysis, support strategic planning, develop presentations and meeting materials, track project deliverables, and contribute to cross-functional initiatives. You’ll gain practical experience in strategy, operations, project management, and communication while contributing to projects related to player development, organizational effectiveness, and U.S. Soccer’s long-term sporting priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Majoring in Business, Operations, Finance, Sports Management, or a related field 
  • Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills 
  • Demonstrated leadership in clubs, organizations, or other activities 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • Interest in sports strategy, business operations, or organizational leadership


Strategy Intern

As a Strategy Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s Strategy team on projects focused on recreational and grassroots soccer and World Cup 2026 legacy initiatives. You’ll conduct research, analyze information, organize stakeholder input, develop presentations, and support project planning across priority initiatives. You’ll help translate strategic ideas into execution plans by identifying opportunities, tracking workstreams, synthesizing insights, and preparing materials for internal discussions. This role offers exposure to strategic planning and execution while working with cross-functional partners to support the long-term growth of soccer in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills 
  • Interest in sports business, strategy, soccer, community impact, data analysis, or project management 
  • Organized, curious, and comfortable working with ambiguity 
  • Ability to turn research and information into clear insights and recommendations 
  • Experience with PowerPoint, Excel, or similar tools is helpful 

Requirements


General Qualifications and Requirements

  • Minimum GPA: 3.0
  • Enrolled in a 4-year undergraduate program with anticipated graduation year of 2028 or 2029
  • Able to participate in this 12-week internship during the summer
  • Able to dedicate 40 hours per week to this internship
  • Able to work in-person at U.S. Soccer’s Fayetteville, GA office at least 3 days per week
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical / problem-solving skills 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Recommended: Participation and interest in soccer/athletics; campus involvement and leadership
  • Deep ties to the Atlanta area – either currently living in metro Atlanta or from the area with a desire to build a career here post-graduation

Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth & networking: weekly professional development sessions with leaders from across the organization and U.S. soccer ecosystem, meaningful, resume-building work in one of 15+ departments, with personalized mentorship and support, regular networking and social events with fellow interns and full-time staff, official U.S. Soccer gear and intern headshots provided
  • Behind-the-scenes access: experience the lead-up to the 2027 FIFA World Cup from inside the U.S. Soccer Federation, attend a U.S. National Team training camp and an Atlanta United match as part of the program, daily access to the Arthur M. Blank National Training Center
  • Financial support: Salary: $20/hour, Transportation costs will be covered by U.S. Soccer for the duration of the internship (either mileage reimbursement or Uber/Lyft pass)

  

*IMPORTANT: Application instructions*
As part of the application, you will be asked to respond to three (3) short essay questions. Please note that our system does not allow you to save progress, so you’ll need to complete and submit your application in one sitting.


We're excited to hear your authentic voice and perspective. Please submit original essay responses written in your own words. Responses that rely substantially on AI-generated content will not be considered.


A cover letter is not required. If you have any questions, please reach out to internships@ussoccer.org. 

 
Application process and next steps

Thank you for your interest in the U.S. Soccer Internship Program. Applications will be reviewed this fall, and interview invitations will be shared via email. 

 

***IMPORTANT: Before proceeding please ensure you have reviewed the descriptions of participating departments, above, along with unique preferred qualifications.***

This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.
job.plain_text_description:
Description
U.S. Soccer Overview
The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.
We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.
U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitions plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.
We are thrilled to launch our third annual Summer Internship Program, specifically for college students who live in the metro Atlanta, Georgia area either during the school year or over the summer.
Position Description
We are seeking motivated and enthusiastic interns to join our team for a 12-week internship program. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in your chosen department, work on meaningful projects, and develop valuable professional skills. You will collaborate with experienced professionals, attend training sessions, and participate in networking events designed to enhance your career development.
***IMPORTANT: Before proceeding please review the descriptions of participating departments, below, along with unique preferred qualifications.***
Accounting Intern
As an Accounting Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience supporting U.S. Soccer’s accounting team in a fast-paced environment. You’ll contribute to day-to-day financial operations through activities such as month-end close, data entry and analysis within the accounts payable system, and special projects. You’ll also have opportunities to support improvements to financial reporting and accounting processes while developing a deeper understanding of U.S. Soccer’s business through an accounting lens.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Business with a concentration in Accounting - Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel - Familiarity with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Strong attention to detail and analytical skills - Interest in accounting and financial operations
Business Ventures – Data Science Intern As a Data Science Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s growing use of data, analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI) to better understand and engage fans. You’ll work on projects involving fan data strategy, audience insights, marketing effectiveness, membership growth, ticketing, revenue opportunities, and internal AI tools. Responsibilities may include cleaning and analyzing datasets, building dashboards and reports, supporting predictive models, documenting data processes, and translating findings into recommendations. You’ll gain hands-on experience applying data science to real business challenges in the sports industry.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Junior or senior pursuing Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Analytics, or a related technical field - Proficiency in Python - Strong interest in data science, machine learning, AI, and solving business problems with data - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and attention-to-detail skills - Experience with SQL, data visualization, statistics, or machine learning is a plus
Coaching Education Intern As a Coaching Education Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to develop and deliver quality coaching education across the country. You’ll contribute to projects that blend strategy, operations, education, and stakeholder engagement while gaining insight into how the coaching ecosystem is developed and implemented at a national level. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about coaching and growing the game, thinks strategically, takes initiative, and enjoys turning ideas into action.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Business major with an interest in coaching and/or operations - Passion for developing coaching education at a national scale - Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with external stakeholders - Strategic thinker who can also execute operationally - Proactive, curious, and eager to learn
Consumer Products Intern
As a Consumer Products Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience across U.S. Soccer’s Nike partnership, Retail/Marketplace, and Licensing teams. You’ll support product strategy, retail development, competitive analysis, licensing initiatives, brand collaborations, and fan engagement programs. You’ll work closely with team leaders and cross-functional partners on projects supporting major global events, including the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup and 2028 Olympics. This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to product development, strategic brand alignment, retail, licensing, and one of U.S. Soccer’s largest commercial partnerships.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field - Interest or experience in product management, marketing, licensing, or marketplace operations - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - Strong collaboration and communication skills, including with external partners - Willingness to learn and contribute across diverse projects
Customer Experience Intern
As a Customer Experience Intern, you’ll help U.S. Soccer better understand and improve the experiences of our fans and customers through Customer Service. You’ll analyze customer feedback, identify trends and pain points, support Voice of the Customer initiatives, and conduct research to generate actionable insights. You’ll collaborate with Customer Service, Product, Commercial, and Participation & Environments teams while owning a project from start to finish. This role offers hands-on experience using customer insights to inform products, programs, and services while contributing to initiatives that enhance the U.S. Soccer experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Interest in customer experience, research, product, analytics, operations, or a related field - Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills - Experience working with data and spreadsheets, such as Excel or Google Sheets - Strong attention to detail - Interest in sports and/or the soccer ecosystem is a plus
External Communications Intern
As an External Communications Intern, you’ll help tell stories that connect fans, media, and stakeholders to U.S. Soccer and the game. You’ll support communications across National Team competitions, business initiatives, partnerships, and community impact. Responsibilities include drafting press materials, monitoring media coverage, researching media opportunities, and supporting communications campaigns and major events. You’ll collaborate with teams across the Federation while gaining hands-on experience in media relations, strategic communications, executive visibility, and storytelling in a fast-paced sports environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field - Strong writing, editing, and verbal communication skills with a passion for sports and storytelling - Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment - Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with media monitoring tools is a plus
Hospitality & Events Intern
Join U.S. Soccer’s National Training Center Operations team for a hands-on internship supporting hospitality and events at a world-class sports facility. You’ll assist with event coordination, guest experiences, hospitality standards, tours, and the NTC ambassador program, with opportunities to collaborate with Facilities and Event Conversion. You’ll gain project ownership, mentorship, live event experience, and exposure to sports facility operations while building skills in hospitality, event management, and cross-functional collaboration.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Sport Management, Event Management, Hospitality, Communications, Business, or a related field - Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities - Clear written and verbal communication skills - Prior event, hospitality, customer service, or athletics experience is a plus - Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace; proactive and service-oriented mindset
Human Resources Intern
As a Human Resources Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to create a positive, engaging, and high-performing employee experience. You’ll contribute to key HR initiatives across recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, and HR data and reporting. This role offers hands-on experience across a broad range of human resources functions within a dynamic and growing organization. You’ll have the opportunity to strengthen your HR knowledge, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to initiatives that help build a strong and engaged workforce.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field - Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and organizational skills - Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment - Collaborative, proactive, and eager to learn - Interest in human resources and creating a positive employee experience
Integrated Performance Support Intern
This internship offers the unique opportunity to work across Performance Science and Performance Innovation to gain hands-on experience in applied sport science and performance research. You’ll support the implementation and evaluation of the Recovery Subsystem and other initiatives through camp-based activities, data collection, compliance monitoring, educational resources, and research deliverables. This cross-functional role provides exposure to high-performance sport while developing skills in research, athlete monitoring, data collection, communication, and translating performance science into practical applications.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Physiology, Biomechanics, Sports Nutrition, or a related field - Interest in applied sport science or high-performance sport, particularly soccer - Research, athlete monitoring, or recovery experience is a plus - Strong written communication skills - Soccer background as a player, coach, referee, or in another capacity is ideal
Internal Communications Intern
As an Internal Communications Intern, you’ll help create communications that inform, engage, and connect employees across U.S. Soccer. You’ll contribute content for our intranet, draft internal emails and announcements, support editorial planning and employee engagement campaigns, and help develop stories highlighting the people and teams behind our mission. You’ll gain exposure to executive communications, organizational storytelling, digital content strategy, employee engagement, and cross-functional collaboration, while building a portfolio of published work and developing skills for careers in corporate communications, public relations, and employee experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Creative Writing, Sports Management, or a related field - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Interest in writing, storytelling, and employee communications - Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines - Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Canva, content management systems, or AI tools are a plus
Markets & Pathways Intern
As a Markets & Pathways Intern, you’ll support strategic initiatives that increase access to soccer and strengthen the sport’s ecosystem across the United States. You’ll assist with research, data analysis, project coordination, and stakeholder engagement related to grassroots participation, community engagement, and long-term growth. You may analyze participation trends, prepare presentations and reports, support meetings with member organizations and partners, and develop resources for players, coaches, referees, and communities. You’ll gain hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams and national soccer stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field - Strong analytical, critical-thinking, presentation, and communication skills - Creative problem-solving and strategic-thinking abilities - Comfortable conducting research and analyzing information - Organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn
Safeguarding Prevention Intern
As a Safeguarding Prevention Intern, you’ll help U.S. Soccer develop meaningful education and resources that protect and empower young athletes. Bringing a player’s perspective, you’ll support athlete-facing educational materials, awareness campaigns, and practical tools for Youth National Teams and Youth Referees. You’ll research how young people learn, translate complex safeguarding concepts into relatable messaging, and contribute to projects that strengthen athlete welfare and wellbeing. You’ll collaborate across the Federation and contribute to a growing and high-priority function.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing Education, Communications, Marketing, Public Health, Psychology, Sport Management, or a related field - Current or recent competitive or pre-professional athlete with firsthand youth athlete experience - Strong writing and content-creation skills, with the ability to make complex topics clear and relatable - Interest in youth development, athlete welfare, and player wellbeing - Collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with sensitive topics
Partnership Development Intern
As a Partnership Development Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s efforts to build purpose-driven, long-term commercial partnerships with leading companies. You’ll contribute to strategic initiatives across platform innovation, partner storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration. This role offers hands-on experience in a dynamic, revenue-generating team during an exciting period of growth for soccer. You’ll have the opportunity to balance creativity with business thinking, develop compelling ideas, and contribute to initiatives that help advance U.S. Soccer’s mission and grow the game at all levels.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Interest in business development, marketing, commercial strategy, or a related field - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail - Ability to craft compelling stories and balance creativity with a commercial mindset - Curious, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity - Passion for growing the game of soccer; soccer background (in any capacity) is a plus
Performance Medicine Intern
As a Performance Medicine Intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience within the high-performance sports medicine environment at U.S. Soccer’s National Training Center. Under the guidance of the sports medicine leadership team, you’ll support daily clinical operations, player care, injury prevention, rehabilitation and recovery, medical documentation, and administrative projects. You will also contribute to data collection, research, quality improvement, and event preparation while observing collaboration among physicians, athletic trainers, physical therapists, sports scientists, and performance staff.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing Athletic Training, Exercise Science, Kinesiology, Sports Medicine, Pre-Med, or a related field - Strong interest in sports medicine and high-performance athletics - Strong organizational and attention-to-detail skills - Interest in research, injury prevention, rehabilitation, or athlete care - Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
Soccer Forward Intern
As a Soccer Forward Intern, you’ll provide hands-on support to the Soccer Forward team while gaining exposure to community impact, sports administration, and program management. You’ll collaborate with teams including Communications, Events, and Stakeholder Engagement and support leadership-level coordination through meeting preparation, event logistics, and other team initiatives. This role offers an opportunity to gain real-world experience in a fast-paced environment while contributing to work that leverages the power of soccer to create meaningful social impact.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Pursuing a degree in Business, Sports Management, or a related field - Prior experience in event coordination, administrative support, community engagement, or sports programming is a plus - Strong organizational skills and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and engage stakeholders professionally - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Airtable; passion for soccer and social impact is a plus - Ability to work flexible hours in a fast-paced environment
Sporting Strategy Intern
The Sporting Strategy Intern will support the Sporting department in advancing The U.S. Way, the strategy for developing winning Senior National Teams through excellence in player development. You’ll conduct research and analysis, support strategic planning, develop presentations and meeting materials, track project deliverables, and contribute to cross-functional initiatives. You’ll gain practical experience in strategy, operations, project management, and communication while contributing to projects related to player development, organizational effectiveness, and U.S. Soccer’s long-term sporting priorities.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Majoring in Business, Operations, Finance, Sports Management, or a related field - Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills - Demonstrated leadership in clubs, organizations, or other activities - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Interest in sports strategy, business operations, or organizational leadership
Strategy Intern
As a Strategy Intern, you’ll support U.S. Soccer’s Strategy team on projects focused on recreational and grassroots soccer and World Cup 2026 legacy initiatives. You’ll conduct research, analyze information, organize stakeholder input, develop presentations, and support project planning across priority initiatives. You’ll help translate strategic ideas into execution plans by identifying opportunities, tracking workstreams, synthesizing insights, and preparing materials for internal discussions. This role offers exposure to strategic planning and execution while working with cross-functional partners to support the long-term growth of soccer in the United States.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills - Interest in sports business, strategy, soccer, community impact, data analysis, or project management - Organized, curious, and comfortable working with ambiguity - Ability to turn research and information into clear insights and recommendations - Experience with PowerPoint, Excel, or similar tools is helpful
Requirements
General Qualifications and Requirements
- Minimum GPA: 3.0 - Enrolled in a 4-year undergraduate program with anticipated graduation year of 2028 or 2029 - Able to participate in this 12-week internship during the summer - Able to dedicate 40 hours per week to this internship - Able to work in-person at U.S. Soccer’s Fayetteville, GA office at least 3 days per week - Strong attention to detail and analytical / problem-solving skills - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills - Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment - Recommended: Participation and interest in soccer/athletics; campus involvement and leadership - Deep ties to the Atlanta area – either currently living in metro Atlanta or from the area with a desire to build a career here post-graduation
Perks and Benefits
- Professional growth & networking: weekly professional development sessions with leaders from across the organization and U.S. soccer ecosystem, meaningful, resume-building work in one of 15+ departments, with personalized mentorship and support, regular networking and social events with fellow interns and full-time staff, official U.S. Soccer gear and intern headshots provided - Behind-the-scenes access: experience the lead-up to the 2027 FIFA World Cup from inside the U.S. Soccer Federation, attend a U.S. National Team training camp and an Atlanta United match as part of the program, daily access to the Arthur M. Blank National Training Center - Financial support: Salary: $20/hour, Transportation costs will be covered by U.S. Soccer for the duration of the internship (either mileage reimbursement or Uber/Lyft pass)

job.title: Goalkeeper Manager, Extended National Teams
job.html_description:
Description


U.S. Soccer Overview


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.


Position Description


Reporting directly to the Head of Goalkeeping, the Extended National Team Goalkeeper Manager will be responsible for educating, equipping, and developing our top talents through age-appropriate, skill-building approaches with the goal of grooming players to play for our Senior Extended National Teams. This role requires the implementation of coaching expertise, excellent in-person and remote communication skills, and collaboration with peers in identifying, selecting, developing, and transitioning talents through the player pathway and from other forms of the game.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Reports to the Head of Goalkeeping
  • Collaborates with the Director of Extended National Teams (Technical & Leadership), Beach, Futsal and Extended Head Coaches and Technical staff to create the best aligned environment for our players within US Soccer set structure and processes (THE U.S. WAY) Serves as the Goalkeeper Coach across Extended National Teams as needed
  •  Works to support and lead a high-performance environment for the Extended National Teams
  • Oversee the individual development and performance environment for goalkeepers 
  • Creates the conditions for an optimal on and off-the-field performance for players
  • Commits to delivering consistently to players the vision, mission, and objectives of U.S. Soccer and the overarching sporting strategy
  • Ability to align and deliver the USSF Player Development Philosophy – The U.S. WAY language (cultural anchors, performance anchors, game model, methodology, etc.)
  • Delivers the US Player pathway document outlining our areas of focus for all ages and stages of the program
  • Works collaboratively with the Talent ID department to identify, report, record, and select high potential players across the pathway
  • Contributes to the overall talent identification audit process providing outstanding player insights to support the player decision process of player selection
  • Responsible for the international development of elite Beach, Futsal and Extended players of our country
  • Ensures all national team goalkeepers within their care have an up to date and robust IDP
  • Delivers with excellence and in line with the “plan, perform, reflect, refine” model
  • Engages in the process of robust post-camp reviews with the Head of Extended National Teams (Technical & Leadership) and Head of Goalkeeping and adopts the personal development plan accordingly
  • Drives a culture of building outstanding players, staff, and club relationship
  •  Supports the US Soccer club engagement program with regular strategic club and player in-club visits
  • Upon request of the Head of Extended National Teams and Head of Goalkeeping, contribute to the US Soccer Coaching Education Programs

Requirements


Minimum Qualifications

  • USSF “B” License or higher (or comparable UEFA B)
  • Coaching experience within elite youth development
  • Passion for working with and the developing young players 
  • Proven history of developing the individual player
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills to manage and lead self and others
  • Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication combined with a professional demeanor
  • Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook) and Video Editing
  • Understands child development and maturation
  • A passion for and knowledge of talent identification
  • Possesses a growth mindset 
  • Has the ability to work as part of a wider coaching team influencing coaching within the US Soccer landscape
  • Able and willing to work non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed
  • Willing to relocate once National Training Facility is established in Atlanta 

Desired Qualifications

  • USSF A License or equivalent
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish)
  • Coaching education experience
  • Thorough institutional knowledge of U.S. Soccer’s mission, goals, technical plan, policies, practices, and procedures   

    

U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development.


U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.

job.title: Director, Donor Experiences
job.html_description:
Description


U.S. Soccer Overview


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.


Position Description

   

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Strategic Philanthropy, the Director, Donor Experiences will lead the strategy, development, and execution of U.S. Soccer's donor experiences and hospitality program, building on the successful donor engagement platform established during FIFA World Cup 2026 and positioning the Federation for the road to the 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup and beyond. 


This leader will transform donor experiences and hospitality into a strategic fundraising platform that generates philanthropic revenue, cultivates, retains, and deepens relationships with U.S. Soccer supporters, and advances U.S. Soccer’s $250 million comprehensive campaign through meaningful, world-class engagement. 


Working collaboratively across Advancement and the broader Federation, the Director will establish the long-term vision, operating model, and standards for donor experiences while leading a team responsible for hospitality, fundraising events, and VIP engagement. Leveraging marquee matches, international competitions, the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center, and other signature Federation assets, this role will create scalable donor experiences that strengthen fundraising, stewardship, and long-term philanthropic growth. 


Primary Responsibilities 

  • Develop and lead a comprehensive donor experiences and hospitality strategy aligned with U.S. Soccer's fundraising priorities, the Federation's $250 million comprehensive campaign, and long-term philanthropic growth. 
  • Build and lead the donor experiences and hospitality function by establishing its operating model, strategic roadmap, hospitality standards, organizational structure, and scalable systems that support long-term fundraising growth. 
  • Hire, supervise, mentor, and develop a team of 2–3 direct reports, while assessing future staffing and organizational needs as the donor experiences function expands. 
  • Develop and execute an annual donor experiences strategy and calendar that intentionally supports cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, donor retention, upgrades, recognition, campaign priorities, and executive engagement. 
  • Design and oversee U.S. Soccer's portfolio of donor experiences, including cultivation events, fundraising events, stewardship and recognition activities, matchday hospitality, VIP experiences, campaign celebrations, behind-the-scenes access, and other engagement opportunities that strengthen philanthropic relationships and inspire deeper investment. 
  • Develop innovative donor experience strategies that directly support fundraising, including bespoke cultivation events, campaign experiences, premium hospitality opportunities, and future revenue-generating donor packages surrounding FIFA World Cups, international competitions, and other signature Federation events. 
  • Position the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center as a premier destination for donor engagement, stewardship, fundraising, and hospitality by creating innovative donor experiences that leverage one of the Federation's most distinctive philanthropic assets. 
  • Partner closely with Annual Fund, Stewardship, Major Gifts, Principal Gifts, Advancement Marketing & Communications, and Advancement Services to ensure donor experiences are intentionally designed to support acquisition, cultivation, stewardship, retention, upgrades, and fundraising outcomes—not simply event execution. 
  • Collaborate across Commercial, Sporting, Marketing & Communications, Event Operations, and other cross-federation departments to deliver integrated donor experiences aligned with Federation priorities. 
  • Establish standards, project management systems, operational procedures, and hospitality best practices that ensure donor experiences are executed consistently, efficiently, and at the highest level of quality. 
  • Develop and manage departmental budgets, hospitality investments, vendor relationships, venue contracts, and strategic partnerships while ensuring responsible financial stewardship. 
  • Establish key performance indicators and evaluation metrics to measure donor engagement, fundraising impact, donor retention, hospitality effectiveness, operational excellence, and return on investment. 
  • Identify emerging trends, innovative hospitality concepts, and best practices that position U.S. Soccer as a leader in donor engagement and philanthropic hospitality. 
  • Promote a culture of exceptional hospitality and donor-centered service throughout the Federation. 
  • Support the overall goals of the Advancement department. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

Requirements


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required 
  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in advancement, fundraising, donor engagement, or donor experiences and hospitality, including experience building or significantly scaling experiential fundraising programs. 
  • Proven track record of generating philanthropic revenue through events and experiences 
  • Experience building from the ground up or significantly scaling donor experiences and hospitality programming 
  • Ability to build the strategy, systems, processes, staffing model, and measures of success for a growing function 
  • Experience hiring, supervising, coaching, and developing professional staff. 
  • Proven ability to think strategically while successfully leading complex initiatives from concept through execution. 
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and overseeing vendor and partner relationships. 
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of an organization. 
  • Experience utilizing Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform preferred. 
  • General knowledge of soccer preferred. 
  • Must be able to connect "microt" details to "macro" vision and mission.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, and travel as needed. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook). 


U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development.


U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.

job.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Communications
job.html_description:
Description


U.S. Soccer Overview


The U.S. Soccer Federation exists in service to soccer. Our aim is to ignite a national passion for the game. Because we believe that soccer is more than a sport; it is a force for good.


We understand the importance and the power of teamwork, on and off the pitch. That is why we work closely with our Federation partners and members, to inspire, support and guide every level of the game: from the grassroots to the National Teams. We want to bring soccer into every home and every community, right across America. Because we believe that soccer can transform lives like no other sport. Soccer can represent the best of U.S.


U.S. Soccer is in a period of significant growth, with ambitious plans for U.S. Soccer in the near and far future. We are, therefore, looking for dynamic servant leaders to join us on this journey: in service to soccer. Applicants must be able to demonstrate visionary leadership, analytical decision-making, professional flexibility, and an empathic management style that builds bold teams and delivers globally significant results.


Position Description


The Senior Manager, Corporate Communications supports and executes enterprise-wide communications strategies that build understanding, strengthen relationships, create meaningful opportunities for engagement and ensure U.S. Soccer’s Federation membership base feels informed, heard and connected to the organization’s mission and direction. In close partnership with the Senior Director of Corporate Communications and business partners across the Soccer Growth and Member Strategy teams, this role is responsible for developing and executing both internal and external communications plans and initiatives that reflect U.S. Soccer’s strategic priorities and mission. 


The ideal candidate is a strategic, proactive and relationship-driven communicator with experience navigating complex stakeholder environments and aligning messaging that helps members and key stakeholders including referees, coaches and youth leaders understand how the organizations work affects them. Areas of focus include executive communications, member engagement, and cross-functional coordination. 


This role oversees the development of executive briefing materials, talking points, background documents, and presentations for public appearances, media engagements, and internal leadership communications as it relates to Soccer Growth and Member Strategy initiatives. This role also supports larger Federation external functions, including board meetings, annual member meetings, annual general meetings of member organizations, regional meetings and public-facing appearances. 


Success in this role requires strong cross-functional collaboration, the ability to synthesize complex information for diverse audiences, and a commitment to ensuring that U.S. Soccer’s internal communications infrastructure and external messaging are aligned and mission-driven. 


Primary Responsibilities 

  • Develop and execute corporate communications strategies that support organizational priorities and strengthen reputation among members, partners, media and other stakeholders. 
  • Develop executive communications, talking points, presentations, messages and other materials for internal and external audiences. 
  • Identify opportunities to proactively tell the organization’s story and demonstrate its impact. 
  • Build strong relationships across departments and serve as a communications thought partner to teams working directly with members and stakeholders. 
  • Collaborate with marketing, digital, events, executive leadership, advancement and other teams to create integrated engagement strategies. 
  • Develop and lead integrated communications strategies that strengthen member understanding, connection and engagement with the organization. 
  • Build communications plans around major organizational initiatives, changes, announcements and priorities. 
  • Play a lead role in building a monthly membership newsletter. 
  • Establish meaningful measures of communications and member engagement effectiveness. 

Requirements


Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in corporate communications, media relations, membership communications or a related field, ideally within sports, entertainment, or nonprofit sectors.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. 
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. soccer ecosystem, including key stakeholders such as members, referees, coaches, and youth programs. 
  • Proven experience supporting C-suite executives with briefing materials, talking points, presentations, and internal/external messaging. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communication skills across a variety of formats (speeches, memos, newsletters, social content, feature articles, etc.). 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive information and craft strategic responses in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations. 
  • Experience coordinating communications for high-profile events, such as board meetings, conventions, and internal town halls. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Ability to develop clear, consistent messaging across internal and external channels, aligned with organizational mission and voice. 
  • Comfort working collaboratively across departments and building relationships at all levels of an organization. 
  • Experience communicating with a membership, association, nonprofit or similarly diverse stakeholder base strongly preferred.
  • General knowledge of soccer.
  • Capable of working in fast-paced and demanding environments.
  • Must be able to connect “micro” details to the “macro” vision and mission.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and travel up to two times per quarter. 
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook). 

Desired Qualifications 

  • Strategic hustle, initiative, and work ethic with diversity of thought. 
  • Strong posture for empathy. 
  • Ability to build meaningful relationships both internally and externally. 
  • Able to think strategically and handle multiple projects. 
  • Confidence without ego. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus, but not required. 

 

U.S. Soccer offers a comprehensive compensation package, casual work environment, an inclusive culture, and an atmosphere for professional development.


U.S. Soccer is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind on the basis of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, military status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected under the law. This policy applies to all our employment practices within our organization. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA, veterans, parents, and persons with disabilities to apply.
